form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: Cuatro versos: riman los dos primeros y riman los dos últimos.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four verses: rhyme the first two and rhyme the last two.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Cuatro versos: el 1 rima con el 3 y el 2 con el 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four verses: 1 rhymes with 3 and 2 with 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: Tres versos; riman el primero y el último.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three verses; the first and last rhyme.

form.anaphora.brief.text: Tres versos que empiezan todos con la misma palabra.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three verses that all begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: Tres versos que empiezan todos con el mismo carácter.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three verses that all begin with the same character.

form.acrostic.brief.text: Un verso por letra: las iniciales deben formar calavera.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One verse per letter: the initials must form a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: Un verso por palabra: los versos deben empezar, en orden, con calavera.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One verse per word: Verses must begin, in order, with skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: Tres versos, cada uno más largo que el anterior.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three verses, each longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: Tres versos que terminan todos con la misma palabra.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three verses that all end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Tres versos que terminan todos con el mismo carácter.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three verses that all end with the same character.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Tres versos de 5, 7 y 5 sonidos. Escribe en kana para que se puedan contar.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three verses of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so they can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Dos versos rimados de unas diez sílabas cada uno, como cerraba Shakespeare sus sonetos.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhymed verses of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Cuatro versos, todos de cinco caracteres o todos de siete: la figura de la cuarteta clásica china.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four verses, all five characters or all seven: the figure of the classical Chinese quartet.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Un verso de seis sílabas y otro de ocho cuya sexta sílaba rima con el final del primero.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A verse of six syllables and another of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.

check.same-opening.text: Todos los versos empiezan con la misma palabra
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All the verses start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: Todos los versos empiezan con el mismo carácter
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: All the verses start with the same character

check.same-ending.text: Todos los versos terminan con la misma palabra
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: All the verses end with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: Todos los versos terminan con el mismo carácter
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: All verses end with the same character

check.spells.words.text: Los versos empiezan, en orden, con calavera
check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: Verses begin, in order, with skull

check.growing.text: Cada verso tiene más palabras que el anterior
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each verse has more words than the previous one

check.growing.char.text: Cada verso tiene más caracteres que el anterior
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each verse has more characters than the previous one

check.jueju-length.text: Todos los versos tienen cinco caracteres, o todos tienen siete
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: All verses have five characters, or all have seven

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: Rima la sexta sílaba de cada verso
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: Rhyme the sixth syllable of each verse

device.question.brief.text: Haz una pregunta: termina un verso con un signo de interrogación.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: End a verse with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: Clama: termina un verso con un signo de exclamación.
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Clama: Ends a verse with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: Empieza tres palabras de un mismo verso con la misma letra.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words of the same verse with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: Repite tres veces una palabra con peso.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a word with weight three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: Haz rimar dos palabras dentro de un mismo verso.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two words rhyme within the same verse.

device.riposte.brief.text: Devuélvele a tu rival una palabra de 3 letras o más de su última estrofa.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Return your opponent a 3-letter or more word from their last stanza.

device.brevity.brief.text: Que ningún verso pase de 3 palabras.
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: Que ningún verso pase de 3 caracteres.
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.

device.swell.brief.text: Haz que tu último verso sea el más largo.
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make your last verse the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: Da a todos los versos el mismo número de palabras.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Give all verses the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: Da a todos los versos el mismo número de caracteres.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Give all verses the same number of characters.

device.ring.brief.text: Termina tu estrofa con la misma palabra con que empezó.
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End your stanza with the same word it started with.

device.ring.brief.char.text: Termina tu estrofa con el mismo carácter con que empezó.
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End your stanza with the same character it started with.

device.invocation.brief.text: Invoca a un personaje por su nombre.
device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: Usa dos palabras de 3 letras o más.
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of 3 letters or more.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: Termina todos los versos con la misma rima.
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: End all the verses with the same rhyme.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: Tu estrofa no puede contener la letra S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: Your stanza cannot contain the letter S.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: Su estrofa no puede contener la letra S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: Your stanza cannot contain the letter S.

curse.short-words.brief.text: Ninguna de tus palabras puede tener más de 3 letras.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: None of your words can have more than 3 letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: Ninguna de sus palabras puede tener más de 3 letras.
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: None of your words can have more than 3 letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: No puedes usar dos veces ninguna palabra de 3 letras o más.
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You cannot use any word of 3 letters or more twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: No puede usar dos veces ninguna palabra de 3 letras o más.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: You cannot use any word of 3 letters or more twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: Ninguno de tus versos puede pasar de 3 palabras.
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: None of your verses can exceed 3 words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: Ninguno de tus versos puede pasar de 3 caracteres.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: None of your verses can exceed 3 characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: Ninguno de sus versos puede pasar de 3 palabras.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: None of his verses can exceed 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: Ninguno de sus versos puede pasar de 3 caracteres.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: None of your verses can exceed 3 characters.

house.montague.why.text: La lengua veloz de Mercucio rima a mitad de verso.
house.montague.why.back: The quick tongue of Mercucio rhymes half a verse.

house.verona-court.why.text: La corte sopesa cada palabra dicha contra ti.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word said against you.

house.the-tempest.why.text: La tormenta crece hasta que rompe.
house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm grows until it breaks.

house.legendary.why.text: El Sonnet Man cabalga una sola rima hasta el final.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: The Sonnet Man rides a single rhyme to the end.

house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.text: Los dioses hablan con palabras de trueno.
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods speak with words of thunder.

house.underworld.why.text: Los muertos recuerdan todo lo que dijiste.
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you said.

nav.toggleAudio.back: Turn on or mute the sound

footer.tagline.text: Cartas coleccionables digitales con IA y realidad aumentada. Experiencias interactivas que dan vida a Shakespeare.
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital collectible cards with AI and augmented reality, interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.

age.title.text: Te damos la bienvenida a Inspired Mile

age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.text: Selecciona tu fecha de nacimiento completa.
age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Select your complete date of birth.

age.minorTitle.text: No cumples el requisito de edad
age.minorTitle.back: You do not meet the age requirement

age.minorBody.text: Debes tener al menos 13 años para usar Inspired Mile. Vuelve cuando cumplas el requisito de edad.
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile, come back when you meet the age requirement.

age.teenTitle.text: Se necesita el consentimiento de tus padres

age.teenBody.text: Como tienes menos de 18 años, necesitas el consentimiento de tu padre, madre o tutor para usar Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: As you are under the age of 18, you need your parent’s or guardian’s consent to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.text: Confirmo que mi padre, madre o tutor legal ha leído las
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the
age.consentBefore.back: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has read the

age.consentAfter.text: y consiente que yo use Inspired Mile.

age.consentAfter.back: and consent to me using Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our

migrate.body.text: Hemos encontrado progreso guardado en este dispositivo. Sincronízalo con tu cuenta para tenerlo en todos tus dispositivos.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We found saved progress on this device, please sync it with your account to have it on all your devices.

migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Could not sync, please try again later.

pwa.install.text: Instala Inspired Mile para disfrutarlo al máximo
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile to get the most out of it

offline.banner.text: Estás sin conexión: la Colección y el Trivial siguen funcionando. El Multijugador necesita internet.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: Collection and Trivial still work. Multiplayer requires an internet connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: Sin contraseñas que recordar. Una llave de acceso te identifica con tu huella, tu cara o el bloqueo de pantalla.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No passwords to remember — a passkey identifies you with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyButton.text: Entrar con una llave de acceso

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Este navegador no admite llaves de acceso. Entra con un código enviado por correo.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser does not support access keys. Enter a code sent to you by email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Este navegador no admite llaves de acceso, y este sitio las usa para iniciar sesión. Prueba con una versión reciente de Chrome, Safari, Edge o Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser does not support access keys, and this site uses them to sign in.Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.text: Crear una cuenta con una llave de acceso
auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: Tu cuenta es una llave de acceso guardada en este dispositivo o en tu gestor de contraseñas. No pedimos nombre, correo ni contraseña.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is an access key stored on this device or in your password manager – we don’t ask for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Si pierdes la llave de acceso, no podremos dejarte entrar. Después, añade una segunda llave o un correo para poder volver.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your access key, we won’t be able to let you in, so add a second key or email to get back.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Si pierdes la llave de acceso, no podremos dejarte entrar. Después, añade una segunda llave para poder volver.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your access key, we won’t be able to let you in, so add a second key to get back.

auth.nudgeBody.text: Ahora mismo una sola llave de acceso es la única entrada a esta cuenta. Si se pierde, se pierde la cuenta. Añade una segunda llave o un correo para poder volver.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: Right now a single access key is the only entry to this account, if you lose it, your account will be lost. Add a second key or an email so you can get back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Ahora mismo una sola llave de acceso es la única entrada a esta cuenta. Si se pierde, se pierde la cuenta. Añade una segunda llave para poder volver.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: Right now a single access key is the only entry to this account, if you lose it, your account will be lost. Add a second key so that you can get back.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Usa otro dispositivo, un gestor de contraseñas o una llave de seguridad.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.

auth.nudgeEmail.text: Añadir un correo en su lugar

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Una sola llave de acceso es tu única entrada. Añade una segunda llave o un correo para poder volver.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: A single access key is your only entry, add a second key or email to get back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Una sola llave de acceso es tu única entrada. Añade una segunda llave para poder volver.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: A single access key is your only entry, add a second key to return.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Hemos enviado un código de 6 dígitos a a@example.com. Escríbelo para confirmar que la dirección es tuya.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We've sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, enter it to confirm that the address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: Correo añadido. Ya puedes entrar con un código enviado a esa dirección.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email added. You can now log in with a code sent to that address.

auth.emailHint.text: ¿En un dispositivo sin tu llave de acceso? Entra por correo, si tu cuenta tiene uno.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: On a device without your passkey? Sign in via email, if your account has one.

auth.emailIntro.text: Te enviaremos un código de 6 dígitos. Si la dirección es nueva, el código crea tu cuenta.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit code, which creates your account if the address is new.

auth.codeIntro.text: Hemos enviado un código de 6 dígitos a a@example.com. Sirve una sola vez y caduca en 10 minutos.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We've sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, it's one-time and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Va en camino un código nuevo. El anterior ya no sirve.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new code is on the way. The old one no longer works.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By logging in, you accept our

auth.offerHeading.text: Añade una llave de acceso a este dispositivo
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: La próxima vez, entra con tu huella, tu cara o el bloqueo de pantalla. Sin código y sin esperar un correo.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock — without a code and without waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Aún no hay llaves de acceso. Añade una para entrar sin código por correo.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There are no access keys yet. Add one to enter without code by mail.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Llave de acceso añadida. Ya puedes entrar con ella.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: Access key added. You can now log in with it.

auth.error.age_required.text: Confirma primero tu edad en la página de inicio. Las cuentas son para jugadores de 13 años o más.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: First confirm your age on the homepage.Accounts are for players 13 years or older.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Esa dirección ya pertenece a otra cuenta. Cierra sesión y entra con ella.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: That address already belongs to another account, so log out and sign in with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: Esta cuenta ya tiene un correo electrónico.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: No se ha completado. Inténtalo de nuevo.
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: Eso no parece una dirección de correo.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: That doesn't look like a mail address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: El código no es correcto o ha caducado. Revísalo o pide uno nuevo.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect or has expired, please check it or order a new one.

battle.intro.text: Tres rondas, tres formas. Tus cartas deciden qué debe hacer tu estrofa. El rival funciona en tu navegador: nada de lo que escribes sale de este dispositivo.

battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three ways – your cards decide what your stanza should do. The opponent works in your browser: nothing you type comes out of this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Cada personaje puede salir a escena una vez. Las reliquias y las pociones cuestan tinta.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can appear once, and relics and potions cost ink.

battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: choose the best of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: Maestro: elige el mejor de tres borradores
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: Comprobando qué puede ejecutar este dispositivo…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: Se descarga una vez desde Hugging Face y tu navegador lo conserva. Nada de lo que escribes o dices se envía a ninguna parte.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: It downloads once from Hugging Face and your browser keeps it, nothing you type or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: El modelo Gemma está cargado y funciona en este dispositivo.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: The Gemma model is loaded and working on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: El modelo Gemma está cargado en este dispositivo. Es pequeño: juzga las estrofas, y el rival recita versos ya escritos.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The model Gemma is loaded on this device.It is small: it judges the stanzas, and the rival recites already written verses.

brain.written.back: Playing against the rival of written verses.

brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser has no WebGPU, so the rival recites already written verses and is judged by rules.Everything else works.

brain.canRun.text: Este dispositivo puede ejecutar Gemma en el navegador. Son 3,1 GB de descarga la primera vez; después se conserva.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in the browser.It's 3.1 GB download first time, then it is kept.

brain.summonLighter.text: Invocar a Gemma (3,1 GB): una descarga más ligera
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download
brain.summonLighter.back: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: Playing against the rival of written verses.You can invoke the model whenever you want by reloading the page.

theatre.intro.text: El mismo duelo, en un escenario a tu alrededor. Señala o pellizca para jugar una carta, pulsa el micrófono y di tu estrofa. Se transcribe y se juzga en este dispositivo.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on a stage all around you. Point or pinch to play a card, tap the microphone and say your stanza – it’s transcribed and judged on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Se abre con visión del entorno, así que el escenario queda en tu habitación. Señala con un mando o pellizca con la mano.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: It opens with a view of the surroundings, so the stage is in your room.Point with a remote or pinch with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: Se abre como un escenario completo. Mira una carta y pellizca. Safari en visionOS no ofrece visión del entorno a las páginas web.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Safari on visionOS doesn’t provide a view of the surroundings for web pages, so you’ll need to pinch your fingers to see what’s around you.

theatre.screenBody.text: Haz clic en las cartas y los botones del escenario, y habla o escribe.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: Juegas contra el rival de versos escritos. Invoca un modelo en la página de batalla para enfrentarte a él aquí.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: You play against the written verse opponent, summoning a model on the battle page to face him here.

theatre.declined.text: Este dispositivo ha rechazado la sesión inmersiva.
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This device has rejected the immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: No se ha podido iniciar la sesión en el visor.
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: Could not log in to the viewer.

theatre.judgedModel.text: Juzgado por Gemma en este dispositivo.
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Judged by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: Juzgado por reglas: no hay ningún modelo en marcha.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Judged by rules: there is no running model.

theatre.pick.text: Elige un personaje de tu mano.
theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: Te maldice. Ninguna de tus palabras puede tener más de 5 letras.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: It curses you. None of your words can be longer than 5 letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Aquí aparece tu estrofa. Pulsa el micrófono y dila, un verso por aliento.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Here's your stanza. Press the microphone and dilate, one verse per breath.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: Quatre vers : les deux premiers riment, et les deux derniers aussi.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four verses: the first two rhyme, and the last two too.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Quatre vers : le 1 rime avec le 3, le 2 avec le 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: Trois vers ; le premier et le dernier riment.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three verses; the first and last rhyme.

form.anaphora.brief.text: Trois vers qui commencent tous par le même mot.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three verses that all begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: Trois vers qui commencent tous par le même caractère.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three verses that all begin with the same character.

form.acrostic.brief.text: Un vers par lettre : les initiales doivent former crâne.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One verse per letter: the initials must form a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: Un vers par mot : les vers doivent commencer, dans l’ordre, par crâne.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One verse per word: the verses must begin, in order, by skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: Trois vers, chacun plus long que le précédent.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three verses, each longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: Trois vers qui finissent tous par le même mot.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three verses that all end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Trois vers qui finissent tous par le même caractère.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three verses that all end with the same character.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Trois vers de 5, 7 et 5 sons. Écrivez en kana pour qu’on puisse les compter.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three verses of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so we can count them.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Deux vers rimés d’une dizaine de syllabes chacun, comme Shakespeare concluait ses sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhymed verses of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare concluded his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Quatre vers, tous de cinq caractères ou tous de sept : la forme du quatrain classique chinois.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four verses, all of five characters or all of seven: the form of classical Chinese quatrain.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Un vers de six syllabes, puis un de huit dont la sixième syllabe rime avec la fin du premier.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A verse of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.

check.same-opening.text: Tous les vers commencent par le même mot
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All verses start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.back: All verses start with the same character

check.same-ending.text: Tous les vers finissent par le même mot

check.same-ending.back: All the verses end with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: Tous les vers finissent par le même caractère
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: All verses end with the same character

check.spells.words.back: The worms start, in order, by skull

check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: The sixth syllable of each verse rhymes

device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: End a verse with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: Exclamez-vous : terminez un vers par un point d’exclamation.
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Exclamez-vous : end a verse with an exclamation point.

device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words in the same verse with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: Répétez trois fois un mot fort.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a strong word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two words rhyme within the same verse.

device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.

device.brevity.brief.back: No more than 3 words per verse.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: Pas plus de 3 caractères par vers.
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: No more than 3 characters per verse.

device.swell.brief.text: Faites de votre dernier vers le plus long.
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make your last verse the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: Donnez à chaque vers le même nombre de mots.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Give each verse the same number of words.

device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of 3 or more letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Finish all the verses on the same rhyme.

curse.short-words.brief.back: None of your words should exceed 3 letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: None of its words must exceed 3 letters.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: He may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.back: None of your verses should exceed 3 words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: Aucun de vos vers ne doit dépasser 3 caractères.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: None of your verses should exceed 3 characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: Aucun de ses vers ne doit dépasser 3 mots.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: None of its verses should exceed 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: Aucun de ses vers ne doit dépasser 3 caractères.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: None of its verses must exceed 3 characters.

house.montague.why.text: La langue vive de Mercutio rime en plein vers.
house.montague.why.back: The vivid language of Mercutio rhymes in full verse.

house.verona-court.why.text: La cour pèse chaque mot prononcé contre vous.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word spoken against you.

house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm swells until it bursts.

house.legendary.why.text: Le Sonnet Man chevauche une seule rime jusqu’au bout.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: The Sonnet Man overlaps a single rhyme to the end.

house.gothic-circle.why.text: Le récit finit là où il a commencé.
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.text: Les dieux parlent en mots de tonnerre.
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods speak in words of thunder.

house.underworld.why.text: Les morts se souviennent de tout ce que vous avez dit.
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you have said.

footer.tagline.back: Digital collectible cards, animated by AI and augmented reality; interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.

pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile to take full advantage

offline.banner.text: Vous êtes hors ligne : la Collection et le Quiz fonctionnent toujours. Le Multijoueur demande une connexion.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: the Collection and Quiz still work. The Multiplayer requires a connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: Aucun mot de passe à retenir. Une clé d’accès vous connecte avec votre empreinte, votre visage ou le verrouillage de l’écran.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No passwords to remember – a passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyButton.text: Se connecter avec une clé d’accès
auth.passkeyButton.back: Log in with an access key

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Ce navigateur ne gère pas les clés d’accès. Connectez-vous plutôt avec un code reçu par e-mail.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser does not handle access keys, please log in with a code received by e-mail.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Ce navigateur ne gère pas les clés d’accès, et ce site s’en sert pour la connexion. Essayez une version récente de Chrome, Safari, Edge ou Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser does not support access keys, and this site uses them for login.Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.text: Créer un compte avec une clé d’accès
auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with an access key

auth.createIntro.text: Votre compte est une clé d’accès enregistrée sur cet appareil ou dans votre gestionnaire de mots de passe. Nous ne demandons ni nom, ni e-mail, ni mot de passe.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is an access key stored on this device or in your password manager, and we don’t ask for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Si vous perdez la clé d’accès, nous ne pourrons pas vous laisser entrer. Ajoutez ensuite une seconde clé ou un e-mail pour pouvoir revenir.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose the access key, we will not be able to let you in.Add a second key or an e-mail to get back.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Si vous perdez la clé d’accès, nous ne pourrons pas vous laisser entrer. Ajoutez ensuite une seconde clé pour pouvoir revenir.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose the access key, we will not be able to let you in.Add then a second key so that you can come back.

auth.nudgeBody.text: Pour l’instant, une seule clé d’accès ouvre ce compte. Si elle est perdue, le compte l’est aussi. Ajoutez une seconde clé ou un e-mail pour pouvoir revenir.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: At the moment, only one access key opens this account, so if you lose it, your account will also be lost. Add a second key or email to get back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Pour l’instant, une seule clé d’accès ouvre ce compte. Si elle est perdue, le compte l’est aussi. Ajoutez une seconde clé pour pouvoir revenir.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: At the moment, only one access key opens this account, so if you lose it, your account will also be lost. Add a second key to get back.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Utilisez un autre appareil, un gestionnaire de mots de passe ou une clé de sécurité.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Une seule clé d’accès vous permet d’entrer. Ajoutez une seconde clé ou un e-mail pour pouvoir revenir.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: Only one access key allows you to enter, add a second key or an e-mail so you can come back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Une seule clé d’accès vous permet d’entrer. Ajoutez une seconde clé pour pouvoir revenir.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: Only one access key allows you to enter, add a second key to get back.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Nous avons envoyé un code à 6 chiffres à a@example.com. Saisissez-le pour confirmer que l’adresse est la vôtre.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, enter it to confirm that the address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: E-mail ajouté. Vous pouvez désormais vous connecter avec un code envoyé à cette adresse.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email added. You can now log in with a code sent to this address.

auth.emailHint.text: Sur un appareil sans votre clé d’accès ? Connectez-vous par e-mail, si votre compte en a un.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: On a device without your passkey? Sign in with email, if your account has one.

auth.emailIntro.text: Nous vous enverrons un code à 6 chiffres. Si l’adresse est nouvelle, le code crée votre compte.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We will send you a 6-digit code, which creates your account if the address is new.

auth.codeIntro.text: Nous avons envoyé un code à 6 chiffres à a@example.com. Il sert une seule fois et expire dans 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, which is only valid once and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Un nouveau code est en route. L’ancien ne fonctionne plus.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new code is on the way. The old one no longer works.

auth.legalBefore.text: En vous connectant, vous acceptez nos
auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By logging in, you accept our

auth.offerHeading.text: Ajoutez une clé d’accès à cet appareil
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: La prochaine fois, connectez-vous avec votre empreinte, votre visage ou le verrouillage de l’écran. Sans code, sans attendre un e-mail.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock — no code, no waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Aucune clé d’accès pour l’instant. Ajoutez-en une pour vous connecter sans code par e-mail.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: No access key yet, add one to log in without an email code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Clé d’accès ajoutée. Vous pouvez désormais vous en servir pour vous connecter.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: Access key added. You can now use it to log in.

auth.error.age_required.text: Veuillez d’abord confirmer votre âge sur la page d’accueil. Les comptes sont réservés aux joueurs de 13 ans et plus.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: First, please confirm your age on the homepage.Accounts are reserved for players aged 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Cette adresse appartient déjà à un autre compte. Déconnectez-vous et connectez-vous avec elle.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address already belongs to another account, please log out and log in with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: Ce compte a déjà une adresse e-mail.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: Cela n’a pas abouti. Veuillez réessayer.
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: Cela ne ressemble pas à une adresse e-mail.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It does not look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Ce code est incorrect ou a expiré. Vérifiez-le, ou demandez-en un nouveau.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: This code is incorrect or has expired, please check it or request a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Trop de codes demandés. Patientez quelques minutes, puis réessayez.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.text: L’e-mail n’est pas disponible pour le moment.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.back: The e-mail is not available at the moment.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Nous n’avons pas pu envoyer l’e-mail. Réessayez dans un instant.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We were unable to send the email, please try again in a moment.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Ce navigateur ne gère pas les clés d’accès.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: This browser does not support access keys.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Aucune clé d’accès n’a été utilisée. Réessayez quand vous voudrez.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No access key has been used, please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Cette clé d’accès n’a pas été acceptée. Connectez-vous avec un code par e-mail, puis ajoutez une nouvelle clé.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: This access key has not been accepted, sign in with an email code and add a new one.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: La clé d’accès n’a pas fonctionné. Veuillez réessayer.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The access key did not work, please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: Cet appareil a déjà une clé d’accès pour votre compte.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a passkey for your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: Cette clé d’accès est déjà enregistrée.
auth.error.passkey_already_registered.back: This access key is already registered.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Cette clé d’accès n’a pas pu être ajoutée. Veuillez réessayer.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: This access key could not be added, please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: Ce compte a atteint le nombre maximum de clés d’accès. Retirez-en une d’abord.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has reached the maximum number of access keys. Remove one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Cette clé d’accès est votre seul moyen de connexion. Ajoutez-en une autre avant de la retirer.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is your only way to log in, so add another one before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: Cela a pris trop de temps. Veuillez réessayer.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long, please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: Votre session a pris fin. Veuillez vous reconnecter.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has expired, please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: Impossible de joindre le serveur. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Unable to connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: Une erreur est survenue. Veuillez réessayer.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: An error has occurred, please try again.

battle.intro.text: Trois manches, trois formes. Vos cartes décident de ce que votre strophe doit accomplir. L’adversaire tourne dans votre navigateur : rien de ce que vous écrivez ne quitte cet appareil.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three shapes. Your cards decide what your stanza must accomplish. The opponent is in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Chaque personnage ne peut monter en scène qu’une fois. Les reliques et les potions coûtent de l’encre.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can only appear once, and relics and potions cost ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Comédien : garde le meilleur de deux jets
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Comedian: keeps the best of two jets

battle.difficulty.master.text: Maître : garde le meilleur de trois jets
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: keeps the best of three jets

brain.checking.text: Vérification de ce que cet appareil peut faire tourner…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can play…

brain.playNow.text: Jouer tout de suite, sans téléchargement
brain.playNow.back: Play right away, no download required

brain.kept.text: Téléchargé une fois depuis Hugging Face, puis conservé par votre navigateur. Rien de ce que vous écrivez ou dites n’est envoyé nulle part.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Downloaded once from Hugging Face, then stored by your browser.Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Le modèle Gemma est chargé et tourne sur cet appareil.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: The Gemma model is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Le modèle Gemma est chargé sur cet appareil. Il est petit : il juge les strophes, et l’adversaire joue des strophes déjà écrites.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The Gemma model is loaded on this device.It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays already written verses.

brain.failed.text: Le modèle n’a pas pu démarrer sur cet appareil. Vous pouvez tout de même affronter l’adversaire aux strophes écrites.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not start on this device, but you can still play against the opponent with written verses.

brain.written.text: Vous affrontez l’adversaire aux strophes écrites.
brain.written.back: You face the opponent with written verses.

brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
