migrate.body.text: Wir haben einen Spielstand auf diesem Gerät gefunden. Synchronisiere ihn mit deinem Konto, damit er auf allen Geräten gespeichert ist.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We found a save on this device, please sync it to your account so it's stored on all your devices.

migrate.failed.text: Synchronisierung fehlgeschlagen. Du kannst es später noch einmal versuchen.
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Synchronization failed, please try again later.

pwa.install.text: Installiere Inspired Mile für das beste Erlebnis
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience

offline.banner.text: Du bist offline: Sammlung und Quiz funktionieren weiter. Der Mehrspielermodus braucht Internet.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You're offline: Collection and Quiz will continue to work. Multiplayer mode requires internet connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: Kein Passwort zum Merken. Ein Passkey meldet dich mit Fingerabdruck, Gesicht oder Displaysperre an.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Dieser Browser kann keine Passkeys verwenden. Melde dich stattdessen mit einem Code per E-Mail an.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser cannot use passkeys, sign in with a code via email instead.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Dieser Browser kann keine Passkeys verwenden, und diese Seite meldet damit an. Versuch es mit einer aktuellen Version von Chrome, Safari, Edge oder Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this page is logging in with it.Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: Dein Konto ist ein Passkey, gespeichert auf diesem Gerät oder in deinem Passwortmanager. Wir fragen weder nach Name noch E-Mail noch Passwort.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a passkey stored on this device or in your password manager, and we don’t ask for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Wenn du den Passkey verlierst, können wir dich nicht wieder hereinlassen. Füge danach einen zweiten Passkey oder eine E-Mail hinzu, damit du wieder Zugriff hast.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose the passkey, we can’t let you in again, so add a second passkey or email to get back in.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Wenn du den Passkey verlierst, können wir dich nicht wieder hereinlassen. Füge danach einen zweiten Passkey hinzu, damit du wieder Zugriff hast.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose the passkey, we can’t let you in again, so add a second passkey afterwards to regain access.

auth.nudgeBody.text: Im Moment ist ein einziger Passkey der einzige Zugang zu diesem Konto. Geht er verloren, ist das Konto verloren. Füge einen zweiten Passkey oder eine E-Mail hinzu, damit du wieder Zugriff hast.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: At the moment, a single passkey is the only way to access this account, so if you lose it, your account will be lost. Add a second passkey or email address to get back in.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Im Moment ist ein einziger Passkey der einzige Zugang zu diesem Konto. Geht er verloren, ist das Konto verloren. Füge einen zweiten Passkey hinzu, damit du wieder Zugriff hast.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: At the moment, a single passkey is the only way to access this account; if you lose it, your account will be lost. Add a second passkey so that you can regain access.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Nutze ein anderes Gerät, einen Passwortmanager oder einen Sicherheitsschlüssel.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use a different device, password manager or security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Ein einziger Passkey ist dein einziger Zugang. Füge einen zweiten Passkey oder eine E-Mail hinzu, damit du wieder Zugriff hast.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: A single passkey is your only access, so add a second passkey or email to get back in.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Ein einziger Passkey ist dein einziger Zugang. Füge einen zweiten Passkey hinzu, damit du wieder Zugriff hast.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: A single passkey is your only access, so add a second passkey to get back in.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Wir haben einen 6-stelligen Code an a@example.com geschickt. Gib ihn ein, um zu bestätigen, dass die Adresse dir gehört.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We've sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, enter it to verify that you own the address.

auth.addEmailDone.text: E-Mail hinzugefügt. Du kannst dich jetzt mit einem Code anmelden, der dorthin geschickt wird.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent there.

auth.emailHint.text: An einem Gerät ohne deinen Passkey? Melde dich per E-Mail an, falls dein Konto eine hat.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: On a device without your passkey, sign in with email if your account has one.

auth.emailIntro.text: Wir schicken dir einen 6-stelligen Code. Ist die Adresse neu, erstellt der Code dein Konto.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit code, which will create your account if the address is new.

auth.codeIntro.text: Wir haben einen 6-stelligen Code an a@example.com geschickt. Er gilt einmal und läuft nach 10 Minuten ab.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, which is valid once and expires after 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Ein neuer Code ist unterwegs. Der alte gilt nicht mehr.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new code is on the way. The old one no longer applies.

auth.legalBefore.text: Mit der Anmeldung akzeptierst du unsere
auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By signing up you accept our

auth.offerHeading.text: Füge diesem Gerät einen Passkey hinzu
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: Melde dich beim nächsten Mal mit Fingerabdruck, Gesicht oder Displaysperre an. Kein Code, kein Warten auf eine E-Mail.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time you sign in, use your fingerprint, face or screen lock — no code, no waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Noch keine Passkeys. Füge einen hinzu, um dich ohne E-Mail-Code anzumelden.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: No passkeys yet, add one to sign in without an email code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Passkey hinzugefügt. Du kannst dich ab jetzt damit anmelden.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: Passkey added. You can use it to log in now.

auth.error.age_required.text: Bitte bestätige zuerst dein Alter auf der Startseite. Konten sind für Spieler ab 13 Jahren.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please first confirm your age on the homepage.Accounts are for players over 13 years old.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Diese Adresse gehört schon zu einem anderen Konto. Melde dich ab und stattdessen damit an.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address already belongs to another account, sign out and use it instead.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: Dieses Konto hat bereits eine E-Mail-Adresse.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: Das hat nicht geklappt. Bitte versuch es noch einmal.
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.
auth.error.signup_retry.back: It didn't work, please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: Das sieht nicht nach einer E-Mail-Adresse aus.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: This does not look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Dieser Code stimmt nicht oder ist abgelaufen. Prüf ihn oder fordere einen neuen an.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: This code is incorrect or has expired, check it or request a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.text: Gib alle 6 Ziffern des Codes ein.
auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Zu viele Codes angefordert. Warte ein paar Minuten und versuch es dann noch einmal.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested, please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.text: E-Mail ist im Moment nicht verfügbar.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.back: Email is not available at the moment.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Wir konnten die E-Mail nicht senden. Bitte versuch es gleich noch einmal.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We were unable to send the email, please try again.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Dieser Browser kann keine Passkeys verwenden.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Es wurde kein Passkey verwendet. Versuch es noch einmal, wenn du so weit bist.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No passkey was used, please try again when you're ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Dieser Passkey wurde nicht akzeptiert. Melde dich mit einem Code per E-Mail an und füge dann einen neuen Passkey hinzu.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: This passkey wasn't accepted, sign in with an email code and then add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: Der Passkey hat nicht funktioniert. Bitte versuch es noch einmal.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The passkey did not work, please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: Dieses Gerät hat bereits einen Passkey für dein Konto.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a passkey for your account.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Dieser Passkey konnte nicht hinzugefügt werden. Bitte versuch es noch einmal.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: This passkey could not be added, please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: Dieses Konto hat die Höchstzahl an Passkeys erreicht. Entferne zuerst einen.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has reached the maximum number of passkeys, please remove one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Dieser Passkey ist dein einziger Weg, dich anzumelden. Füge einen weiteren hinzu, bevor du ihn entfernst.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is your only way to log in, so add another one before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: Das hat zu lange gedauert. Bitte versuch es noch einmal.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: This has taken too long, please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: Deine Sitzung ist beendet. Bitte melde dich erneut an.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has expired, please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: Wir konnten den Server nicht erreichen. Prüf deine Verbindung und versuch es noch einmal.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: We could not reach the server, please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: Etwas ist schiefgegangen. Bitte versuch es noch einmal.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: Something went wrong, please try again.

battle.intro.text: Drei Runden, drei Formen. Deine Karten bestimmen, was deine Strophe leisten muss. Der Gegner läuft in deinem Browser: Nichts von dem, was du schreibst, verlässt dieses Gerät.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three shapes – your cards determine what your stanza has to do. The opponent is running in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Jede Figur darf einmal auf die Bühne. Relikte und Tränke kosten Tinte.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can go on stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Schauspieler: wählt den besseren von zwei Entwürfen
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actors: choose the better of two designs

battle.difficulty.master.text: Meister: wählt den besten von drei Entwürfen
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: chooses the best of three designs

brain.checking.text: Prüfe, was dieses Gerät ausführen kann …
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Check what this device can do...

brain.kept.text: Einmal von Hugging Face heruntergeladen und von deinem Browser aufbewahrt. Nichts, was du schreibst oder sagst, wird irgendwohin gesendet.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Once downloaded from Hugging Face and stored by your browser, nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Gemma ist geladen und läuft auf diesem Gerät.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Gemma ist auf diesem Gerät geladen. Es ist klein: Es bewertet die Strophen, und der Gegner spielt geschriebene Strophen.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: Gemma is loaded on this device, it's small: it scores the verses, and the opponent plays written verses.

brain.failed.text: Das Modell konnte auf diesem Gerät nicht starten. Du kannst trotzdem gegen den Gegner mit geschriebenen Strophen spielen.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not start on this device, you can still play against the opponent with written verses.

brain.written.text: Du spielst gegen den Gegner mit geschriebenen Strophen.
brain.written.back: You play against the opponent with written verses.

brain.noWebgpu.text: Dieser Browser hat kein WebGPU, also spielt der Gegner geschriebene Strophen, und bewertet wird nach Regeln. Alles andere funktioniert.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser does not have a WebGPU, so the opponent plays written stanzas and scores according to rules, everything else works.

brain.canRun.text: Dieses Gerät kann Gemma im Browser ausführen. Beim ersten Mal sind es 3,1 GB Download, danach bleibt es gespeichert.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in the browser, the first time it is 3.1 GB download, after that it stays saved.

brain.summonLighter.text: Gemma beschwören (3,1 GB): ein kleinerer Download
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download
brain.summonLighter.back: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a smaller download

brain.writtenReload.text: Du spielst gegen den Gegner mit geschriebenen Strophen. Das Modell kannst du jederzeit beschwören, indem du die Seite neu lädst.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You play against the opponent with written verses, and you can summon the model at any time by reloading the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: Ruf es hinaus: Beende eine Zeile mit einem Ausrufezeichen.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Call it out: End a line with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet belegt dich mit dem Fluch Ariel: Keines deiner Wörter darf länger als 5 Buchstaben sein.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet curses you Ariel: None of your words can be longer than 5 letters.

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…

round.mustDo.back: What your verse has to do

round.seedNote.text: Derselbe Startwert und dasselbe Deck ziehen dieselben Formen.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: The same starting value and deck draw the same shapes.

hand.curses.text: Verflucht deinen Gegner: Keines deiner Wörter darf länger als 5 Buchstaben sein.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curse your opponent: None of your words can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet leiht dir: Schädel, Scherz und Grab.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet lends you: Skull, Joke and Grave.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet verflucht die nächste Strophe deines Gegners: Keines deiner Wörter darf länger als 5 Buchstaben sein.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses your opponent's next stanza: None of your words can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet würde die nächste Strophe des Gegners verfluchen, aber dies ist die letzte Runde.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet would curse the opponent’s next stanza, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.text: Diese Figur ist nicht in deinem Deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: This card is not in your deck.

illegal.character-used.text: Jede Figur darf pro Partie einmal auf die Bühne.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Each character can go on stage once per game.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.text: Dieses Relikt ist nicht in deinem Deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: This relic is not in your deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.text: Dieser Trank ist nicht in deinem Deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.back: This potion is not in your deck.

live.device.text: Ariel (+½ Handwerk): Ruf es hinaus: Beende eine Zeile mit einem Ausrufezeichen.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (+½ craft): Call It Out: End a line with an exclamation mark.

live.signature.text: Signatur (+½ Handwerk): Lass die Zeile von Hamlet anklingen, ohne sie zu zitieren
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (+½ craft): Make Hamlet's line ring without quoting it

live.power.text: Machtworte (+2): Verwende zwei von Schädel, Scherz und Grab
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Power Words (+2): Use two of Skull, Joke and Grave

signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: this card has no signature line

signature.hint.text: lass eines davon anklingen: Schädel, Scherz und Grab
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: let one of them ring: skull, joke and grave

signature.quoted.text: wörtlich zitiert; ein Anklang muss deine eigene Zeile sein
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: quoted literally; a reference must be your own line

mic.heardNothing.text: Nichts gehört; versuch es noch einmal

mic.loadingEar.text: Das Ohr wird geladen (75 MB, einmalig) …
mic.loadingEar.back: The ear is loading (75 MB, once) …

mic.earFailed.text: Das Ohr konnte nicht geladen werden
mic.earFailed.back: The ear could not be loaded

mic.listening.text: Ich höre zu … zum Beenden tippen

verdict.judgedCompare.text: Bewertet von Gemma auf diesem Gerät; die Strophen wurden in beiden Reihenfolgen gelesen.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Rated by Gemma on this device; the verses were read in both orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: Bewertet von Gemma auf diesem Gerät; jede Strophe wurde für sich benotet.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Rated by Gemma on this device; each verse was rated separately.

verdict.judgedRules.text: Nach Regeln bewertet (Vielfalt, Anspielung, Klang und Konter), weil kein Modell läuft.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: Evaluated according to rules (variety, allusion, sound and counter), because no model is running.

end.lost.text: Heute Nacht gehört die Bühne dem Gegner.
end.lost.back: Tonight the stage belongs to the opponent.

end.tally.back: Rounds: you 2, opponent 1. Your overall score: 3.

badge.writtenJudged.text: Gegner mit geschriebenen Strophen · bewertet von Gemma
badge.writtenJudged.back: Opponents with written verses · reviewed by Gemma

theatre.intro.text: Dasselbe Duell, auf einer Bühne um dich herum. Zeig oder kneif, um eine Karte zu spielen, drück auf das Mikrofon und sprich deine Strophe. Sie wird auf diesem Gerät transkribiert und bewertet.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on a stage all around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your stanza, which will be transcribed and scored on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Öffnet sich im Durchsichtmodus, die Bühne steht also in deinem Zimmer. Zeig mit einem Controller oder kneif mit der Hand.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: Opens in view mode, so the stage is in your room – point with a controller or pinch with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: Öffnet sich als ganze Bühne. Sieh eine Karte an und kneif. Safari auf visionOS bietet Webseiten keinen Durchsichtmodus.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Opens as a full stage. View a map and pinch. Safari on visionOS doesn’t offer browse mode for web pages.

theatre.screenBody.text: Klick auf die Karten und Knöpfe der Bühne und sprich oder tipp.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards and buttons of the stage and speak or tap.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.
theatre.running.back: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: Du spielst gegen den Gegner mit geschriebenen Strophen. Beschwöre auf der Kampfseite ein Modell, um ihm hier zu begegnen.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: You play against the opponent with written verses, summon a model on the battle side to encounter him here.

theatre.declined.text: Dieses Gerät hat die immersive Sitzung abgelehnt.
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This device has declined the immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: Die Sitzung im Headset konnte nicht starten.
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: The session in the headset could not start.

theatre.judgedModel.text: Bewertet von Gemma auf diesem Gerät.
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Reviewed by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: Nach Regeln bewertet: Es läuft kein Modell.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Evaluated by rules: There is no running model.

theatre.pick.text: Wähle eine Figur aus deiner Hand.
theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a piece from your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: Verflucht dich: Keines deiner Wörter darf länger als 5 Buchstaben sein.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: Curse yourself: None of your words can be longer than 5 letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Hier erscheint deine Strophe. Drück auf das Mikrofon und sprich sie, eine Zeile pro Atemzug.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Press the microphone and say your verse, one line per breath.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: Quattro versi: rimano i primi due, e rimano gli ultimi due.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four verses: the first two remain, and the last two remain.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Quattro versi: il 1 rima con il 3, il 2 con il 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: Tre versi; rimano il primo e l’ultimo.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three verses; the first and last remain.

form.anaphora.brief.text: Tre versi che cominciano tutti con la stessa parola.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three verses that all begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: Tre versi che cominciano tutti con lo stesso carattere.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three verses that all begin with the same character.

form.acrostic.brief.text: Un verso per lettera: le iniziali devono formare teschio.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One verse per letter: the initials must form a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: Un verso per parola: i versi devono cominciare, nell’ordine, con teschio.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: A verse per word: the verses must begin, in order, with skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: Tre versi, ciascuno più lungo del precedente.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three verses, each longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: Tre versi che finiscono tutti con la stessa parola.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three verses that all end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Tre versi che finiscono tutti con lo stesso carattere.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three verses that all end with the same character.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Tre versi di 5, 7 e 5 suoni. Scrivi in kana, così si possono contare.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three verses of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so you can count them.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Due versi in rima di circa dieci sillabe ciascuno, come Shakespeare chiudeva i suoi sonetti.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhyming verses of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare used to close his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Quattro versi, tutti di cinque caratteri o tutti di sette: la forma della quartina classica cinese.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four verses, all of five characters or all of seven: the form of the classical Chinese quartet.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Un verso di sei sillabe, poi uno di otto la cui sesta sillaba rima con la fine del primo.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A verse of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.

check.same-opening.text: Tutti i versi cominciano con la stessa parola
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All the verses start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: Tutti i versi cominciano con lo stesso carattere
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: All verses begin with the same character

check.same-ending.text: Tutti i versi finiscono con la stessa parola
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: All the verses end with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: Tutti i versi finiscono con lo stesso carattere
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: All verses end with the same character

check.spells.words.text: I versi cominciano, nell’ordine, con teschio
check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: The verses begin, in order, with skull

check.growing.text: Ogni verso ha più parole del precedente
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each verse has more words than the previous

check.growing.char.text: Ogni verso ha più caratteri del precedente
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each verse has more characters than the previous

check.jueju-length.text: Tutti i versi hanno cinque caratteri, o tutti ne hanno sette
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: All verses have five characters, or all have seven

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: La sesta sillaba dei due versi rima
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: The sixth syllable of the two verses rhyme

device.question.brief.text: Fai una domanda: chiudi un verso con un punto interrogativo.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: End a verse with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: Grida: chiudi un verso con un punto esclamativo.
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Scream: Close a verse with an exclamation point.

device.alliteration.brief.text: Fai cominciare tre parole di uno stesso verso con la stessa lettera.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Make three words of the same verse start with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: Ripeti tre volte una parola forte.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a strong word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: Fai rimare due parole dentro un solo verso.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two words rhyme in a single verse.

device.riposte.brief.text: Rivolta contro l’avversario una parola di almeno 3 lettere della sua ultima strofa.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Turns against the opponent a word of at least 3 letters from his last verse.

device.brevity.brief.text: Nessun verso con più di 3 parole.
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: No verse with more than 3 words.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: Nessun verso con più di 3 caratteri.
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: No verse with more than 3 characters.

device.swell.brief.text: Fai dell’ultimo verso il più lungo.
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make the last line the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: Dai a ogni verso lo stesso numero di parole.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Give each verse the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: Dai a ogni verso lo stesso numero di caratteri.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Give each verse the same number of characters.

device.ring.brief.text: Chiudi la strofa con la stessa parola con cui è cominciata.
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End the stanza with the same word it started with.

device.ring.brief.char.text: Chiudi la strofa con lo stesso carattere con cui è cominciata.
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End the stanza with the same character as it began.

device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: Usa due parole di almeno 3 lettere.
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of at least 3 letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: Chiudi tutti i versi sulla stessa rima.
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Close all verses on the same rhyme.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: La tua strofa non può contenere la lettera L.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: Your verse cannot contain the letter L.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: La sua strofa non può contenere la lettera L.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: Your verse cannot contain the letter L.

curse.short-words.brief.text: Nessuna tua parola può avere più di 3 lettere.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: No one of your words can have more than 3 letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: Nessuna sua parola può avere più di 3 lettere.
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: No word can have more than 3 letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: Non puoi usare due volte nessuna parola di almeno 3 lettere.
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You cannot use any word of at least 3 letters twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: Non può usare due volte nessuna parola di almeno 3 lettere.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: You cannot use any word of at least 3 letters twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: Nessun tuo verso può avere più di 3 parole.
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: No one of your verses can have more than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: Nessun tuo verso può avere più di 3 caratteri.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: No one of your verses can have more than 3 characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: Nessun suo verso può avere più di 3 parole.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: No verse can have more than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: Nessun suo verso può avere più di 3 caratteri.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: No verse can have more than 3 characters.

house.montague.why.text: La lingua svelta di Mercuzio rima a metà verso.
house.montague.why.back: The swift tongue of Mercuzio rhymes in half verse.

house.verona-court.why.text: La corte pesa ogni parola detta contro di te.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word said against you.

house.the-tempest.why.text: La tempesta cresce finché non si rompe.
house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm grows until it breaks.

house.legendary.why.text: Il Sonnet Man cavalca una sola rima fino in fondo.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: The Sonnet Man rides a single rhyme all the way.

house.gothic-circle.why.text: Il racconto finisce dove è cominciato.
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.text: Gli dèi parlano con parole di tuono.
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods speak with words of thunder.

house.underworld.why.text: I morti ricordano tutto quello che hai detto.
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you said.

nav.toggleAudio.back: Turns the audio on or off

footer.tagline.text: Carte collezionabili digitali con IA e realtà aumentata. Esperienze interattive che danno vita a Shakespeare.
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital trading cards with AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.

age.title.text: Ti diamo il benvenuto su Inspired Mile

age.intro.text: Conferma la tua età per continuare.
age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.text: Seleziona la tua data di nascita completa.
age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Select your complete date of birth.

age.minorBody.text: Devi avere almeno 13 anni per usare Inspired Mile. Torna quando avrai l’età richiesta.
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile, please come back when you reach the required age.

age.teenBody.text: Poiché hai meno di 18 anni, ti serve il consenso di un genitore o di un tutore per usare Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: Because you are under the age of 18, you need a parent or guardian’s consent to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.text: Confermo che un mio genitore o tutore legale ha letto i
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the
age.consentBefore.back: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has read the

age.consentAfter.text: e acconsente al mio uso di Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our

migrate.body.text: Abbiamo trovato dei progressi salvati su questo dispositivo. Sincronizzali con il tuo account per averli su tutti i dispositivi.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We found saved progress on this device, sync it with your account to have it on all your devices.

migrate.failed.text: Sincronizzazione non riuscita. Puoi riprovare più tardi.
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Synchronization failed, please try again later.

pwa.install.text: Installa Inspired Mile per l’esperienza migliore
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience

offline.banner.text: Sei offline: la Collezione e il Quiz funzionano ancora. Il Multigiocatore richiede internet.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: The Collection and Quiz still work. Multiplayer requires internet.

auth.signInIntro.text: Nessuna password da ricordare. Una passkey ti fa accedere con l’impronta, il volto o il blocco schermo.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No passwords to remember. A passkey lets you log in with your fingerprint, face or lock screen.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Questo browser non può usare le passkey. Accedi invece con un codice inviato via email.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser cannot use passkeys. Log in with a code sent by email instead.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Questo browser non può usare le passkey, e questo sito le usa per l’accesso. Prova una versione recente di Chrome, Safari, Edge o Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site uses them for login.Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.text: Crea un account con una passkey
auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: Il tuo account è una passkey salvata su questo dispositivo o nel tuo gestore di password. Non chiediamo nome, email o password.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager.We don't ask for name, email or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Se perdi la passkey, non possiamo farti rientrare. Subito dopo, aggiungi una seconda passkey o un’email per poter rientrare.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your passkey, we can’t get you back in. Immediately afterwards, add a second passkey or email to be able to get back in.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Se perdi la passkey, non possiamo farti rientrare. Subito dopo, aggiungi una seconda passkey per poter rientrare.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your passkey, we can't get you back in. Immediately afterwards, add a second passkey to get you back in.

auth.nudgeBody.text: Per ora una sola passkey è l’unico modo di entrare in questo account. Se va persa, l’account è perso. Aggiungi una seconda passkey o un’email per poter rientrare.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: For now, one passkey is the only way to access this account. If you lose it, your account will be lost, so add a second passkey or an email address to get back in.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Per ora una sola passkey è l’unico modo di entrare in questo account. Se va persa, l’account è perso. Aggiungi una seconda passkey per poter rientrare.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: For now, one passkey is the only way to get into this account. If you lose it, your account will be lost, so add a second passkey to get back in.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Usa un altro dispositivo, un gestore di password o una chiave di sicurezza.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Una sola passkey è il tuo unico modo di entrare. Aggiungi una seconda passkey o un’email per poter rientrare.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: One passkey is your only way to get in.Add a second passkey or email to get back in.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Una sola passkey è il tuo unico modo di entrare. Aggiungi una seconda passkey per poter rientrare.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: One passkey is your only way to enter, add a second passkey to get back in.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Abbiamo inviato un codice di 6 cifre a a@example.com. Inseriscilo per confermare che l’indirizzo è tuo.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, enter it to confirm that the address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: Email aggiunta. Ora puoi accedere con un codice inviato a quell’indirizzo.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email added. You can now log in with a code sent to that address.

auth.emailButton.back: Send me a code via email

auth.emailHint.text: Sei su un dispositivo senza la tua passkey? Accedi via email, se il tuo account ne ha una.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Are you on a device without your passkey? Sign in via email, if your account has one.

auth.emailIntro.text: Ti invieremo un codice di 6 cifre. Se l’indirizzo è nuovo, il codice crea il tuo account.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We will send you a 6-digit code, which creates your account if the address is new.

auth.emailSend.back: Send me a code via email

auth.codeIntro.text: Abbiamo inviato un codice di 6 cifre a a@example.com. Vale una volta sola e scade tra 10 minuti.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, which is valid only once and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Un nuovo codice è in arrivo. Quello vecchio non funziona più.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new code is coming. The old one no longer works.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By logging in, you accept our

auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: La prossima volta accedi con l’impronta, il volto o il blocco schermo. Niente codice, niente attese per un’email.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time you sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock — no code, no waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Ancora nessuna passkey. Aggiungine una per accedere senza codice via email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.back: Still no passkey. Add one to access without code via email.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Passkey aggiunta. D’ora in poi puoi usarla per accedere.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: Passkey added. From now on you can use it to log in.

auth.error.age_required.text: Conferma prima la tua età nella pagina iniziale. Gli account sono per giocatori dai 13 anni in su.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: First confirm your age on the home page.Accounts are for players 13 years and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Quell’indirizzo appartiene già a un altro account. Esci e accedi con quello.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: That address already belongs to another account. Log out and log in with that one.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: Questo account ha già un indirizzo email.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: Non è andata a buon fine. Riprova.
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Il codice non è corretto, oppure è scaduto. Controllalo, o fattene inviare uno nuovo.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect, or it has expired. Check it, or have a new one sent to you.

auth.error.code_incomplete.text: Inserisci tutte e 6 le cifre del codice.
auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Troppi codici richiesti. Aspetta qualche minuto e riprova.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes required. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.text: L’email non è disponibile in questo momento.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.back: The email is not available at the moment.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Non siamo riusciti a inviare l’email. Riprova tra un momento.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We were unable to send the email, please try again in a moment.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Questo browser non può usare le passkey.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Nessuna passkey è stata usata. Riprova quando vuoi.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No passkey has been used. Please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Quella passkey non è stata accettata. Accedi con un codice via email, poi aggiungi una nuova passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an email code, then add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: La passkey non ha funzionato. Riprova.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The passkey did not work, please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: Questo dispositivo ha già una passkey per il tuo account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a passkey for your account.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Non è stato possibile aggiungere quella passkey. Riprova.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Could not add that passkey. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: Questo account ha il numero massimo di passkey. Rimuovine prima una.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has the maximum number of passkeys, please remove one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Questa passkey è il tuo unico modo di accedere. Aggiungine un’altra prima di rimuoverla.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is your only way to log in, so add another one before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: Ci è voluto troppo tempo. Riprova.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: La tua sessione è terminata. Accedi di nuovo.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has expired, please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: Non siamo riusciti a raggiungere il server. Controlla la connessione e riprova.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: We were unable to reach the server, please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: Tre round, tre forme. Le tue carte decidono che cosa deve fare la tua strofa. L’avversario gira nel tuo browser: niente di ciò che scrivi lascia questo dispositivo.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three shapes – your cards decide what your stanza has to do. Your opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Ogni personaggio può salire in scena una volta. Reliquie e pozioni costano inchiostro.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can appear once. Relics and potions cost ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Attore: sceglie la migliore di due stesure
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: choose the best of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: Maestro: sceglie la migliore di tre stesure
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Teacher: choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: Verifico che cosa può far girare questo dispositivo…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: I check what can make this device run…

brain.kept.text: Scaricato una volta da Hugging Face e conservato dal tuo browser. Niente di ciò che scrivi o dici viene inviato altrove.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and stored in your browser, nothing you write or say is sent anywhere else.

brain.loaded.text: Il modello Gemma è caricato e gira su questo dispositivo.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: The Gemma model is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Il modello Gemma è caricato su questo dispositivo. È piccolo: giudica le strofe, e l’avversario recita strofe già scritte.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The Gemma model is loaded on this device, it’s small: it judges the verses, and the opponent recites already written verses.

brain.failed.text: Il modello non è riuscito ad avviarsi su questo dispositivo. Puoi comunque giocare contro l’avversario dalle strofe scritte.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model failed to start on this device, you can still play against the opponent from the written verses.

brain.written.text: Giochi contro l’avversario dalle strofe scritte.
brain.written.back: Play against the opponent from the written verses.

brain.noWebgpu.text: Questo browser non ha WebGPU, quindi l’avversario recita strofe già scritte e si giudica secondo regole. Tutto il resto funziona.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser does not have WebGPU, so the opponent recites already written verses and judges according to rules.Everything else works.

brain.canRun.text: Questo dispositivo può far girare Gemma nel browser. La prima volta sono 3,1 GB da scaricare, poi resta salvato.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in the browser.The first time are 3.1 GB to download, then it remains saved.

brain.summonLighter.text: Evoca Gemma (3,1 GB): un download più leggero
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download
brain.summonLighter.back: Evoca Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: Giochi contro l’avversario dalle strofe scritte. Puoi evocare il modello quando vuoi ricaricando la pagina.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You play against the opponent from the written verses.You can evoke the pattern whenever you want by reloading the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: Grida: chiudi un verso con un punto esclamativo.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Scream: close a verse with an exclamation point.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet ti lancia la maledizione Ariel. Nessuna tua parola può avere più di 5 lettere.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet casts the Ariel curse on you. No word can have more than 5 letters.

round.items.text: Reliquie e pozioni (1 di inchiostro ciascuna)

round.seedNote.back: The same seed and the same deck draw the same shapes.

hand.curses.text: Maledice il tuo avversario. Nessuna tua parola può avere più di 5 lettere.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curse your opponent. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet lends you: skull, mockery and tomb.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet maledice la prossima strofa del tuo avversario. Nessuna tua parola può avere più di 5 lettere.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet maledirebbe la prossima strofa dell’avversario, ma questo è l’ultimo round.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet would curse the opponent’s next stanza, but this is the last round.

live.device.back: Ariel (+½ craft): Scream: End a verse with an exclamation point.

theatre.intro.text: Lo stesso duello, su un palco intorno a te. Punta o pizzica per giocare una carta, premi il microfono e recita la tua strofa. Viene trascritta e giudicata su questo dispositivo.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and recite your verse, which is transcribed and judged on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Si apre in passthrough, così il palco sta nella tua stanza. Punta un controller o pizzica con la mano.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: It opens in passthrough, so the stage is in your room.Point a controller or pinch with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: Si apre come un palco completo. Guarda una carta e pizzica. Safari su visionOS non offre il passthrough alle pagine web.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: It opens up like a full stage. Look at a map and pinch.Safari on visionOS doesn’t offer passthrough to web pages.

theatre.screenBody.text: Fai clic sulle carte e sui pulsanti del palco, e parla o scrivi.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or write.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: Giochi contro l’avversario dalle strofe scritte. Evoca un modello nella pagina della battaglia per affrontarlo qui.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: Play against the opponent from the written verses.Conjure a pattern in the battle page to face it here.

theatre.enterAr.text: Entra: il palco nella tua stanza
theatre.enterAr.back: Enter: the stage in your room

theatre.declined.text: Questo dispositivo ha rifiutato la sessione immersiva.
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This device has refused the immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: Non è stato possibile avviare la sessione nel visore.
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: The session could not be started in the headset.

theatre.judgedModel.text: Giudicato da Gemma su questo dispositivo.
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Reviewed by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: Giudicato secondo regole: nessun modello è in funzione.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Judged by rules: no model is in operation.

theatre.pick.text: Scegli un personaggio dalla tua mano.
theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: Ti maledice. Nessuna tua parola può avere più di 5 lettere.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: It curses you. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Qui compare la tua strofa. Premi il microfono e recitala, un verso per respiro.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and recite it, one verse per breath.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: Quatro versos: os dois primeiros rimam, e os dois últimos também.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four verses: the first two rhyme, and the last two too.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Quatro versos: o 1 rima com o 3, o 2 com o 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four verses: 1 rhymes with 3, 2 rhymes with 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: Três versos; o primeiro e o último rimam.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three verses; the first and last rhyme.

form.anaphora.brief.text: Três versos que começam todos com a mesma palavra.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three verses that all begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: Três versos que começam todos com o mesmo caractere.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three verses that all begin with the same character.

form.acrostic.brief.text: Um verso por letra: as iniciais devem formar caveira.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One verse per letter: the initials should form a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: Um verso por palavra: os versos devem começar, em ordem, com caveira.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One verse per word: the verses must begin, in order, with skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: Três versos, cada um mais longo que o anterior.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three verses, each longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: Três versos que terminam todos com a mesma palavra.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three verses that all end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Três versos que terminam todos com o mesmo caractere.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three verses that all end with the same character.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Três versos de 5, 7 e 5 sons. Escreva em kana para que possam ser contados.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three verses of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so they can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Dois versos rimados de cerca de dez sílabas cada, como Shakespeare fechava seus sonetos.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhymed verses of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Quatro versos, todos de cinco caracteres ou todos de sete: o formato da quadra clássica chinesa.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four verses, all of five characters or all of seven: the format of the classical Chinese square.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Um verso de seis sílabas e depois um de oito cuja sexta sílaba rima com o fim do primeiro.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A verse of six syllables and then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.

check.same-opening.text: Todos os versos começam com a mesma palavra
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All the verses start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: Todos os versos começam com o mesmo caractere
