battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three ways – your cards decide what your stanza needs to do. Your opponent is running in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Cada personagem pode subir ao palco uma vez. Relíquias e poções custam tinta.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can step on stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Ator: escolhe o melhor de dois rascunhos
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: choose the best of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: Mestre: escolhe o melhor de três rascunhos
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: Verificando o que este dispositivo consegue rodar…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: Baixado uma vez do Hugging Face e guardado pelo seu navegador. Nada do que você escreve ou diz é enviado a lugar nenhum.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and saved by your browser, nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: O modelo Gemma está carregado e rodando neste dispositivo.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: The Gemma model is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: O modelo Gemma está carregado neste dispositivo. Ele é pequeno: julga as estrofes, e o adversário recita estrofes já escritas.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The model Gemma is loaded on this device.It is small: it judges the stanzas, and the opponent recites already written stanzas.

brain.failed.text: O modelo não conseguiu iniciar neste dispositivo. Você ainda pode jogar contra o adversário de estrofes escritas.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not start on this device.You can still play against the opponent of written stanzas.

brain.written.text: Jogando contra o adversário de estrofes escritas.
brain.written.back: Playing against the opponent of written stanzas.

brain.noWebgpu.text: Este navegador não tem WebGPU, então o adversário recita estrofes já escritas e o julgamento é por regras. Todo o resto funciona.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser does not have WebGPU, so the opponent recites already written stanzas and judgment is by rules.Everything else works.

brain.canRun.text: Este dispositivo consegue rodar Gemma no navegador. São 3,1 GB para baixar na primeira vez; depois fica guardado.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in the browser.There are 3.1 GB to download the first time; then it is saved.

brain.summonLighter.text: Invocar Gemma (3,1 GB): um download mais leve
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download
brain.summonLighter.back: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: Jogando contra o adversário de estrofes escritas. Você pode invocar o modelo quando quiser, recarregando a página.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: Playing against the opponent of written stanzas.You can invoke the model whenever you want by reloading the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: Brade: termine um verso com um ponto de exclamação.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Brade: End a verse with an exclamation point.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet lança sobre você a maldição Ariel. Nenhuma palavra sua pode ter mais de 5 letras.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet casts on you the curse Ariel. No word of yours can be more than 5 letters.

round.items.text: Relíquias e poções (1 de tinta cada)

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…

round.mustDo.text: O que a sua estrofe precisa fazer
round.mustDo.back: What your stanza needs to do

round.seedNote.text: A mesma semente e o mesmo baralho sorteiam as mesmas formas.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: The same seed and the same deck draw the same shapes.

hand.curses.text: Amaldiçoa seu adversário. Nenhuma palavra sua pode ter mais de 5 letras.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curse your opponent. No word of yours can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet empresta a você: caveira, gracejo e túmulo.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet lends you: skull, prank and tomb.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet amaldiçoa a próxima estrofe do seu adversário. Nenhuma palavra sua pode ter mais de 5 letras.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses his opponent's next stanza. No word of yours can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet amaldiçoaria a próxima estrofe do adversário, mas esta é a última rodada.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet would curse the opponent’s next stanza, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.text: Esse personagem não está no seu baralho.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: This character is not in your deck.

illegal.character-used.text: Cada personagem pode subir ao palco uma vez por partida.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Each character can take the stage once per match.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.text: Essa relíquia não está no seu baralho.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: This relic is not in your deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.text: Essa poção não está no seu baralho.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.back: This potion is not in your deck.

illegal.relic-spent.back: This relic has already been spent.

illegal.potion-spent.back: This potion has already been spent.

live.device.text: Ariel (+½ de ofício): Brade: termine um verso com um ponto de exclamação.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (+½ craft): Brade: End a verse with an exclamation point.

live.signature.text: Assinatura (+½ de ofício): ecoe a fala de Hamlet sem citá-la
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (+½ craft): Echo Hamlet's speech without quoting it

live.power.text: Palavras de poder (+2): use duas entre caveira, gracejo e túmulo
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Power words (+2): use two between skull, prank and tomb

signature.none.text: esta carta não tem fala de assinatura
signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: this letter has no signature speech

signature.hint.text: ecoe uma destas: caveira, gracejo e túmulo
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: echoes one of these: skull, prank and tomb

signature.quoted.text: citada ao pé da letra; um eco precisa ser um verso seu
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: quoted to the letter; an echo must be a verse of yours

mic.heardNothing.text: Não ouvi nada; tente de novo
mic.heardNothing.back: I didn't hear anything; try again

mic.loadingEar.text: Carregando o ouvido (75 MB, uma única vez)…

verdict.judgedCompare.text: Julgado por Gemma neste dispositivo, lendo as estrofes nas duas ordens.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the stanzas in both orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: Julgado por Gemma neste dispositivo, dando nota a cada estrofe em separado.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Judged by Gemma on this device, giving a note to each stanza separately.

verdict.judgedRules.text: Julgado por regras (variedade, alusão, som e réplica), porque nenhum modelo está rodando.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: Judged by rules (variety, allusion, sound and replica), because no model is running.

end.lost.text: Esta noite o palco é deles.

badge.writtenJudged.text: Adversário de estrofes escritas · julgado por Gemma
badge.writtenJudged.back: of stanzas written · judged by Gemma

theatre.intro.text: O mesmo duelo, em um palco ao seu redor. Aponte ou pince para jogar uma carta, aperte o microfone e diga sua estrofe. Ela é transcrita e julgada neste dispositivo.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on a stage all around you. Point or pinch to roll a card, squeeze the microphone and say your stanza, which is transcribed and judged on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Abre em passthrough, então o palco fica no seu cômodo. Aponte um controle ou pince com a mão.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: Opens in passthrough, so the stage is in your room.Point a control or pinch with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: Abre como um palco completo. Olhe para uma carta e pince. O Safari no visionOS não oferece passthrough a páginas da web.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Look at a letter and pinch. Safari on visionOS doesn’t offer passthrough to web pages, so you don’t have to do anything else.

theatre.screenBody.text: Clique nas cartas e nos botões do palco, e fale ou digite.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.
theatre.running.back: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: Jogando contra o adversário de estrofes escritas. Invoque um modelo na página de batalha para enfrentá-lo aqui.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: Playing against the opponent of written stanzas Summon a template on the battle page to face it here.

theatre.declined.text: Este dispositivo recusou a sessão imersiva.
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This device refused the immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: Não foi possível iniciar a sessão no headset.
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: Could not log in to the headset.

theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Reviewed by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: Julgado por regras: nenhum modelo está rodando.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Judged by rules: no model is running.

theatre.pick.text: Escolha um personagem da sua mão.
theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: Amaldiçoa você. Nenhuma palavra sua pode ter mais de 5 letras.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: It curses you. No word of yours can have more than 5 letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Sua estrofe aparece aqui. Aperte o microfone e diga-a, um verso por fôlego.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your stanza appears here. Snap the microphone and say it, one verse per breath.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: Cztery wersy: rymują się dwa pierwsze i rymują się dwa ostatnie.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four verses: the first two rhyme and the last two rhyme.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Cztery wersy: 1 rymuje się z 3, a 2 z 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four verses: 1 rhymes with 3, and 2 with 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: Trzy wersy; rymują się pierwszy i ostatni.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three verses; the first and last rhyme.

form.anaphora.brief.text: Trzy wersy, które zaczynają się tym samym słowem.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three verses that begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: Trzy wersy, które zaczynają się tym samym znakiem.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three verses that begin with the same sign.

form.acrostic.brief.text: Jeden wers na literę: pierwsze litery muszą ułożyć słowo czaszka.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One verse per letter: the first letters must arrange the word skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: Jeden wers na słowo; wersy muszą zaczynać się kolejno od słów: czaszka.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One verse per word; the verses must begin with the words: skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: Trzy wersy, każdy dłuższy od poprzedniego.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three verses, each longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: Trzy wersy, które kończą się tym samym słowem.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three verses that end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Trzy wersy, które kończą się tym samym znakiem.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three verses that end with the same sign.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Trzy wersy: 5, 7 i 5 dźwięków. Pisz kaną, żeby dało się je policzyć.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three verses: 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so they can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Dwa rymowane wersy po mniej więcej dziesięć sylab, tak jak Szekspir zamykał swoje sonety.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhymed verses of about ten syllables, as Shakespeare used to close his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Cztery wersy, wszystkie po pięć znaków albo wszystkie po siedem: kształt klasycznego chińskiego czterowiersza.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four verses, all five characters or all seven: the shape of a classical Chinese four-letter word.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Wers sześciosylabowy, a po nim ośmiosylabowy, którego szósta sylaba rymuje się z końcem pierwszego.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A six-syllable verse, followed by an eight-syllable one, whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.

check.same-opening.text: Każdy wers zaczyna się tym samym słowem
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: Each verse begins with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: Każdy wers zaczyna się tym samym znakiem
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: Each verse begins with the same character

check.same-ending.text: Każdy wers kończy się tym samym słowem
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: Each verse ends with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: Każdy wers kończy się tym samym znakiem
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: Each verse ends with the same character

check.spells.back: First letters make up the word skull

check.spells.words.text: Wersy zaczynają się kolejno od słów: czaszka
check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: Verses begin with the words: skull

check.growing.text: Każdy wers ma więcej słów niż poprzedni
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each verse has more words than the previous

check.growing.char.text: Każdy wers ma więcej znaków niż poprzedni
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each verse has more characters than the previous one

check.jueju-length.text: Każdy wers ma pięć znaków albo każdy ma siedem
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: Each verse has five characters or each one has seven

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: Szósta sylaba obu wersów się rymuje
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: The sixth syllable of both verses rhymes

device.question.brief.text: Zadaj pytanie: zakończ wers znakiem zapytania.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: end the verse with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Zawołaj: end the verse with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: Zacznij trzy słowa w jednym wersie tą samą literą.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words in one verse with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: Powtórz trzy razy jedno mocne słowo.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat one strong word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: Zrymuj dwa słowa wewnątrz jednego wersu.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Rhyme two words within one verse.

device.riposte.brief.text: Obróć przeciw rywalowi słowo z jego ostatniej strofy, które ma co najmniej 3 litery.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Turn against your opponent a word from his last stanza that has at least 3 letters.

device.brevity.brief.text: Żaden wers nie może mieć więcej niż 3 słowa.
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: No verse can have more than 3 words.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: Żaden wers nie może mieć więcej niż 3 znaki.
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: No verse can have more than 3 characters.

device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Let the last verse be the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: Daj każdemu wersowi tyle samo słów.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Give each verse the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: Daj każdemu wersowi tyle samo znaków.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Give each verse the same number of characters.

device.ring.brief.text: Zakończ strofę tym samym słowem, którym się zaczęła.
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End the stanza with the same word it began with.

device.ring.brief.char.text: Zakończ strofę tym samym znakiem, którym się zaczęła.
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End the stanza with the same character as it began.

device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: Użyj dwóch słów, z których każde ma co najmniej 3 litery.
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words, each with at least 3 letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: Zakończ każdy wers tym samym rymem.
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: End each verse with the same rhyme.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: W twojej strofie nie może być litery O.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: There can't be an O in your verse.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: W strofie rywala nie może być litery O.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: There can be no letter O in the rival's stanza.

curse.short-words.brief.text: Żadne twoje słowo nie może mieć więcej niż 3 litery.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: No one of your words can have more than 3 letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: Żadne słowo rywala nie może mieć więcej niż 3 litery.
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: No word of the opponent can have more than 3 letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: Nie możesz użyć dwa razy żadnego słowa, które ma co najmniej 3 litery.
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You cannot use any word that has at least 3 letters twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: Rywal nie może użyć dwa razy żadnego słowa, które ma co najmniej 3 litery.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: The opponent cannot use twice any word that has at least 3 letters.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: Żaden twój wers nie może mieć więcej niż 3 słowa.
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: No one of your verses can have more than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: Żaden twój wers nie może mieć więcej niż 3 znaki.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: No one of your verses can have more than 3 characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: Żaden wers rywala nie może mieć więcej niż 3 słowa.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: No opponent's verse can have more than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: Żaden wers rywala nie może mieć więcej niż 3 znaki.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: No rival verse can have more than 3 characters.

house.montague.why.text: Cięty język Merkucja rymuje w pół wersu.
house.montague.why.back: The cut tongue of Mercutio rhymes in half a verse.

house.verona-court.why.text: Dwór waży każde słowo wypowiedziane przeciw tobie.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word spoken against you.

house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm gets bigger until it breaks.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Man jedzie na jednym rymie do samego końca.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: Sonnet Man goes on one rhyme to the very end.

house.gothic-circle.why.text: Opowieść kończy się tam, gdzie się zaczęła.
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: Gods speak with words like thunder.

house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember every word you say.

nav.toggleAudio.back: Turn on or mute the sound

footer.tagline.text: Cyfrowe karty kolekcjonerskie napędzane SI i rozszerzoną rzeczywistością. Interaktywne doświadczenia, które ożywiają Szekspira.
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital trading cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.

age.intro.text: Potwierdź swój wiek, aby przejść dalej.
age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Please select a full date of birth.

age.minorTitle.back: You do not meet the age requirement

age.minorBody.text: Aby korzystać z Inspired Mile, trzeba mieć co najmniej 13 lat. Wróć, gdy spełnisz ten wymóg.
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile, please come back when you meet this requirement.

age.teenBody.text: Ponieważ nie masz jeszcze 18 lat, do korzystania z Inspired Mile potrzebujesz zgody rodzica lub opiekuna.
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: As you are under the age of 18, you need permission from a parent or guardian to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.text: Potwierdzam, że mój rodzic lub opiekun prawny zapoznał się z dokumentami:
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the
age.consentBefore.back: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has read the documents:

age.consentAfter.text: i zgadza się na moje korzystanie z Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: and agrees to my use of Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our
age.agreeBefore.back: By continuing, you accept the documents:

migrate.body.text: Znaleźliśmy postępy zapisane na tym urządzeniu. Zsynchronizuj je z kontem, aby mieć je na wszystkich urządzeniach.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We found progress saved on this device, please sync it with your account to have it on all your devices.

migrate.failed.text: Synchronizacja się nie powiodła. Możesz spróbować później.
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Synchronization failed. You can try again later.

pwa.install.text: Zainstaluj Inspired Mile, żeby grało się najlepiej
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best gaming experience

offline.banner.text: Jesteś offline: Kolekcja i Quiz nadal działają. Gra wieloosobowa wymaga internetu.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: Collection and Quiz still work. Multiplayer requires internet connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: Żadnego hasła do zapamiętania. Klucz dostępu loguje cię odciskiem palca, twarzą albo blokadą ekranu.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No password to remember. The passkey logs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Ta przeglądarka nie obsługuje kluczy dostępu. Zaloguj się kodem wysłanym e-mailem.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: Your browser does not support access keys. Log in with the code sent by email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Ta przeglądarka nie obsługuje kluczy dostępu, a ta strona loguje właśnie nimi. Spróbuj w aktualnej wersji Chrome, Safari, Edge lub Firefoksa.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser does not support access keys, and this site is logging in with them.Try the current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with access key

auth.createIntro.text: Twoje konto to klucz dostępu zapisany na tym urządzeniu albo w menedżerze haseł. Nie prosimy o imię, e-mail ani hasło.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is the access key stored on this device or in your password manager, and we don’t ask for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Jeśli stracisz klucz dostępu, nie będziemy mogli cię wpuścić. Zaraz potem dodaj drugi klucz albo e-mail, żeby móc wrócić.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your access key, we won't be able to let you in.Add a second key or email immediately afterwards so that you can come back.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Jeśli stracisz klucz dostępu, nie będziemy mogli cię wpuścić. Zaraz potem dodaj drugi klucz, żeby móc wrócić.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your access key, we won't be able to let you in.

auth.nudgeBody.text: W tej chwili jedyną drogą do tego konta jest jeden klucz dostępu. Jeśli przepadnie, przepadnie konto. Dodaj drugi klucz albo e-mail, żeby móc wrócić.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: At the moment, the only way to access this account is with one access key. If it expires, your account will be lost, so please add a second key or email to get back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: W tej chwili jedyną drogą do tego konta jest jeden klucz dostępu. Jeśli przepadnie, przepadnie konto. Dodaj drugi klucz, żeby móc wrócić.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: At the moment, the only way to access this account is with one key. If it expires, your account will be lost, so add a second key to get back.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Użyj innego urządzenia, menedżera haseł albo klucza bezpieczeństwa.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use a different device, password manager or security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Jeden klucz dostępu to twoja jedyna droga do konta. Dodaj drugi klucz albo e-mail, żeby móc wrócić.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: One access key is your only way to access your account, so add a second key or email to get back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Jeden klucz dostępu to twoja jedyna droga do konta. Dodaj drugi klucz, żeby móc wrócić.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: One access key is your only way to access your account, so add a second key to get back.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Wysłaliśmy 6-cyfrowy kod na adres a@example.com. Wpisz go, aby potwierdzić, że adres należy do ciebie.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, enter it to confirm that the address belongs to you.

auth.addEmailDone.text: E-mail dodany. Możesz teraz logować się kodem wysyłanym na ten adres.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email added. You can now log in with the code sent to this address.

auth.emailButton.back: Send me the code by email

auth.emailHint.text: Jesteś na urządzeniu bez swojego klucza dostępu? Zaloguj się e-mailem, jeśli twoje konto go ma.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Are you on a device without your passkey? Sign in with email if your account has one.

auth.emailIntro.text: Wyślemy ci 6-cyfrowy kod. Jeśli adres jest nowy, kod założy twoje konto.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit code, which will create your account if the address is new.

auth.emailSend.back: Send me the code by email

auth.codeIntro.text: Wysłaliśmy 6-cyfrowy kod na adres a@example.com. Działa raz i wygasa po 10 minutach.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, it works once and expires after 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Nowy kod jest w drodze. Stary już nie działa.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: The new code is on its way, the old one no longer works.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By logging in, you accept the documents:

auth.offerHeading.text: Dodaj klucz dostępu do tego urządzenia
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add access key to this device

auth.offerBody.text: Następnym razem zaloguj się odciskiem palca, twarzą albo blokadą ekranu. Bez kodu i bez czekania na e-mail.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock – no code and no waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Nie masz jeszcze kluczy dostępu. Dodaj jeden, aby logować się bez kodu z e-maila.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: You don't have access keys yet. Add one to log in without the code from your email.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Klucz dostępu dodany. Od teraz możesz się nim logować.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: Access key added. From now on you can log in with it.

auth.error.age_required.text: Najpierw potwierdź swój wiek na stronie głównej. Konta są dla graczy od 13 lat.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: First confirm your age on the homepage. Accounts are for players over 13 years old.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Ten adres należy już do innego konta. Wyloguj się i zaloguj właśnie nim.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address already belongs to another account. Log out and log in with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: To konto ma już adres e-mail.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: To nie wygląda na adres e-mail.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Ten kod jest błędny albo wygasł. Sprawdź go lub wyślij nowy.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: This code is incorrect or has expired. Please check it or send a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Poproszono o zbyt wiele kodów. Odczekaj kilka minut i spróbuj ponownie.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.text: E-mail jest w tej chwili niedostępny.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Nie udało się wysłać e-maila. Spróbuj ponownie za chwilę.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: The email could not be sent, please try again in a moment.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Ta przeglądarka nie obsługuje kluczy dostępu.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: Your browser does not support access keys.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Nie użyto klucza dostępu. Spróbuj ponownie, kiedy zechcesz.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No access key was used. Please try again whenever you want.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Ten klucz dostępu nie został przyjęty. Zaloguj się kodem z e-maila, a potem dodaj nowy klucz.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: This access key has not been accepted. Sign in with the code from your email, then add a new key.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: Klucz dostępu nie zadziałał. Spróbuj ponownie.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The access key did not work, please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: To urządzenie ma już klucz dostępu do twojego konta.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has the key to your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: Ten klucz dostępu jest już zarejestrowany.
auth.error.passkey_already_registered.back: This access key is already registered.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Nie udało się dodać tego klucza dostępu. Spróbuj ponownie.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Unable to add this access key. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: To konto ma już największą możliwą liczbę kluczy dostępu. Najpierw usuń jeden.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account already has the maximum number of access keys. Delete one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Ten klucz dostępu to twój jedyny sposób logowania. Zanim go usuniesz, dodaj inny.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This access key is your only way to sign in, so add another before you delete it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: To trwało zbyt długo. Spróbuj ponownie.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long, please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: Twoja sesja się zakończyła. Zaloguj się ponownie.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: Nie udało się połączyć z serwerem. Sprawdź połączenie i spróbuj ponownie.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: Coś poszło nie tak. Spróbuj ponownie.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: Trzy rundy, trzy formy. Twoje karty decydują, co ma zrobić twoja strofa. Rywal działa w twojej przeglądarce: nic z tego, co piszesz, nie opuszcza tego urządzenia.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three forms, your cards decide what to do with your stanza. The Rival runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves that device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Każda postać może wyjść na scenę raz. Relikwie i mikstury kosztują atrament.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can come on stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Aktor: wybiera lepszy z dwóch szkiców
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: chooses the better of two sketches

battle.difficulty.master.text: Mistrz: wybiera najlepszy z trzech szkiców
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: chooses the best of three sketches

battle.noWorldCard.back: Without a map of the world

brain.checking.text: Sprawdzam, co to urządzenie potrafi uruchomić…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: I'm checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: Pobierane raz z Hugging Face i przechowywane przez przeglądarkę. Nic z tego, co piszesz lub mówisz, nie jest nigdzie wysyłane.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and stored by your browser, nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Model Gemma jest wczytany i działa na tym urządzeniu.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: The Gemma model is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Model Gemma jest wczytany na tym urządzeniu. Jest mały: ocenia strofy, a rywal gra gotowymi strofami.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The model Gemma is loaded on this device.It is small: it evaluates the stanzas, and the rival plays the ready-made stanzas.

brain.failed.text: Model nie zdołał się uruchomić na tym urządzeniu. Nadal możesz grać z rywalem, który ma gotowe strofy.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model failed to run on this device.You can still play with a rival who has ready stanzas.

brain.written.text: Grasz z rywalem, który ma gotowe strofy.
brain.written.back: You play against a rival who has ready verses.

brain.noWebgpu.text: Ta przeglądarka nie ma WebGPU, więc rywal gra gotowymi strofami, a ocena odbywa się według reguł. Cała reszta działa.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser does not have a WebGPU, so the rival plays with ready-made stanzas, and the evaluation is carried out according to the rules.

brain.canRun.text: To urządzenie może uruchomić model Gemma w przeglądarce. Za pierwszym razem trzeba pobrać 3,1 GB; potem zostaje na urządzeniu.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in a browser, the first time you need to download 3.1 GB; after that it stays on your device.

brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: Grasz z rywalem, który ma gotowe strofy. Model możesz przywołać w każdej chwili, odświeżając stronę.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You play against a rival who has ready stanzas.You can call up the model at any time by refreshing the page.

round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Call: end the verse with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet rzuca na ciebie klątwę Ariel. Żadne twoje słowo nie może mieć więcej niż 5 liter.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet casts a curse on you, Ariel. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

round.composingDraft.back: Hamlet composes a stanza… sketch 3 of 3

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…

round.mustDo.back: What is your stanza supposed to do

round.seedNote.text: To samo ziarno i ta sama talia losują te same formy.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: The same grain and the same deck draw the same forms.

hand.curses.text: Rzuca klątwę na rywala. Żadne twoje słowo nie może mieć więcej niż 5 liter.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Throw a curse on your opponent. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet użycza ci słów: czaszka, żart i grób.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet lends you the words: skull, joke and grave.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet rzuca klątwę na następną strofę rywala. Żadne twoje słowo nie może mieć więcej niż 5 liter.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.

theatre.intro.text: Ten sam pojedynek, na scenie wokół ciebie. Wskaż albo uszczypnij palcami, aby zagrać kartę, naciśnij mikrofon i wygłoś strofę. Jest zapisywana i oceniana na tym urządzeniu.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on the stage all around you. Point or pinch your fingers to play a card, press the microphone and speak a verse, which is recorded and scored on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Otwiera się w trybie przezroczystym, więc scena stoi w twoim pokoju. Wskaż kontrolerem albo uszczypnij dłonią.

theatre.questBody.back: It opens in transparent mode, so the scene stands in your room.

theatre.visionBody.back: It opens as a full scene. Look at the tab and pinch your fingers. Safari on visionOS doesn’t make pages transparent.

theatre.screenBody.text: Klikaj karty i przyciski na scenie, mów albo pisz.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click cards and buttons on the stage, speak or type.

theatre.running.back: The model Gemma works on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.back: You play against a rival who has ready stanzas, summon the model on the battle page to face him here.

theatre.versePrompt.back: Press the microphone and sing it, one verse at a time.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines: rhyme the first two and rhyme the last two.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Четыре строки: первая рифмуется с третьей, вторая с четвёртой.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four lines: the first rhymes with the third, the second with the fourth.

form.tercet.brief.text: Три строки; рифмуются первая и последняя.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.

form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three lines, and they all start with the same character.

form.acrostic.brief.words.back: By line by word: Lines should start with the words skull in order.

form.crescendo.brief.back: Three lines, each longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three lines, and they all end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Три строки, и все кончаются одним и тем же знаком.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines, and they all end with the same sign.

form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so they can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhymed lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare ended his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines, all five characters or all seven: the appearance of a classical Chinese quatrain.

form.luc-bat.brief.back: A line of six syllables, then eight, the sixth syllable rhyming with the end of the first.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Rhyme two words in one line.

device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words, each at least 3 letters long.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: Закончи все строки на одну и ту же рифму.
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Finish all the lines on the same rhyme.

curse.short-lines.brief.back: None of your lines can be longer than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.back: No line of the opponent can be longer than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: No string of the opponent can be longer than 3 characters.

offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: No Network: Collection and Quiz are working. Internet is required for online play.

auth.signInIntro.text: Пароль запоминать не нужно. Ключ доступа впускает по отпечатку пальца, лицу или блокировке экрана.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No need to remember the password. The access key enters by fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Этот браузер не умеет работать с ключами доступа. Войди по коду из письма.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: Your browser does not support access keys. Please enter the code from your email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Этот браузер не умеет работать с ключами доступа, а на этом сайте вход только по ним. Попробуй свежую версию Chrome, Safari, Edge или Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser does not work with access keys, and on this site login only by them. Try a fresh version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.text: Создать учётную запись с ключом доступа
auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: Твоя учётная запись — это ключ доступа, сохранённый на этом устройстве или в менеджере паролей. Мы не спрашиваем ни имени, ни почты, ни пароля.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is the access key stored on that device or in a password manager. We don’t ask for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Если ключ доступа потеряется, мы не сможем тебя впустить. Сразу после этого добавь второй ключ или почту, чтобы можно было вернуться.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If the access key is lost, we will not be able to let you in. Immediately afterwards add a second key or email so that you can come back.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Если ключ доступа потеряется, мы не сможем тебя впустить. Сразу после этого добавь второй ключ, чтобы можно было вернуться.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If the access key is lost, we won't be able to let you in. Immediately afterwards add a second key so that you can return.

auth.nudgeBody.text: Сейчас в эту учётную запись ведёт один-единственный ключ доступа. Потеряется он — потеряется и она. Добавь второй ключ или почту, чтобы можно было вернуться.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: There is only one access key to this account at the moment. If you lose it, it will be lost too. Add a second key or email so that you can get back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Сейчас в эту учётную запись ведёт один-единственный ключ доступа. Потеряется он — потеряется и она. Добавь второй ключ, чтобы можно было вернуться.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: There's only one access key to this account right now. If you lose it, you'll lose it too. Add a second key so you can get back.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Возьми другое устройство, менеджер паролей или ключ безопасности.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Take another device, password manager or security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Один ключ доступа — твой единственный вход. Добавь второй ключ или почту, чтобы можно было вернуться.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: One access key is your only login. Add a second key or email so you can come back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Один ключ доступа — твой единственный вход. Добавь второй ключ, чтобы можно было вернуться.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: One access key is your only entry. Add a second key so you can return.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Мы отправили код из 6 цифр на a@example.com. Введи его, чтобы подтвердить, что адрес твой.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to verify that the address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: Почта добавлена. Теперь можно входить по коду, отправленному на неё.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: The mail has been added. You can now log in with the code sent to it.

auth.emailHint.text: На этом устройстве нет твоего ключа доступа? Войди по почте, если она есть в учётной записи.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Don't have your passkey on this device? Sign in with email if it is in the account.

auth.emailIntro.text: Мы пришлём код из 6 цифр. Если адрес новый, код создаст учётную запись.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We will send you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code will create an account.

auth.codeIntro.text: Мы отправили код из 6 цифр на a@example.com. Он действует один раз и истекает через 10 минут.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It is valid once and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Новый код уже в пути. Старый больше не действует.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: The new code is on its way. The old one is no longer valid.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: When you enter, you accept documents:

auth.offerHeading.text: Добавь ключ доступа на это устройство
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: В следующий раз войди по отпечатку пальца, лицу или блокировке экрана. Без кода и без ожидания письма.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No code and no waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Ключей доступа пока нет. Добавь один, чтобы входить без кода из письма.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There are no access keys yet. Add one to log in without the code from the email.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Ключ доступа добавлен. Теперь можно входить по нему.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: The access key has been added. You can now log in with it.

auth.error.age_required.text: Сначала подтверди возраст на главной странице. Учётные записи доступны игрокам от 13 лет.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: First, verify your age on the home page. Accounts are available to players aged 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Этот адрес уже принадлежит другой учётной записи. Выйди и войди с ним.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address already belongs to another account. Log out and log in with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: В этой учётной записи уже есть адрес почты.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: Это не похоже на адрес электронной почты.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It's not like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Код неверный или истёк. Проверь его или запроси новый.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect or expired. Please check it or request a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Запрошено слишком много кодов. Подожди несколько минут и попробуй снова.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Не удалось отправить письмо. Попробуй ещё раз чуть позже.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Этот браузер не умеет работать с ключами доступа.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: Your browser does not support access keys.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Ключ доступа не был использован. Попробуй снова, когда будет удобно.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: The access key has not been used. Please try again at a later time.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Этот ключ доступа не принят. Войди по коду из письма, а затем добавь новый ключ.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: This access key has not been accepted. Please enter the code from the email and then add a new key.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: Ключ доступа не сработал. Попробуй ещё раз.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The access key failed. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: На этом устройстве уже есть ключ доступа к твоей учётной записи.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a passkey for your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.back: This access key is already registered.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Не удалось добавить этот ключ доступа. Попробуй ещё раз.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Could not add this access key. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: В этой учётной записи уже предельное число ключей доступа. Сначала удали один.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has the maximum number of access keys. Please delete one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Этот ключ доступа — твой единственный способ входа. Добавь другой, прежде чем удалять его.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This access key is your only way to sign in. Add another one before deleting it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: Это заняло слишком много времени. Попробуй ещё раз.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long, please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: Не удалось связаться с сервером. Проверь соединение и попробуй ещё раз.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Could not connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: Что-то пошло не так. Попробуй ещё раз.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: Something went wrong, please try again.

battle.intro.text: Три раунда, три формы. Твои карты решают, что должна сделать твоя строфа. Соперник работает в твоём браузере: ничто из написанного не покидает это устройство.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three shapes. Your cards decide what your stanza should do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves that device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Каждый персонаж выходит на сцену один раз. Реликвии и зелья стоят чернил.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character comes on stage once. Relics and potions are worth ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Актёр: выбирает лучший из двух черновиков
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: chooses the best of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: Мастер: выбирает лучший из трёх черновиков
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: selects the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: Проверяю, что может запустить это устройство…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what can start this device…

brain.kept.text: Загружается один раз с Hugging Face и хранится в браузере. Ничто из того, что ты пишешь или говоришь, никуда не отправляется.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Loads once with Hugging Face and is stored in your browser. Nothing of what you type or say goes anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Модель Gemma загружена и работает на этом устройстве.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: The Gemma model is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Модель Gemma загружена на этом устройстве. Она мала: судит строфы, а соперник читает готовые строфы.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The model Gemma is loaded on this device. She is small: judges the verses, and the opponent reads the finished verses.

brain.failed.text: Модель не смогла запуститься на этом устройстве. Играть всё равно можно: с соперником, у которого готовые строфы.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not start on this device. You can still play: with an opponent who has ready stanzas.

brain.written.text: Ты играешь с соперником, у которого готовые строфы.
brain.written.back: You're playing with an opponent who has ready verses.

brain.noWebgpu.text: В этом браузере нет WebGPU, поэтому соперник читает готовые строфы, а судят по правилам. Всё остальное работает.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: In this browser there is no WebGPU, so the opponent reads ready verses, and judge by the rules. Everything else works.

brain.canRun.text: Это устройство может запустить модель Gemma в браузере. В первый раз нужно загрузить 3,1 GB, потом она хранится.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run the Gemma model in the browser. The first time you need to load 3.1 GB, then it is stored.

brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: Ты играешь с соперником, у которого готовые строфы. Модель можно призвать в любой момент, обновив страницу.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You play against an opponent who has ready verses. The model can be summoned at any time by refreshing the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: Воскликни: закончи строку восклицательным знаком.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Exclamation: End the line with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet налагает на тебя проклятие «Ariel». Ни одно твоё слово не может быть длиннее 5 букв.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet puts the curse "Ariel" on you. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

round.versePlaceholder.text: По одной строке стиха в строке…
round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…
round.versePlaceholder.back: One line of verse in a row…

round.seedNote.text: То же зерно и та же колода дают те же формы.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: The same grain and the same deck give the same shapes.

hand.lends.text: Даёт слова: череп, шутка и могила
hand.lends.back: Gives words: skull, joke and grave

hand.curses.text: Проклинает соперника. Ни одно твоё слово не может быть длиннее 5 букв.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curses the opponent. No word can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet даёт тебе слова: череп, шутка и могила.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet gives you the words: skull, joke and grave.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet проклинает следующую строфу соперника. Ни одно твоё слово не может быть длиннее 5 букв.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses the next stanza of your opponent. No word can be longer than five letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet: проклятие легло бы на следующую строфу соперника, но это последний раунд.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet: The curse would fall on the opponent's next stanza, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.text: Этого персонажа нет в твоей колоде.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: This character is not in your deck.

illegal.character-used.text: Каждый персонаж выходит на сцену один раз за матч.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Each character appears on stage once per match.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.text: Этой реликвии нет в твоей колоде.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: That relic isn't in your deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.text: Этого зелья нет в твоей колоде.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.back: That potion's not in your deck.

illegal.relic-spent.back: This relic has already been spent.

illegal.potion-spent.back: This potion has already been spent.

live.device.text: Ariel (+½ мастерства): Воскликни: закончи строку восклицательным знаком.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (+½ skill): Exclamation: End the line with an exclamation mark.

live.signature.text: Подпись (+½ мастерства): отзовись на реплику персонажа Hamlet, не цитируя её
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (+½ skill): Reply to Hamlet's line without quoting it

live.power.text: Слова силы (+2): используй два из них: череп, шутка и могила
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Power Words (+2): Use two of them: Skull, Joke and Tomb

signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: This card has no signature replica

signature.hint.text: отзовись на одно из слов: череп, шутка и могила
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: answer one of the words: skull, joke and grave

signature.quoted.text: процитировано дословно; отзвук должен быть твоей собственной строкой
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: quoted verbatim; the echo should be your own line

mic.heardNothing.text: Ничего не слышно; попробуй ещё раз
mic.heardNothing.back: I can't hear anything; try again

verdict.judgedCompare.text: Судила модель Gemma на этом устройстве: строфы прочитаны в обоих порядках.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Judged the model Gemma on this device: stanzas read in both orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: Судила модель Gemma на этом устройстве: каждая строфа оценена отдельно.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Judged the model Gemma on this device: each verse is judged separately.

verdict.judgedRules.text: Судили по правилам (разнообразие, аллюзия, звучание и ответный выпад), потому что модель не запущена.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: They were judged by the rules (variety, allusion, sound and response) because the model is not running.

end.lost.back: Today's scene is behind the opponent.

theatre.intro.back: The same duel, but on the stage around you. Point or pinch your fingers to play a card, click on the microphone and pronounce a verse. It is recognized and judged on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Открывается в сквозном режиме, так что сцена встаёт в твоей комнате. Укажи контроллером или сожми пальцы.

theatre.screenBody.back: Press the cards and buttons on stage, speak or type.

theatre.running.back: The model Gemma works on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.back: Judged by the rules: model not launched.

theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from the hand.
