theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: No word of yours can be longer than five letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Здесь появится твоя строфа. Нажми на микрофон и произнеси её, по строке на вдох.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your verse will appear here. Click on the microphone and say it, line by line on inhalation.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: أربعة أسطر: الأول والثاني على قافية، والثالث والرابع على قافية.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines: first and second in commas, third and fourth in commas.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: أربعة أسطر: السطر 1 يقفّي مع 3، والسطر 2 مع 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four lines: line 1 with 3, line 2 with 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: ثلاثة أسطر؛ الأول والأخير على قافية واحدة.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines; the first and last on a single line.

form.anaphora.brief.text: ثلاثة أسطر تبدأ كلها بالكلمة نفسها.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three lines that all start with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: ثلاثة أسطر تبدأ كلها بالحرف نفسه.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three lines that all start with the same letter.

form.acrostic.brief.text: سطر لكل حرف: الحروف الأولى من الأسطر يجب أن تكوّن كلمة جمجمة.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One line per letter: The first letters of the lines must form a skull word.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: سطر لكل كلمة: يجب أن تبدأ الأسطر، بالترتيب، بـ جمجمة.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One line per word: Lines must begin, in order, with a skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: ثلاثة أسطر، كل سطر أطول من الذي قبله.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three lines, each line longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: ثلاثة أسطر تنتهي كلها بالكلمة نفسها.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three lines all ending with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: ثلاثة أسطر تنتهي كلها بالحرف نفسه.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines all ending with the same letter.

form.haiku.brief.text: ثلاثة أسطر من 5 و7 و5 مقاطع.
form.haiku.brief.back: Three lines of five, seven and five paragraphs.

form.haiku.brief.char.text: ثلاثة أسطر من 5 و7 و5 أحرف.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: ثلاثة أسطر من 5 و7 و5 أصوات. اكتب بالكانا حتى يمكن عدّ الأصوات.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: سطران مقفّيان، في كل منهما نحو عشرة مقاطع، كما كان شكسبير يختم سونيتاته.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two standing lines, each of about ten verses, as Shakespeare used to close his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: أربعة أسطر، كلها من خمسة أحرف أو كلها من سبعة: هيئة الرباعية الصينية القديمة.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven: the ancient Chinese quatrain.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: سطر من ستة مقاطع ثم سطر من ثمانية، مقطعه السادس يقفّي مع آخر السطر الأول.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A line of six paragraphs and then a line of eight, the sixth paragraph standing at the end of the first line.

check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: Every line starts with the same word.

check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: Every line starts with the same letter.

check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: Every line ends with the same word.

check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: Every line ends with the same letter.

check.spells.back: The first letters make a skull.

check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: The lines start, in order, with a skull.

check.growing.text: في كل سطر كلمات أكثر من السطر الذي قبله

check.growing.back: Each line has more words than the one before it.

check.growing.char.text: في كل سطر أحرف أكثر من السطر الذي قبله
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each line has more letters than the previous one .

check.jueju-length.text: كل سطر من خمسة أحرف، أو كل سطر من سبعة
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: Each line of five letters, or each line of seven.

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: المقطع السادس في السطرين على قافية واحدة
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: Sixth paragraph in two lines on one line

device.question.brief.text: اطرح سؤالًا: اختم سطرًا بعلامة استفهام.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: End a line with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Exclaim: End a line with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: ابدأ ثلاث كلمات في سطر واحد بالحرف نفسه.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words in one line with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: كرّر كلمة قوية واحدة ثلاث مرات.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat one strong word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: اجعل كلمتين داخل سطر واحد على قافية واحدة.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two words in one line on a single hyphen.

device.riposte.brief.text: خذ من آخر أبيات خصمك كلمة من 3 أحرف أو أكثر وردّها عليه.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Take from your opponent's last verse a word of 3 or more letters and answer it.

device.brevity.brief.text: لا تجعل في أي سطر أكثر من 3 كلمات.
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: Do not make in any line more than 3 words.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: لا تجعل في أي سطر أكثر من 3 أحرف.
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: Do not make in any line more than 3 letters.

device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make your last line the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: اجعل في كل سطر العدد نفسه من الكلمات.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Make each line have the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: اجعل في كل سطر العدد نفسه من الأحرف.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Make each line have the same number of letters.

device.ring.brief.back: End your verses with the word you started.

device.ring.brief.char.text: اختم أبياتك بالحرف الذي بدأت به.
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End your verses with the letter you started.

device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.
device.invocation.brief.back: Call a character by her name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: استعمل كلمتين، كل منهما من 3 أحرف أو أكثر.
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words, each of 3 or more letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: End all lines with the same header.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: لا يجوز أن تحتوي أبياتك على الحرف م.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: Your verses must not contain the letter M.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: لا يجوز أن تحتوي أبيات خصمك على الحرف م.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: Your opponent's verse must not contain the letter M.

curse.short-words.brief.text: لا يجوز أن تزيد أي كلمة من كلماتك على 3 أحرف.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: None of your words can be longer than three letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.back: None of your opponent's words can be longer than three letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: لا يجوز لك أن تكرّر أي كلمة من 3 أحرف أو أكثر.

curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You may not repeat any word of 3 or more letters.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: لا يجوز لخصمك أن يكرّر أي كلمة من 3 أحرف أو أكثر.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: Your opponent may not repeat any word of 3 or more letters.

curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: No line of yours can be longer than three words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: لا يجوز أن يزيد أي سطر من أسطرك على 3 أحرف.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: No one of your lines can be longer than 3 characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: لا يجوز أن يزيد أي سطر من أسطر خصمك على 3 كلمات.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: None of your opponent's lines can be longer than three words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: لا يجوز أن يزيد أي سطر من أسطر خصمك على 3 أحرف.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: None of your opponent's lines can be longer than 3 characters.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your password, we will not be able to re-enter you. After this step add a second passkey so that you can get back.

auth.nudgeBody.text: الآن مفتاح مرور واحد هو السبيل الوحيد إلى هذا الحساب. إن ضاع ضاع الحساب. أضف مفتاح مرور ثانيًا أو بريدًا إلكترونيًا لتتمكن من العودة.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: Now a single password is the only way to access this account. If you lose it, your account is lost. Add a second password or an email to get back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: الآن مفتاح مرور واحد هو السبيل الوحيد إلى هذا الحساب. إن ضاع ضاع الحساب. أضف مفتاح مرور ثانيًا لتتمكن من العودة.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: Now one passkey is the only way to this account. If you lose it, the account is lost. Add a second passkey to get back.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: استعمل جهازًا آخر أو مدير كلمات مرور أو مفتاح أمان.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use another device, password manager or security key.

auth.nudgeEmail.text: إضافة بريد إلكتروني بدلًا من ذلك

auth.recoveryWarning.text: مفتاح مرور واحد هو سبيلك الوحيد للدخول. أضف مفتاح مرور ثانيًا أو بريدًا إلكترونيًا لتتمكن من العودة.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: A single passkey is your only way to log in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: مفتاح مرور واحد هو سبيلك الوحيد للدخول. أضف مفتاح مرور ثانيًا لتتمكن من العودة.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: One passkey is your only way to log in. Add a second passkey so you can get back.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: أرسلنا رمزًا من 6 أرقام إلى a@example.com. أدخله لتأكيد أن العنوان لك.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to verify that the address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: أُضيف البريد. يمكنك الآن الدخول برمز يُرسل إليه.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Mail added. You can now sign in with a send-to code.

auth.emailButton.back: Send me a code by mail.

auth.emailHint.text: على جهاز لا يتوفر فيه مفتاح مرورك؟ سجّل الدخول بالبريد الإلكتروني إذا كان لحسابك بريد.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: On a device that does not have your passkey? Sign in with email if you have an account.

auth.emailIntro.text: سنرسل لك رمزًا من 6 أرقام. إن كان العنوان جديدًا فسينشئ الرمز حسابك.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code will create your account.

auth.emailSend.back: Send me a code by mail.

auth.codeIntro.text: أرسلنا رمزًا من 6 أرقام إلى a@example.com. يصلح مرة واحدة وتنتهي صلاحيته بعد 10 دقائق.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It is valid once and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: رمز جديد في الطريق إليك. الرمز القديم لم يعد صالحًا.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new code is on its way to you.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By logging in, you agree to

auth.offerHeading.text: أضف مفتاح مرور إلى هذا الجهاز
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: في المرة القادمة، سجّل الدخول ببصمة إصبعك أو وجهك أو قفل الشاشة. بلا رمز وبلا انتظار بريد إلكتروني.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No code and no waiting for email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: لا توجد مفاتيح مرور بعد. أضف مفتاحًا لتسجيل الدخول دون رمز يصلك بالبريد الإلكتروني.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There are no password keys yet. Add a login key without an email code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: تمت إضافة مفتاح المرور. يمكنك تسجيل الدخول به من الآن فصاعدًا.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: The password key has been added. You can log in with it from now on.

auth.error.age_required.text: يُرجى تأكيد عمرك في الصفحة الرئيسية أولًا. الحسابات للاعبين من سن 13 فما فوق.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please confirm your age on the homepage first. Accounts for players aged 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: هذا العنوان تابع لحساب آخر. سجّل الخروج ثم سجّل الدخول به.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address belongs to another account. Log out and then log in with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: لم تكتمل العملية. حاول مرة أخرى.
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.
auth.error.signup_retry.back: Process not completed. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: لا يبدو هذا عنوان بريد إلكتروني.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: That doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: الرمز غير صحيح أو انتهت صلاحيته. راجعه أو اطلب رمزًا جديدًا.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The password is invalid or has expired. Please check it or request a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: طُلبت رموز كثيرة. انتظر بضع دقائق ثم حاول مجددًا.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: تعذّر إرسال البريد. حاول مجددًا بعد قليل.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: The mail could not be sent. Please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: هذا المتصفح لا يدعم مفاتيح المرور.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: This browser does not support passkeys.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: لم يُستعمل أي مفتاح مرور. حاول مجددًا حين تكون مستعدًا.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: لم يُقبل مفتاح المرور هذا. سجّل الدخول باستخدام رمز مرسل عبر البريد الإلكتروني، ثم أضف مفتاح مرور جديدًا.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: This passkey has not been accepted. Please log in using the code sent by email, and then add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: لم يعمل مفتاح المرور. حاول مرة أخرى.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The passkey didn't work, try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: على هذا الجهاز مفتاح مرور لحسابك بالفعل.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a password for your account.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: تعذّرت إضافة مفتاح المرور هذا. حاول مرة أخرى.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Could not add this passkey. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: بلغ هذا الحساب الحد الأقصى من مفاتيح المرور. أزِل واحدًا أولًا.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has reached the maximum number of password keys. Remove one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: مفتاح المرور هذا وسيلتك الوحيدة للدخول. أضف مفتاحًا آخر قبل إزالته.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is your only means of access. Add another key before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: استغرق ذلك وقتًا طويلًا. حاول مرة أخرى.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: انتهت جلستك. سجّل الدخول من جديد.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

auth.error.network.text: تعذّر الوصول إلى الخادم. تحقق من اتصالك وحاول مجددًا.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Unable to access the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: حدث خطأ ما. حاول مرة أخرى.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: Something went wrong, please try again.

battle.intro.text: ثلاث جولات، ثلاثة قوالب. بطاقاتك تحدّد ما يجب أن تفعله أبياتك. الخصم يعمل داخل متصفحك: لا شيء مما تكتبه يغادر هذا الجهاز.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three templates, your cards dictate what your words should do, the counter works inside your browser: nothing you type leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: كل شخصية تصعد المسرح مرة واحدة. الآثار والجرعات تكلّف حبرًا.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character gets on stage once, the effects and doses cost a fortune.

battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Representative: Choose the best of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: الأستاذ: يختار الأفضل من ثلاث مسودات
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Teacher: Choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: جارٍ فحص ما يستطيع هذا الجهاز تشغيله…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can do...

brain.kept.text: يُنزَّل مرة واحدة من Hugging Face ويحتفظ به متصفحك. لا يُرسَل شيء مما تكتبه أو تقوله إلى أي مكان.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: It's downloaded once from Hugging Face and stored in your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: تم تحميل Gemma وهو يعمل على هذا الجهاز.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Gemma has been loaded and is working on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: تم تحميل Gemma على هذا الجهاز. هو نموذج صغير: يحكم على الأبيات، والخصم يلقي أبياتًا مكتوبة سلفًا.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: Gemma has been loaded on this device. It's a small model: judges verses, the opponent throws pre-written verses.

brain.failed.text: تعذّر تشغيل النموذج على هذا الجهاز. ما زال بإمكانك اللعب ضد خصم الأبيات المكتوبة.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not be run on this device. You can still play against the written verses opponent.

brain.written.back: You play against an opponent written verses.

brain.noWebgpu.text: هذا المتصفح بلا WebGPU، لذا يلقي الخصم أبياتًا مكتوبة سلفًا والتحكيم بالقواعد. كل ما عدا ذلك يعمل.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent throws pre-written sentences and arbitrates by rules.

brain.canRun.text: يستطيع هذا الجهاز تشغيل Gemma في المتصفح. حجم التنزيل 3.1 GB في المرة الأولى، ثم يبقى محفوظًا.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in the browser. The download size is 3.1 GB for the first time, then it stays saved.

brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: تلعب ضد خصم الأبيات المكتوبة. يمكنك استدعاء النموذج متى شئت بإعادة تحميل الصفحة.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You play against an opponent of written verses. You can call the model anytime by reloading the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: اهتف: اختم سطرًا بعلامة تعجب.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Exclaim: End a line with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet يصيبك بلعنة «Ariel»: لا يجوز أن تزيد أي كلمة من كلماتك على 5 أحرف.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet curses you with the "Ariel" curse: no word of yours may exceed five letters.

round.composingDraft.back: Hamlet arranges his verses. Draft 3 of 3.

round.items.back: Effects and doses (each with one ink)

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…
round.versePlaceholder.back: A line of my hair in every line...

round.seedNote.text: البذرة نفسها والرزمة نفسها تسحبان القوالب نفسها.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: Same seed and same bundle draw the same templates.

hand.curses.text: يلعن خصمك: لا يجوز أن تزيد أي كلمة من كلماتك على 5 أحرف.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curse your opponent: No word may be longer than 5 characters.

hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet Battles: A Skull, a Joke and a Tomb.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet يلعن أبيات خصمك القادمة: لا يجوز أن تزيد أي كلمة من كلماتك على 5 أحرف.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of your words may exceed 5 letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet كان سيلعن أبيات الخصم القادمة، لكن هذه هي الجولة الأخيرة.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet would have cursed his opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: That character isn't in your pack.

illegal.character-used.text: كل شخصية تصعد المسرح مرة واحدة في المباراة.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Each character climbs the stage once in the game.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: That trace isn't in your package.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.back: That dose isn't in your package.

live.device.text: Ariel (+½ صنعة): اهتف: اختم سطرًا بعلامة تعجب.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (+½ skill): Exclaim: Ends a line with an exclamation mark.

live.signature.text: التوقيع (+½ صنعة): ردّد صدى عبارة Hamlet دون أن تقتبسها
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (+½ handwriting): echo Hamlet without quoting

live.power.text: كلمات القوة (+2): استعمل اثنتين من جمجمة ومزحة وقبر
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Power words (+2): use two of skull, joke and tomb

signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: This card doesn't have a signature.

signature.hint.text: ردّد صدى إحدى هذه الكلمات: جمجمة ومزحة وقبر
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: Echo one of these words: skull, joke and grave.

signature.quoted.text: اقتباس حرفي؛ الصدى يجب أن يكون سطرًا من عندك
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: I quote; the echo must be a line from you.

mic.loadingEar.text: جارٍ تحميل الأذن (75 م.ب، مرة واحدة)…

verdict.judgedCompare.text: حكم Gemma على هذا الجهاز، وقد قرأ الأبيات بالترتيبين.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Gemma judged on this device, and read the verses in both orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: حكم Gemma على هذا الجهاز، وقد قيّم كل أبيات على حدة.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Gemma judged this device, and evaluated each verse individually.

verdict.judgedRules.text: حُكم بالقواعد (التنوع والتلميح والإيقاع والردّ) لأنه لا نموذج يعمل.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: Rules (variety, hint, rhythm and response) were ruled because there was no working model.

end.lost.back: The stage for your opponent tonight.

badge.writtenJudged.back: Discount for written verses · Judge Gemma

theatre.intro.text: المبارزة نفسها، على خشبة تحيط بك. أشِر أو اقرص بإصبعيك لتلعب بطاقة، واضغط الميكروفون وألقِ أبياتك. تُدوَّن ويُحكم عليها على هذا الجهاز.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The wrestling itself, on a stage surrounding you. Point or pinch your fingers to play a card, press the microphone and cast your sentences. They're recorded and judged on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: يُفتح بوضع الرؤية العابرة، فتقوم الخشبة في غرفتك. أشِر بذراع التحكم أو اقرص بيدك.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: It opens in passing view, and the screen is in your room.

theatre.visionBody.text: يُفتح خشبةً كاملة. انظر إلى بطاقة واقرص بإصبعيك. Safari على visionOS لا يتيح الرؤية العابرة لصفحات الويب.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Opens a full screen. Look at a card and pinch with your finger. Safari on visionOS does not allow browsing of web pages.

theatre.screenBody.text: انقر البطاقات والأزرار على الخشبة، وتكلّم أو اكتب.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click cards and buttons on the board, talk or type.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: تلعب ضد خصم الأبيات المكتوبة. استدعِ نموذجًا في صفحة النزال لتواجهه هنا.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: You're playing against a written verse opponent. Call up a model on the battle page to face him here.

theatre.enterAr.back: Enter: the wood in your room.

theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.

theatre.cursesYou.back: Curse you: No word of yours may exceed five letters.

theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Here's your verse, press the microphone and throw it, a line at every breath.

form.couplet.brief.text: दो पंक्तियाँ जिनकी तुक मिलती हो।

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: चार पंक्तियाँ: पहली दो की तुक मिले, और आख़िरी दो की तुक मिले।
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines: Match the first two, and match the last two.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: चार पंक्तियाँ: पंक्ति 1 की तुक 3 से मिले, पंक्ति 2 की 4 से।
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four rows: Line 1's dot meets line 3, line 2's dot meets line 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: तीन पंक्तियाँ; पहली और आख़िरी की तुक मिले।
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines; first and last matched.

form.anaphora.brief.text: तीन पंक्तियाँ जो सब एक ही शब्द से शुरू हों।
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three lines that all start with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: तीन पंक्तियाँ जो सब एक ही अक्षर से शुरू हों।
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three lines that all start with the same letter.

form.acrostic.brief.text: हर अक्षर के लिए एक पंक्ति: पंक्तियों के पहले अक्षरों से खोपड़ी बनना चाहिए।
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: A row for each letter: The first letters of the rows should form a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: हर शब्द के लिए एक पंक्ति: पंक्तियाँ क्रम से खोपड़ी से शुरू होनी चाहिए।
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One line for each word: Lines must start with a skull in order.

form.crescendo.brief.text: तीन पंक्तियाँ, हर पंक्ति पिछली से लंबी।
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three lines, each line longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: तीन पंक्तियाँ जो सब एक ही शब्द पर ख़त्म हों।
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three lines that all end in the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: तीन पंक्तियाँ जो सब एक ही अक्षर पर ख़त्म हों।
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines that all end with the same letter.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: 5, 7 और 5 ध्वनियों की तीन पंक्तियाँ। काना में लिखें ताकि ध्वनियाँ गिनी जा सकें।
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three rows of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so that the sounds can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: तुक वाली दो पंक्तियाँ, हर एक में लगभग दस शब्दांश, जैसे शेक्सपीयर अपने सॉनेट समाप्त करते थे।
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two lines of sentences, about ten syllables each, like Shakespeare ended his sonnet.

form.jueju.brief.text: चार पंक्तियाँ, सब पाँच अक्षरों की या सब सात की: चीनी शास्त्रीय चौपदी का ढाँचा।
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines, all five characters or all seven: The structure of the Chinese classical quatrain.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: छह शब्दांशों की एक पंक्ति, फिर आठ की, जिसका छठा शब्दांश पहली पंक्ति के अंत से तुक मिलाए।
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A line of six syllables, then eight, with the sixth syllable matching the end of the first line.

check.rhyme.text: पंक्ति 1 और 2 की तुक मिलती है

check.same-opening.text: हर पंक्ति एक ही शब्द से शुरू होती है
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: Each line starts with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: हर पंक्ति एक ही अक्षर से शुरू होती है
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: Each line starts with the same letter

check.same-ending.text: हर पंक्ति एक ही शब्द पर ख़त्म होती है
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: Each line ends with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: हर पंक्ति एक ही अक्षर पर ख़त्म होती है
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: Each line ends with the same letter

check.spells.text: पहले अक्षरों से खोपड़ी बनता है
check.spells.back: Creates a skull from the first letters

check.spells.words.text: पंक्तियाँ क्रम से खोपड़ी से शुरू होती हैं
check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: Rows start with skull in order

check.growing.text: हर पंक्ति में पिछली से ज़्यादा शब्द हैं
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each line has more words than the previous one

check.growing.char.text: हर पंक्ति में पिछली से ज़्यादा अक्षर हैं
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each line has more characters than the previous one

check.jueju-length.text: हर पंक्ति में पाँच अक्षर हैं, या हर पंक्ति में सात
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: Five characters per line, or seven characters per line

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: दोनों पंक्तियों के छठे शब्दांश की तुक मिलती है
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: Match the sixth syllable of both lines

device.question.brief.text: एक सवाल पूछें: किसी पंक्ति को प्रश्नचिह्न पर ख़त्म करें।
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: End any line with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: पुकार उठें: किसी पंक्ति को विस्मयादिबोधक चिह्न पर ख़त्म करें।
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Exclamation: End a line with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: एक ही पंक्ति में तीन शब्द एक ही अक्षर से शुरू करें।
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words in the same line with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: एक दमदार शब्द को तीन बार दोहराएँ।
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a strong word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: एक ही पंक्ति के भीतर दो शब्दों की तुक मिलाएँ।
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Match two words in the same line.

device.riposte.brief.text: प्रतिद्वंद्वी के पिछले पद से 3 या ज़्यादा अक्षरों वाला कोई शब्द लेकर उसी पर लौटा दें।
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Return a word of 3 or more characters from the opponent's previous position.

device.brevity.brief.text: किसी भी पंक्ति में 3 से ज़्यादा शब्द न हों।
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: No more than 3 words in any line.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: किसी भी पंक्ति में 3 से ज़्यादा अक्षर न हों।
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: No more than 3 characters in any line.

device.swell.brief.text: अपनी आख़िरी पंक्ति को सबसे लंबी रखें।
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Keep your last line the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: हर पंक्ति में बराबर शब्द रखें।
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Put the same words in each line.

device.balance.brief.char.text: हर पंक्ति में बराबर अक्षर रखें।
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Put the same letters in each row.

device.ring.brief.text: अपना पद उसी शब्द पर ख़त्म करें जिससे वह शुरू हुआ था।
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End your speech with the same word it started with.

device.ring.brief.char.text: अपना पद उसी अक्षर पर ख़त्म करें जिससे वह शुरू हुआ था।
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End your position on the same letter it started with.

device.invocation.brief.text: किसी पात्र को नाम लेकर पुकारें।
device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: 3 या ज़्यादा अक्षरों वाले दो शब्द इस्तेमाल करें।
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of 3 or more letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: हर पंक्ति को एक ही तुक पर ख़त्म करें।
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: End each line at the same stroke.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: आपके पद में म अक्षर नहीं आ सकता।
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: Your position cannot contain the letter M.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: प्रतिद्वंद्वी के पद में म अक्षर नहीं आ सकता।
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: The letter M cannot come in the opponent's position.

curse.short-words.brief.text: आपका कोई भी शब्द 3 अक्षरों से लंबा नहीं हो सकता।
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: No word can be longer than 3 characters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: प्रतिद्वंद्वी का कोई भी शब्द 3 अक्षरों से लंबा नहीं हो सकता।
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: No word of the opponent can be longer than 3 characters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: आप 3 या ज़्यादा अक्षरों वाला कोई शब्द दो बार इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकते।
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You cannot use any word of 3 or more letters twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: प्रतिद्वंद्वी 3 या ज़्यादा अक्षरों वाला कोई शब्द दो बार इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकता।
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: The opponent cannot use a word of 3 or more letters twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: आपकी किसी भी पंक्ति में 3 से ज़्यादा शब्द नहीं हो सकते।
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: You cannot have more than 3 words in any line.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: आपकी किसी भी पंक्ति में 3 से ज़्यादा अक्षर नहीं हो सकते।
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: You cannot have more than 3 characters in any line.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: प्रतिद्वंद्वी की किसी भी पंक्ति में 3 से ज़्यादा शब्द नहीं हो सकते।
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: The opponent cannot have more than 3 words in any line.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: प्रतिद्वंद्वी की किसी भी पंक्ति में 3 से ज़्यादा अक्षर नहीं हो सकते।
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: The opponent cannot have more than 3 characters in any row.

house.montague.why.text: मरकूशियो की तेज़ ज़ुबान पंक्ति के बीच में ही तुक मिला देती है।
house.montague.why.back: Marcoussio's sharp tongue makes sense in the middle of a line.

house.verona-court.why.text: दरबार आपके ख़िलाफ़ कहे गए हर शब्द को तौलता है।
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word spoken against you.

house.the-tempest.why.text: तूफ़ान बढ़ता जाता है, जब तक टूट न पड़े।
house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm grows, until it breaks.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Man एक ही तुक पर सवार होकर अंत तक जाता है।
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: Sonnet Man rides on the same line all the way to the end.

house.lake-district.why.text: रोमानी कवि हर पंक्ति को नाप-तौलकर लिखते थे।
house.lake-district.why.back: Romantic poets wrote every line with measure.

house.gothic-circle.why.text: कहानी वहीं ख़त्म होती है जहाँ से शुरू हुई थी।
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it started.

house.olympus.why.text: देवता गरजते शब्दों में बोलते हैं।
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.

house.underworld.why.text: मृतकों को आपकी कही हर बात याद रहती है।
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you say.

nav.toggleAudio.back: Turn the sound on or off

footer.tagline.text: एआई और ऑगमेंटेड रियलिटी से चलने वाले डिजिटल संग्रहणीय कार्ड। ऐसे इंटरैक्टिव अनुभव जो शेक्सपीयर को जीवंत कर देते हैं।

footer.tagline.back: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.

migrate.body.text: हमें इस डिवाइस पर खेल की प्रगति मिली है। इसे अपने खाते से सिंक करें ताकि यह आपके सभी डिवाइस पर सुरक्षित रहे।

pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience

offline.banner.text: आप ऑफ़लाइन हैं: संग्रह और प्रश्नोत्तरी अब भी चलते हैं। मल्टीप्लेयर के लिए इंटरनेट चाहिए।
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: collection and quiz are still running. Multiplayer requires Internet.

auth.signInIntro.text: कोई पासवर्ड याद नहीं रखना। पासकी आपको फ़िंगरप्रिंट, चेहरे या स्क्रीन लॉक से साइन इन कराती है।
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: Don't remember any passwords. Passkey allows you to sign in with a fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: यह ब्राउज़र पासकी इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकता। इसके बदले ईमेल से आए कोड से साइन इन करें।
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with the code from email instead.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: यह ब्राउज़र पासकी इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकता, और यह साइट पासकी से ही साइन इन कराती है। Chrome, Safari, Edge या Firefox का नया संस्करण आज़माएँ।
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site only allows you to sign in with passkeys. Try a newer version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: आपका खाता एक पासकी है, जो इस डिवाइस पर या आपके पासवर्ड मैनेजर में सहेजी जाती है। हम नाम, ईमेल या पासवर्ड नहीं माँगते।
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a passkey, which is stored on this device or in your password manager. We don't ask for name, email or password.

auth.createWarning.text: अगर पासकी खो गई तो हम आपको वापस अंदर नहीं ला सकेंगे। इसके बाद दूसरी पासकी या एक ईमेल जोड़ लें ताकि आप लौट सकें।
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If the password is lost, we will not be able to get you back in. Then add a second password or an email so that you can return.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: अगर पासकी खो गई तो हम आपको वापस अंदर नहीं ला सकेंगे। इसके बाद दूसरी पासकी जोड़ लें ताकि आप लौट सकें।
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If the passkey is lost, we will not be able to bring you back in. Then pair a second passkey so that you can return.

auth.nudgeBody.text: अभी इस खाते में आने का एकमात्र रास्ता एक पासकी है। वह खोई तो खाता भी गया। दूसरी पासकी या एक ईमेल जोड़ लें ताकि आप लौट सकें।
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: The only way to access this account at the moment is with a password. If you lose it, your account will be lost. Please add another password or an email so that you can get back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: अभी इस खाते में आने का एकमात्र रास्ता एक पासकी है। वह खोई तो खाता भी गया। दूसरी पासकी जोड़ लें ताकि आप लौट सकें।
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: The only way to access this account right now is with a passkey. If you lose it, the account will be lost. Add another passkey so that you can get back.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: कोई दूसरा डिवाइस, पासवर्ड मैनेजर या सिक्योरिटी की इस्तेमाल करें।
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use another device, password manager or security.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: एक ही पासकी आपके अंदर आने का अकेला रास्ता है। दूसरी पासकी या एक ईमेल जोड़ लें ताकि आप लौट सकें।
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: The same password is the only way to get in. Add a second password or an email so you can return.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: एक ही पासकी आपके अंदर आने का अकेला रास्ता है। दूसरी पासकी जोड़ लें ताकि आप लौट सकें।
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: The same passkey is the only way to get inside you. Get a second passkey so that you can return.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: हमने a@example.com पर 6 अंकों का कोड भेजा है। पता आपका ही है, इसकी पुष्टि के लिए कोड डालें।
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We have sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. This is your address, enter the code to confirm it.

auth.addEmailDone.text: ईमेल जुड़ गया। अब आप उस पर भेजे गए कोड से साइन इन कर सकते हैं।
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email attached. You can now sign in with the code sent to it.

auth.emailButton.back: Send me the code by email

auth.emailHint.text: ऐसे डिवाइस पर हैं जिसमें आपकी पासकी नहीं? अगर खाते में ईमेल है तो ईमेल से साइन इन करें।
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Are you on a device that does not have your password? If the account has email, sign in with email.

auth.emailIntro.text: हम आपको 6 अंकों का कोड ईमेल करेंगे। पता नया हुआ तो यही कोड आपका खाता बना देगा।
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We will email you a 6-digit code. This code will create your account when the address is new.

auth.emailSend.back: Send me the code by email

auth.codeIntro.text: हमने a@example.com पर 6 अंकों का कोड भेजा है। यह एक बार चलता है और 10 मिनट में ख़त्म हो जाता है।
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It runs once and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: नया कोड भेज दिया गया है। पुराना अब नहीं चलेगा।
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: The new code has been sent. The old one will no longer work.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By signing in, you agree to our

auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: अगली बार फ़िंगरप्रिंट, चेहरे या स्क्रीन लॉक से साइन इन करें। न कोड, न ईमेल का इंतज़ार।
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time sign in with fingerprint, face or screen lock. No code, no email waiting.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: अभी कोई पासकी नहीं है। एक जोड़ लें ताकि ईमेल कोड के बिना साइन इन हो सके।
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There is no passkey yet. Choose one so that you can sign in without an email code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: पासकी जुड़ गई। अब से आप इससे साइन इन कर सकते हैं।
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: Passkey connected. You can now sign in with it.

auth.error.age_required.text: कृपया पहले मुखपृष्ठ पर अपनी आयु की पुष्टि करें। खाते 13 वर्ष और उससे ऊपर के खिलाड़ियों के लिए हैं।
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please first confirm your age on the homepage. Accounts are for players 13 years and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: यह पता पहले से किसी और खाते का है। साइन आउट करके इसी से साइन इन करें।
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: इस खाते में पहले से ईमेल पता है।
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: यह पूरा नहीं हो सका। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.
auth.error.signup_retry.back: It could not be completed. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: यह ईमेल पता जैसा नहीं लगता।
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: This does not look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: कोड सही नहीं है, या उसकी अवधि बीत गई है। जाँच लें, या नया कोड मँगाएँ।
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect, or it has expired. Please check, or request a new code.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: बहुत ज़्यादा कोड माँगे गए। कुछ मिनट रुककर फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: हम ईमेल नहीं भेज सके। थोड़ी देर में फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We could not send the email. Please try again in a while.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: यह ब्राउज़र पासकी इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकता।

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: कोई पासकी इस्तेमाल नहीं हुई। जब तैयार हों, फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No passkeys used. Try again when you are ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: वह पासकी स्वीकार नहीं हुई। ईमेल कोड से साइन इन करें, फिर नई पासकी जोड़ें।
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with the email code, then add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: पासकी काम नहीं कर पाई। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: Passkey could not work. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: इस डिवाइस पर आपके खाते की पासकी पहले से है।
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a password for your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: वह पासकी पहले से दर्ज है।

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: वह पासकी जोड़ी नहीं जा सकी। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: The next pair could not go. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: इस खाते में पासकी की अधिकतम संख्या हो चुकी है। पहले एक हटाएँ।
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has reached the maximum number of passkeys. Remove one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: यह पासकी साइन इन का आपका अकेला तरीक़ा है। इसे हटाने से पहले दूसरी जोड़ें।
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This is your only way to sign in with a passkey. Add another one before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: इसमें बहुत देर लग गई। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: आपका सत्र समाप्त हो गया है। कृपया फिर साइन इन करें।
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

auth.error.network.text: हम सर्वर तक नहीं पहुँच सके। अपना कनेक्शन जाँचकर फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: कुछ गड़बड़ हो गई। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: Something went wrong. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: तीन दौर, तीन छंद-रूप। आपके कार्ड तय करते हैं कि आपके पद को क्या करना है। प्रतिद्वंद्वी आपके ब्राउज़र में ही चलता है: आपका लिखा कुछ भी इस डिवाइस से बाहर नहीं जाता।
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three stanzas. Your cards decide what your position should do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: हर पात्र एक ही बार मंच पर आ सकता है। अवशेष और काढ़े में स्याही लगती है।
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can come on stage at once. Ink is used in the remains and extracts.

battle.difficulty.player.text: अभिनेता: दो मसौदों में से बेहतर चुनता है
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: Choose the best of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: उस्ताद: तीन मसौदों में से सबसे अच्छा चुनता है
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: Choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: देखा जा रहा है कि यह डिवाइस क्या चला सकता है…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: एक बार Hugging Face से डाउनलोड होता है और आपका ब्राउज़र उसे रख लेता है। आप जो लिखते या बोलते हैं, वह कहीं नहीं भेजा जाता।
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Once it's downloaded from Hugging Face and your browser keeps it. What you type or speak is not sent anywhere.

brain.summoning.text: आपके प्रतिद्वंद्वी को बुलाया जा रहा है…

brain.downloading.text: मॉडल Gemma डाउनलोड हो रहा है: 3 MB में से 512

brain.loaded.text: मॉडल Gemma लोड हो गया है और इसी डिवाइस पर चल रहा है।
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Model Gemma has been loaded and is running on the same device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: मॉडल Gemma इस डिवाइस पर लोड हो गया है। यह छोटा है: यह पदों का निर्णय करता है, और प्रतिद्वंद्वी पहले से लिखे पद सुनाता है।
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: The model Gemma has been loaded on this device. It's small: it decides positions, and the opponent reads out pre-written positions.

brain.failed.text: मॉडल इस डिवाइस पर शुरू नहीं हो सका। आप फिर भी लिखे हुए पदों वाले प्रतिद्वंद्वी से खेल सकते हैं।
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against opponents with written positions.

brain.noModel.text: बिना मॉडल के खेल रहे हैं।

brain.written.text: लिखे हुए पदों वाले प्रतिद्वंद्वी से खेल रहे हैं।
brain.written.back: Playing against an opponent with written positions.

brain.noWebgpu.text: इस ब्राउज़र में WebGPU नहीं है, इसलिए प्रतिद्वंद्वी पहले से लिखे पद सुनाता है और निर्णय नियमों से होता है। बाक़ी सब चलता है।
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser does not have a WebGPU, so the opponent reads pre-written sentences and decisions are made by rules. Everything else goes.

brain.canRun.text: यह डिवाइस Gemma को ब्राउज़र में चला सकता है। पहली बार 3.1 GB डाउनलोड होगा, फिर वह रखा रहेगा।
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in a browser. 3.1 GB will be downloaded first, then kept.

brain.summonLighter.text: Gemma को बुलाएँ (3.1 GB): हल्का डाउनलोड
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download
brain.summonLighter.back: Call to Gemma (3.1 GB): Light Download

theatre.intro.text: वही द्वंद्व, आपके चारों ओर बने मंच पर। कार्ड खेलने के लिए इशारा करें या चुटकी भरें, माइक्रोफ़ोन दबाएँ और अपना पद सुनाएँ। उसे इसी डिवाइस पर लिखा और परखा जाता है।
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on a platform built around you. Point or tap to play cards, press the microphone and speak your position. It is recorded and tested on the same device.

theatre.questBody.text: पासथ्रू में खुलता है, इसलिए मंच आपके कमरे में ही सजता है। कंट्रोलर से इशारा करें या हाथ से चुटकी भरें।
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: Opens in a passthrough, so the stage fits into your room. Point with the controller or wink with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: पूरे मंच के रूप में खुलता है। किसी कार्ड को देखें और चुटकी भरें। visionOS पर Safari वेब पेजों को पासथ्रू नहीं देता।
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Opens as a whole platform. Look at any card and swipe in. Safari does not passthrough web pages on visionOS.

theatre.screenBody.text: मंच पर कार्डों और बटनों पर क्लिक करें, और बोलें या टाइप करें।
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards and buttons on the board, and speak or type.

theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: You are playing against an opponent with written positions. Call a model on the battle page to face the model here.

theatre.declined.back: This device denied an immersive session.

theatre.judgedModel.back: The decision was made by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.back: Decision made by rules: no model is running.

theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a card from your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: आप पर शाप: आपका कोई भी शब्द 5 अक्षरों से लंबा नहीं हो सकता।
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: Curse on you: No word can be longer than 5 characters.

theatre.composingDraft.text: पद रचा जा रहा है… मसौदा 3 / 3

theatre.versePrompt.text: आपका पद यहाँ दिखेगा। माइक्रोफ़ोन दबाएँ और उसे सुनाएँ, एक साँस में एक पंक्ति।
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your position will appear here. Press the microphone and play it, one line in a breath.

form.couplet.brief.back: Two lines, in rhythm with each other.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: 四行：前两行押韵，后两行押韵。
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines: the first two lines are rhymed and the last two lines are rhymed.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: 四行：第1行与第3行押韵，第2行与第4行押韵。
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Fourth line: Line 1 rhymes with Line 3, and Line 2 rhymes with Line 4.

form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines; the first and last lines are rhymed.

form.anaphora.brief.text: 三行，每行都以同一个词开头。
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three lines, each beginning with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: 三行，每行都以同一个字开头。
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three lines, each beginning with the same word.

form.acrostic.brief.text: 每个字一行：各行的第一个字必须连成“骷髅”。
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One line per word: The first word of each line must be joined to form "skeleton".

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: 每个词一行：各行必须依次以“骷髅”开头。
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One line per word: Lines must begin with "skeleton" in sequence.

form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three rows, one row longer than the other.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: 三行，每行都以同一个词结尾。
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three lines, each ending with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: 三行，每行都以同一个字结尾。
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines, each ending with the same word.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: 三行，分别为5、7、5个音。请用假名书写，这样才能数出音数。
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines, 5, 7 and 5 notes respectively. Please write with pseudonyms so that the number of pronunciations can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: 两行押韵，每行大约十个音节，莎士比亚就是这样为十四行诗收尾的。
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two lines of rhyme, about ten syllables each, which is how Shakespeare ended the fourteen-line poem.

form.jueju.brief.text: 四行，全是五个字或全是七个字：古典绝句的体式。
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines, all five words or all seven words: the style of the classic imperative.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: 先一行六个音节，再一行八个音节，后一行的第六个音节与前一行的末尾押韵。
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: The first line consists of six syllables, the second of eight, and the sixth syllable of the next row is rhymed with the end of the previous row.

check.same-opening.text: 每行都以同一个词开头
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: Each line starts with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: 每行都以同一个字开头
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: Each line starts with the same word

check.same-ending.text: 每行都以同一个词结尾
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: Each line ends with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: 每行都以同一个字结尾
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: Each line ends with the same word
