check.growing.char.text: 每行的字数都比上一行多
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each line has more words than the previous one.

check.jueju-length.text: 每行都是五个字，或每行都是七个字
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: Five words per line, or seven words per line.

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: 两行的第六个音节押韵
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: Rhyming the sixth syllable of two lines

device.question.brief.text: 提出一个问题：让某一行以问号结尾。
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: put a question mark at the end of a line.

device.exclaim.brief.text: 大声疾呼：让某一行以感叹号结尾。
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Exclamation: Let a line end with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: 在同一行里，让三个词以同一个字开头。
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: In the same line, let three words begin with the same word.

device.repetition.brief.text: 把一个有分量的词重复三次。
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a word with weight three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: 让同一行里的两个词押韵。
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two words in the same line rhyme.

device.riposte.brief.text: 从对手上一首诗里取一个不少于3个字的词，回敬给对手。
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Take a word of not less than three words from an opponent's poem and return it to the opponent.

device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: No more than 3 words per line.

device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: No more than 3 words per line.

device.swell.brief.text: 让最后一行成为最长的一行。
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make the last line the longest.

device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Make each line have the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Make each line have the same number of words.

device.ring.brief.text: 用开头的那个词结束你的诗。
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End your poem with the first word.

device.ring.brief.char.text: 用开头的那个字结束你的诗。
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End your poem with the first word.

device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.
device.invocation.brief.back: Call out the name of a character.

device.grandeur.brief.text: 用两个不少于3个字的词。
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of no less than three words.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: 让每一行都落在同一个韵上。
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Let each line fall on the same rhythm.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: 你的诗里不能出现“的”字。
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: You can't have the word "of" in your poem.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: 对手的诗里不能出现“的”字。
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: The opponent's poem must not contain the word "of."

curse.short-words.brief.text: 你用的词都不能超过3个字。
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: You can't use more than three words.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: 对手用的词都不能超过3个字。
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: The opponent cannot use more than three words.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: 不少于3个字的词，你都不能用两次。
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You can't use a word of at least three words twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: 不少于3个字的词，对手都不能用两次。
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: No opponent can use a word of at least three words twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: 你的每一行都不能超过3个词。
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: Each of your lines can not be more than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: 你的每一行都不能超过3个字。
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: Each of your lines can not be more than 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: 对手的每一行都不能超过3个词。
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: Each line of your opponent must not exceed 3 words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: 对手的每一行都不能超过3个字。
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: Each line of your opponent must not exceed 3 words.

house.montague.why.text: 茂丘西奥口齿伶俐，一行之内就能押韵。
house.montague.why.back: Mochu Teo is a wise tongue, and he can rhyme within a line.

house.verona-court.why.text: 宫廷会掂量每一句冲你而来的话。
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court will weigh every word that comes to you.

house.the-tempest.why.text: 风暴越积越大，直到爆发。
house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm builds up until it explodes.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Man 骑着一个韵，一路到底。
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: Sonnet Man Ride a Rhyme, All the Way.

house.lake-district.why.text: 浪漫派诗人字斟句酌，每一行都量过。

house.gothic-circle.why.text: 故事在开始的地方结束。
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods opened their mouths and spoke like thunder.

house.underworld.why.text: 亡者记得你说过的每一句话。
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember every word you say.

footer.tagline.text: 由人工智能和增强现实驱动的数字收藏卡牌。让莎士比亚活起来的互动体验。
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital collectible cards powered by artificial intelligence and augmented reality. An interactive experience that brings Shakespeare to life.

age.intro.text: 请确认你的年龄以继续。
age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.
age.intro.back: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.text: 请选择完整的出生日期。
age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Please select a complete date of birth.

age.minorBody.text: 使用 Inspired Mile 须年满 13 岁。请在达到年龄要求后再来。
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.

age.teenBody.text: 由于你未满 18 岁，使用 Inspired Mile 需要父母或监护人的同意。
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: Because you are under 18, the use of Inspired Mile requires parental or guardian consent.

age.consentBefore.text: 我确认我的父母或法定监护人已阅读
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the
age.consentBefore.back: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has read

age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: And I agree to use Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.text: 继续即表示你同意我们的
age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our
age.agreeBefore.back: By continuing, you agree to our use of cookies.

migrate.body.text: 我们在这台设备上发现了游戏进度。同步到你的账户后，就能在所有设备上保存。
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We found the game progress on this device. Once synced to your account, it can be saved on all devices.

migrate.done.text: 已同步 12 张卡牌、4 项成就。

migrate.failed.text: 同步失败。你可以稍后再试。
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Sync failed. You can try again later.

pwa.install.text: 安装 Inspired Mile，获得最佳体验
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience

offline.banner.text: 你已离线：收藏和问答仍可使用。多人对战需要联网。
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: Collections and Q&A are still available. Multiplayer requires networking.

auth.signInIntro.text: 不用记密码。通行密钥让你用指纹、面容或屏幕锁登录。
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No need to remember passwords. Passkey lets you sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: 这个浏览器无法使用通行密钥。请改用邮件验证码登录。
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: Your browser does not support frames or is currently configured not to display frames.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: 这个浏览器无法使用通行密钥，而本站用通行密钥登录。请试试新版的 Chrome、Safari、Edge 或 Firefox。
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: Please try a new version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: 你的账户就是一个通行密钥，保存在这台设备或你的密码管理器里。我们不要姓名、邮箱，也不要密码。
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a passkey, stored on this device or in your password manager. We don’t need your name, email address, or password.

auth.createWarning.text: 如果你丢了通行密钥，我们就无法让你再进来。创建之后，请再添加一个通行密钥或一个邮箱，以便找回。
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your access key, we will not be able to let you in again. Once created, please add another access key or an email address so that it can be retrieved.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: 如果你丢了通行密钥，我们就无法让你再进来。创建之后，请再添加一个通行密钥，以便找回。
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your passkey, we will not be able to let you in again. Once created, please add another passkey so that it can be retrieved.

auth.nudgeBody.text: 目前只有一个通行密钥能进入这个账户。它丢了，账户也就丢了。请再添加一个通行密钥或一个邮箱，以便找回。
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: Currently, only one passkey can access this account. If it is lost, the account will be lost as well. Please add another passkey or an e-mail address in order to retrieve it.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: 目前只有一个通行密钥能进入这个账户。它丢了，账户也就丢了。请再添加一个通行密钥，以便找回。
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: Currently, only one passkey can access this account. If it is lost, the account will be lost as well. Please add another passkey in order to retrieve it.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: 可以用另一台设备、密码管理器或安全密钥。
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: You can use another device, a password manager or a security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: 一个通行密钥是你唯一的入口。请再添加一个通行密钥或一个邮箱，以便找回。
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: A passkey is your only access. Please add another passkey or an email address in order to retrieve it.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: 一个通行密钥是你唯一的入口。请再添加一个通行密钥，以便找回。
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: A passkey is your only entry. Please add another passkey in order to retrieve it.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: 我们已向 a@example.com 发送了 6 位验证码。请输入验证码，确认这个地址是你的。
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We've sent a 6-digit verification code to a@example.com. Enter the verification code to confirm that this address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: 邮箱已添加。现在你可以用发到这个邮箱的验证码登录。
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: The email address has been added. You can now log in with the verification code sent to this email address.

auth.emailHint.text: 这台设备上没有你的通行密钥？如果账户里有邮箱，可以用邮箱登录。
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Does this device not have your passkey? If the account has an e-mail address, you can log in with it.

auth.emailIntro.text: 我们会给你发一个 6 位验证码。如果是新地址，验证码会为你创建账户。
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit verification code, which will be used to create an account for you if your email address is new.

auth.codeIntro.text: 我们已向 a@example.com 发送了 6 位验证码。验证码只能用一次，10 分钟后失效。
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We have sent a 6-digit verification code to a@example.com. The verification code can only be used once and expires after 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: 新的验证码已发出。旧的已经失效。
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new verification code has been issued. The old one has expired.

auth.legalBefore.text: 登录即表示你同意我们的
auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: By logging in, you agree to our

auth.offerHeading.text: 为这台设备添加通行密钥
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey for this device

auth.offerBody.text: 下次就能用指纹、面容或屏幕锁登录。不用验证码，也不用等邮件。
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time you can log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No verification code, no waiting for emails.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: 还没有通行密钥。添加一个，就能不用邮件验证码登录。
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There is no passkey yet. Adding one allows you to log in without an email authentication code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: 通行密钥已添加。今后可以用它登录。
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: A passkey has been added. You can use it to log in from now on.

auth.passkeyRemoveConfirm.back: Are you sure of the removal?

auth.passkeyRemoved.back: The access key has been removed.

auth.error.age_required.text: 请先在首页确认你的年龄。账户仅面向 13 岁及以上的玩家。
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please first confirm your age on the home page.Accounts are only available to players aged 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: 这个地址已属于另一个账户。请退出登录，再用它登录。
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: This address already belongs to another account. Please log out and log in again with it.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: 这个账户已经有邮箱地址了。
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: 这看起来不像邮箱地址。
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: This does not look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: 验证码不正确，或已过期。请核对一下，或重新发送。
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The verification code is incorrect or has expired. Please check it or resend it.

auth.error.code_incomplete.text: 请输入完整的 6 位验证码。
auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Please enter the complete 6-digit verification code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: 请求验证码的次数太多。请等几分钟再试。
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Verification code requested too many times. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: 邮件没能发出。请稍后再试。
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: 这个浏览器无法使用通行密钥。
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: Your browser does not support the audio element.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: 没有使用通行密钥。准备好后请再试。
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No passkey was used. Please try again when you are ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: 这个通行密钥未被接受。请用邮件验证码登录，然后添加新的通行密钥。
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: This passkey has not been accepted. Please log in with the email verification code and add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: 通行密钥没有起作用。请再试一次。
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The passkey did not work. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: 这台设备上已经有你账户的通行密钥。
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has the passkey for your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: 这个通行密钥已经登记过了。
auth.error.passkey_already_registered.back: This access key has already been registered.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: 这个通行密钥没能添加。请再试一次。
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: This passkey could not be added. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: 这个账户的通行密钥已达上限。请先移除一个。
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: The access key for this account has reached its limit. Please remove one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: 这个通行密钥是你唯一的登录方式。移除之前请先添加另一个。
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is your only way to log in. Please add another one before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: 你的会话已结束。请重新登录。
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: 无法连接服务器。请检查网络后再试。
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your network and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: 出了点问题。请再试一次。
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: There was a problem. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: 三个回合，三种诗体。你的卡牌决定你的诗必须做到什么。对手就运行在你的浏览器里：你写的内容不会离开这台设备。
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three poetry styles. Your cards decide what your poem must do. The opponent runs in your browser: what you write doesn’t leave the device.

battle.prepareNote.text: 每个角色只能登台一次。圣物和药水要花墨水。
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can only be on stage once. Sacred objects and potions require ink.

battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: Choose the Best of Three

brain.checking.text: 正在检查这台设备能运行什么…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: 只需从 Hugging Face 下载一次，由你的浏览器保存。你写下或说出的内容不会发送到任何地方。
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Just download it once from Hugging Face and save it in your browser. What you write or say is not sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Gemma 已加载，正在这台设备上运行。
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Gemma 已加载到这台设备。它比较小：只负责评判，对手则出预先写好的诗。
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: Gemma has been loaded on this device. It is small: it only judges, and the opponents are given pre-written poems.

brain.failed.text: 模型无法在这台设备上启动。你仍然可以和预先写好诗句的对手对决。
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model cannot be started on this device. You can still play against opponents with pre-written poems.

brain.noModel.back: No models are used in the game.

brain.written.text: 正在与预先写好诗句的对手对决。
brain.written.back: You are playing against an opponent who has written a poem in advance.

brain.noWebgpu.text: 这个浏览器没有 WebGPU，所以对手出预先写好的诗，评判按规则进行。其余功能一切正常。
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: The browser does not have a WebGPU, so opponents are given pre-written poems and judged according to the rules.

brain.canRun.text: 这台设备可以在浏览器里运行 Gemma。第一次需要下载 3.1 GB，之后会保存下来。
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: The device can run Gemma in a browser. 3.1 GB is downloaded for the first time and then saved.

brain.summonLighter.text: 召唤 Gemma（3.1 GB）：下载量更小
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download
brain.summonLighter.back: Call of Gemma (3.1 GB): smaller download

hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet would have cursed his opponent's next poem, but this was the last round.

verdict.judgedCompare.back: Judged by Gemma on the device, the two poems were read in both orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.back: Judged by Gemma on the device, each poem was scored individually.

badge.writtenJudged.back: Pre-write the opponent's poem · Reviewed by Gemma

badge.written.back: The opponent of the pre-written poem

theatre.intro.text: 同样的对决，搬到环绕你的舞台上。指向或捏合来出牌，按下麦克风，吟出你的诗。转写和评判都在这台设备上完成。
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: Point or pinch to roll cards, press the microphone and sing your poem. Transcription and judging are done on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: 以透视模式打开，舞台就落在你的房间里。用手柄指向，或用手捏合。
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: Opened in perspective mode, the stage falls into your room. Point with a handle or pinch by hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: 以完整舞台打开。看着一张牌，然后捏合。visionOS 上的 Safari 不向网页提供透视模式。
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Open with the full stage. Look at a card, then fold it. Safari on visionOS does not provide perspective mode for web pages.

theatre.screenBody.text: 点击舞台上的卡牌和按钮，然后说或打字。
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, then speak or type.

theatre.running.text: Gemma 正在这台设备上运行。
theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.
theatre.running.back: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: 正在与预先写好诗句的对手对决。想在这里迎战模型，请先到对战页面召唤一个。
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: If you want to fight a model here, please go to the battle page and summon one first.

theatre.enterAr.text: 进入：舞台在你的房间里

theatre.declined.text: 这台设备拒绝了沉浸式会话。
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: The header session could not be started.

theatre.judgedModel.text: 由这台设备上的 Gemma 评判。
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Judged by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: 按规则评判：没有模型在运行。
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Judgment by rules: No models are running.

theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from the hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: 对你的诅咒：你用的词都不能超过5个字。
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: Curse on you: You can't use more than five words.

theatre.composingDraft.text: 正在作诗… 第 3 稿，共 3 稿

theatre.versePrompt.text: 你的诗会显示在这里。按下麦克风，一口气吟一行。
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your poem will appear here. Press the microphone and sing a line in one breath.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: 四行。最初の二行どうし、最後の二行どうしで韻を踏みます。
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines. The first two lines doshi and the last two lines doshi are used to rhyme.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: 四行。1行目は3行目と、2行目は4行目と韻を踏みます。
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four lines. The first line rhymes with the third line and the second line rhymes with the fourth line.

form.tercet.brief.text: 三行。最初の行と最後の行で韻を踏みます。
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines. The first line and the last line rhyme.

form.anaphora.brief.text: すべて同じ語で始まる三行。
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: All three lines begin with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: すべて同じ文字で始まる三行。
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: All three lines begin with the same letter.

form.acrostic.brief.text: 一文字につき一行。各行の最初の文字をつなぐと「骸骨」になるようにします。
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One line per character. Connect the first letters of each line to form a skeleton.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: 一語につき一行。各行を順に「骸骨」で始めます。
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One line per word. Each line begins with 'skeleton' in sequence.

form.crescendo.brief.text: 三行。あとの行ほど前の行より長くします。
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three rows. The next row is longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: すべて同じ語で終わる三行。
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: All three lines end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: すべて同じ文字で終わる三行。
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines all ending in the same letter.

form.haiku.brief.back: Three lines of five syllables, seven syllables and five syllables.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: 五・七・五の三行。音を数えられるよう、かなで書いてください。
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines of five, seven, and five. Write in kana so that you can count the notes.

form.heroic-couplet.name.text: ヒロイック・カプレット

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: それぞれ十音節ほどの、韻を踏む二行。シェイクスピアがソネットを結んだ形です。
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each. Shakespeare's form of a sonnet.

form.jueju.brief.text: 四行。すべて五字か、すべて七字。中国古典の絶句の形です。
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines. All five characters or all seven characters. The form of a sentence in the classical Chinese literature.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: 六音節の行、続いて八音節の行。二行目の六番目の音節が一行目の末尾と韻を踏みます。
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A six-syllable line followed by an eight-syllable line. The sixth syllable of the second line rhymes with the end of the first line.

check.rhyme.back: The first and second lines are rhymed.

check.same-opening.text: すべての行が同じ語で始まる
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All lines start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: すべての行が同じ文字で始まる
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: All lines start with the same character

check.same-ending.text: すべての行が同じ語で終わる
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: All lines end with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: すべての行が同じ文字で終わる
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: All lines end with the same character

check.spells.text: 最初の文字をつなぐと「骸骨」
check.spells.back: If you join the first letter, it's 'skeleton.'

check.spells.words.text: 各行が順に「骸骨」で始まる
check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull

check.growing.text: どの行も前の行より語数が多い
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each line has more words than the previous one.

check.growing.char.text: どの行も前の行より文字数が多い
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each line has more characters than the previous one.

check.jueju-length.text: すべての行が五字、またはすべての行が七字
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: All rows are five characters or all rows are seven characters

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: 両方の行の六番目の音節が韻を踏む
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: The sixth syllable of both lines rhymes.

device.question.brief.text: 問いを投げかけます。一行を疑問符で終えてください。
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: I'm asking you a question. Please end the line with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: 叫びます。一行を感嘆符で終えてください。
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Scream. End the line with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: 一行のなかで、三つの語を同じ文字で始めてください。
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: In a line, start three words with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: 力のある語をひとつ、三回くり返してください。
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a powerful word one or three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: 一行のなかで二つの語に韻を踏ませてください。
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two words in a line rhyme.

device.riposte.brief.text: 相手の直前の詩から3文字以上の語をひとつ取り、相手に投げ返してください。
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Take one word of three or more letters from the poem immediately before your opponent and throw it back to him.

device.brevity.brief.text: どの行も3語以内に収めてください。
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: Each line should be within three words.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: どの行も3文字以内に収めてください。
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: Each line should contain no more than three characters.

device.swell.brief.text: 最後の行をいちばん長くしてください。
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make the last line as long as possible.

device.balance.brief.text: すべての行を同じ語数にしてください。
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Make all lines have the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: すべての行を同じ文字数にしてください。
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Make all lines have the same number of characters.

device.ring.brief.text: 詩を、始めたときと同じ語で終えてください。
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: Please end the poem with the same words you started.

device.ring.brief.char.text: 詩を、始めたときと同じ文字で終えてください。
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: Please end the poem with the same letters as you started it.

device.invocation.brief.text: 登場人物を名前で呼んでください。
device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: 3文字以上の語を二つ使ってください。
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Please use two words of more than three letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: すべての行を同じ韻で終えてください。
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Please end every line with the same rhyme.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: あなたの詩に「の」の文字を使ってはいけません。
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: You should not use the letter 'no' in your poem.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: 相手は詩に「の」の文字を使えません。
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: The opponent cannot use the letter 'no' in a poem.

curse.short-words.brief.text: あなたは3文字を超える語を使えません。
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: You cannot use words longer than three letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: 相手は3文字を超える語を使えません。
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: Your opponent cannot use words longer than three letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: あなたは3文字以上の語を二度使えません。
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You can't use a word of more than three letters twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: 相手は3文字以上の語を二度使えません。
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: The opponent cannot use a word of more than three letters twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: あなたのどの行も3語を超えてはいけません。
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: Each of your lines must not exceed three words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: あなたのどの行も3文字を超えてはいけません。
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: Each of your lines must not exceed three characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: 相手のどの行も3語を超えてはいけません。
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: No line of your opponent can exceed three words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: 相手のどの行も3文字を超えてはいけません。
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: No line of the opponent can exceed 3 characters.

house.montague.why.text: マキューシオのよく回る舌は、行の途中で韻を踏みます。
house.montague.why.back: Makishio's often-turning tongue rhymes in the middle of a line.

house.verona-court.why.text: 宮廷は、あなたに向けられた言葉をひとつ残らず量ります。
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court will measure every word that is spoken to you.

house.the-tempest.why.text: 嵐は、砕けるまで高まりつづけます。
house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm continues to rise until it breaks.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Manは、ひとつの韻に乗って最後まで駆け抜けます。
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: The Sonnet Man runs through to the end on one rhyme.

house.lake-district.why.text: ロマン派の詩人たちは、一行一行を測って書きました。

house.gothic-circle.why.text: 物語は、始まった場所で終わります。
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.text: 神々は雷のような言葉で語ります。
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods speak with words like thunder.

house.underworld.why.text: 死者は、あなたの言ったことをすべて覚えています。
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you said.

footer.tagline.text: AIと拡張現実で動くデジタルコレクションカード。シェイクスピアを生き生きとよみがえらせるインタラクティブな体験。
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: A digital collector's card that moves with AI and augmented reality. An interactive experience that brings Shakespeare to life.

footer.privacy.text: プライバシーポリシー

age.intro.text: 続けるには年齢を確認してください。
age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.
age.intro.back: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.text: 生年月日をすべて選択してください。
age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.

age.minorTitle.text: 年齢の条件を満たしていません
age.minorTitle.back: You don't meet the age criteria.

age.minorBody.text: Inspired Mileは13歳以上の方がご利用いただけます。条件を満たしてから、またお越しください。
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: The Inspired Mile is open to guests over the age of 13. Please come back after meeting the requirements.

age.teenTitle.text: 保護者の同意が必要です
age.teenTitle.back: You need the consent of your guardian.

age.teenBody.text: 18歳未満の方がInspired Mileを利用するには、親または保護者の同意が必要です。
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: If you are under the age of 18, you must have your parent's or guardian's consent to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.text: 親または法定保護者が
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the

age.consentAfter.text: を確認し、私がInspired Mileを利用することに同意していることを確認します。
age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: I confirm that I agree to use the Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our

age.agreeAfter.text: に同意したものとみなされます。
age.agreeAfter.back: You are deemed to have agreed to the terms and conditions.

migrate.title.text: データを同期しますか？
migrate.title.back: Do you want to synchronize the data?

migrate.body.text: この端末に保存されたゲームの進行状況が見つかりました。アカウントに同期すると、どの端末でも引き継げます。
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: The progress of a game saved on this device has been found. If you synchronize it with your account, it will be available on any device.

migrate.done.text: カード12枚、実績4件を同期しました。
migrate.done.back: Twelve cards and four results have been synchronized.

migrate.failed.text: 同期できませんでした。あとでもう一度お試しください。
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.

pwa.install.text: Inspired Mileをインストールすると、より快適に楽しめます
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for a better experience

offline.banner.text: オフラインです。コレクションとクイズは引き続き使えます。マルチプレイにはインターネットが必要です。
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline. Collections and quizzes will still be available. Multiplayer requires an Internet connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: 覚えるパスワードはありません。パスキーなら、指紋・顔・画面ロックでサインインできます。
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No passwords to remember. With Paskey, you can sign in with your fingerprint, face and screen lock.

auth.passkeyButton.text: パスキーでサインイン

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: このブラウザではパスキーを使えません。メールで届くコードでサインインしてください。
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser does not support Passport keys. Please sign in with the code you received by email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: このブラウザではパスキーを使えませんが、このサイトはパスキーでサインインします。Chrome、Safari、Edge、Firefoxの最新版をお試しください。
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser does not support Passkeys, but this site uses them to sign in. Please try the latest versions of Chrome, Safari, Edge and Firefox.

auth.createButton.text: パスキーでアカウントを作成
auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: あなたのアカウントは、この端末またはパスワードマネージャーに保存されるパスキーです。名前もメールアドレスもパスワードもお尋ねしません。
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a passkey that will be stored on this terminal or in the password manager. You will not be asked for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: パスキーをなくすと、こちらで再びお通しすることはできません。作成後に、2つ目のパスキーかメールアドレスを追加して、戻れるようにしておいてください。
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you delete a passkey, you will not be able to use it again. After creating it, add a second passkey or an email address so that you can get back to it.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: パスキーをなくすと、こちらで再びお通しすることはできません。作成後に、2つ目のパスキーを追加して、戻れるようにしておいてください。
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you delete a passkey, it cannot be passed here again. After creating it, add a second passkey so that you can get back to it.

auth.createConfirm.text: アカウントを作成する

auth.nudgeHeading.text: アカウントの準備ができました

auth.nudgeBody.text: 今は、ひとつのパスキーだけがこのアカウントへの入口です。それをなくすと、アカウントも失われます。2つ目のパスキーかメールアドレスを追加して、戻れるようにしておいてください。
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: At the moment, there is only one passkey for this account. If you delete it, you will lose your account as well. Please add a second passkey or email address so that you can get back to it.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: 今は、ひとつのパスキーだけがこのアカウントへの入口です。それをなくすと、アカウントも失われます。2つ目のパスキーを追加して、戻れるようにしておいてください。
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: At the moment, there is only one passkey for this account. If you remove it, you will lose your account as well. Please add a second passkey so that you can get back to it.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: 別の端末、パスワードマネージャー、またはセキュリティキーを使ってください。
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Please use a different terminal, password manager or security key.

auth.nudgeEmail.text: 代わりにメールアドレスを追加

auth.recoveryWarning.text: ひとつのパスキーだけがあなたの入口です。2つ目のパスキーかメールアドレスを追加して、戻れるようにしておいてください。
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: There is only one passkey for you. Add a second passkey or an email address so that you can get back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: ひとつのパスキーだけがあなたの入口です。2つ目のパスキーを追加して、戻れるようにしておいてください。
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: There is only one passkey for your entrance. Add a second passkey so that you can return.

auth.recoveryEmailHeading.text: 復旧用メールアドレス

auth.addEmailButton.text: 復旧用メールアドレスを追加

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: a@example.com に6桁のコードを送りました。アドレスがご本人のものであることを確認するため、コードを入力してください。
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We have sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Please enter the code to verify that the address is yours.

auth.addEmailConfirm.text: メールアドレスを確認

auth.addEmailDone.text: メールアドレスを追加しました。今後は、そこに届くコードでサインインできます。
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: You have added an email address. From now on, you can sign in with the code sent to that address.

auth.emailButton.text: コードをメールで受け取る

auth.emailHint.text: パスキーのない端末をお使いですか？アカウントにメールアドレスがあれば、メールでサインインできます。
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Are you using a device without a passkey? If your account has an e-mail address, you can sign in with it.

auth.emailIntro.text: 6桁のコードをメールでお送りします。初めてのアドレスの場合は、そのコードでアカウントが作成されます。
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: A 6-digit code will be sent to you by email. If this is your first address, the code will be used to create an account.

auth.emailSend.text: コードをメールで受け取る

auth.codeIntro.text: a@example.com に6桁のコードを送りました。使えるのは一度だけで、10分で無効になります。
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: You have sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. You can only use it once and it will expire in 10 minutes.

auth.codeBack.text: 別のメールアドレスを使う

auth.codeResent.text: 新しいコードを送りました。以前のコードはもう使えません。
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: A new code has been sent. The old code is no longer available.

auth.legalBefore.text: サインインすることで、
auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our

auth.legalPrivacy.text: プライバシーポリシー

auth.legalAfter.text: に同意したものとみなされます。
auth.legalAfter.back: You are deemed to have agreed to the terms and conditions.

auth.offerHeading.text: この端末にパスキーを追加
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this terminal

auth.offerBody.text: 次回からは、指紋・顔・画面ロックでサインインできます。コードも、メールを待つ時間もいりません。
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: From now on, you can sign in with your fingerprint, face and screen lock. You don't have to wait for a code or an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: パスキーはまだありません。追加すると、メールのコードなしでサインインできます。
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: You do not have a passkey yet. If you add one, you will be able to sign in without an email code.

auth.passkeysAdd.text: パスキーをもうひとつ追加

auth.passkeyAdded.text: パスキーを追加しました。今後はこれでサインインできます。
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: You have added a passkey. This will be used to sign in from now on.

auth.passkeyRemoveConfirm.back: Do you want to delete it?

auth.passkeyRemoved.text: パスキーを削除しました。

auth.error.age_required.text: 先にホームページで年齢を確認してください。アカウントは13歳以上のプレイヤー向けです。
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please check your age on the homepage first. The account is for players over 13 years old.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: そのアドレスはすでに別のアカウントのものです。サインアウトして、そのアドレスでサインインしてください。
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: The address already belongs to another account. Please log out and sign in with that address.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: このアカウントにはすでにメールアドレスがあります。
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: 完了できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.
auth.error.signup_retry.back: Could not complete. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: メールアドレスの形式ではないようです。
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It does not appear to be the format of an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: コードが正しくないか、期限が切れています。確認するか、新しいコードを送ってください。
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is either incorrect or has expired. Please check it or send a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.text: コードの6桁をすべて入力してください。
auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Please enter all six digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: コードの要求が多すぎます。数分待ってから、もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many code requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.text: 現在、メールは利用できません。
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.back: Mail is not available at the moment.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: メールを送信できませんでした。少ししてから、もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: このブラウザではパスキーを使えません。
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: This browser does not support pascal keys.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: パスキーは使われませんでした。準備ができたら、もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: The paskey was not used. Please try again when you are ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: そのパスキーは受け付けられませんでした。メールのコードでサインインしてから、新しいパスキーを追加してください。
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: The passkey was not accepted. Please sign in with the code from your email and add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: パスキーがうまく動作しませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The pascal key did not work properly. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: この端末には、すでにあなたのアカウントのパスキーがあります。
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This terminal already has the passkey for your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: そのパスキーはすでに登録されています。

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: そのパスキーを追加できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Could not add that passkey. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: このアカウントのパスキーは上限に達しています。先にひとつ削除してください。
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: The password key limit for this account has been reached. Delete one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: このパスキーが唯一のサインイン手段です。削除する前に、別のパスキーを追加してください。
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is the only way to sign in. Add another passkey before deleting it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: 時間がかかりすぎました。もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: セッションが終了しました。もう一度サインインしてください。
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

auth.error.network.text: サーバーに接続できませんでした。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Could not connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: 問題が発生しました。もう一度お試しください。
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: There was a problem. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: 三つのラウンド、三つの詩形。カードが、あなたの詩のなすべきことを決めます。対戦相手はあなたのブラウザの中で動きます。書いたものがこの端末の外に出ることはありません。
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three poems. The cards decide what your poem should do. Your opponent moves inside your browser. What you write never leaves this terminal.

battle.prepareNote.text: 登場人物はそれぞれ一度だけ舞台に立てます。遺物と薬にはインクが必要です。
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character appears on the stage only once. Relics and medicine require ink.

battle.difficulty.apprentice.text: 見習い：下書きをひとつ書く

battle.difficulty.player.text: 役者：二つの下書きから良いほうを選ぶ
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: Choose the better of the two sketches.

battle.difficulty.master.text: 名人：三つの下書きから最良を選ぶ
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: Choose the best of three sketches

brain.checking.text: この端末で何を動かせるか確認しています…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what can be run on this device...

brain.playNow.text: ダウンロードせずに今すぐプレイ

brain.kept.text: Hugging Face からのダウンロードは一度だけで、ブラウザに保存されます。書いた内容や話した内容は、どこにも送信されません。
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Downloads from Hugging Face are saved in your browser only once. What you write or speak is not sent anywhere.

brain.summoning.text: 対戦相手を召喚しています…

brain.downloading.text: Gemmaをダウンロード中：512 / 3 MB

brain.loaded.text: Gemmaを読み込み、この端末で動かしています。
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: I'm loading Gemma and running it on this terminal.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Gemmaをこの端末に読み込みました。小さなモデルなので詩の審査だけを行い、相手はあらかじめ書かれた詩を出します。
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: I loaded Gemma into this terminal. It's a small model, so it only reviews poems and the contestant submits a pre-written poem.

brain.failed.text: この端末ではモデルを起動できませんでした。あらかじめ書かれた詩を出す相手とは対戦できます。
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model could not be started on this terminal. You can play against a pre-written poem.

brain.noModel.text: モデルなしでプレイします。

brain.written.text: あらかじめ書かれた詩を出す相手と対戦します。
brain.written.back: You play against someone who has written a poem in advance.

brain.noWebgpu.text: このブラウザにはWebGPUがないため、相手はあらかじめ書かれた詩を出し、審査は規則で行います。そのほかはすべて動作します。
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: Because this browser does not have a WebGPU, the recipient will submit a pre-written poem and it will be judged according to rules. Everything else will work.

brain.canRun.text: この端末はGemmaをブラウザで動かせます。初回のみ3.1 GBのダウンロードが必要で、以後は保存されます。
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This terminal allows Gemma to run in a browser. It requires only an initial download of 3.1 GB, which will be saved afterwards.

brain.summonLighter.text: Gemmaを召喚（3.1 GB）：より軽いダウンロード
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: あらかじめ書かれた詩を出す相手と対戦します。ページを再読み込みすれば、いつでもモデルを召喚できます。
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: Play against a pre-written poem. Reload the page and you can summon a model at any time.

round.device.text: Ariel：叫びます。一行を感嘆符で終えてください。
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Screaming. Please end the line with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamletがあなたに呪い「Ariel」をかけました：あなたは5文字を超える語を使えません。
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet has cursed you with 'Ariel': You can't use more than five letters in a word.

round.composingDraft.text: Hamletが詩を作っています… 下書き 3 / 3

round.items.text: 遺物と薬（それぞれインク1）

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…
round.versePlaceholder.back: A line of poetry in a line...

round.mustDo.text: あなたの詩がなすべきこと

round.deliberating.text: 審判が審議しています…

round.seedNote.text: シードとデッキが同じなら、同じ詩形が引かれます。
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: If the seed and deck are the same, draw the same poem.

hand.lends.text: 貸してくれる言葉：骸骨、冗談、墓
hand.lends.back: Words to borrow: skeleton, joke, tomb

hand.curses.text: 相手にかける呪い：あなたは5文字を超える語を使えません。
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curse on your opponent: You can't use more than five letters in a word.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamletが貸してくれる言葉：骸骨、冗談、墓。
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamletは相手の次の詩に呪いをかけます：あなたは5文字を超える語を使えません。
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses his opponent's next poem: You cannot use more than five letters in a word.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamletは相手の次の詩に呪いをかけるものですが、これが最後のラウンドです。
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet curses his opponent's next poem, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.text: その登場人物はあなたのデッキにいません。
illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: The character is not on your deck.

illegal.character-used.text: 登場人物が舞台に立てるのは、一試合に一度だけです。
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: The characters only appear on stage once per match.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.text: その遺物はあなたのデッキにありません。
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.text: その薬はあなたのデッキにありません。
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.back: The medicine isn't on your deck.

illegal.relic-spent.text: その遺物はもう使いました。

illegal.potion-spent.text: その薬はもう使いました。

live.chooseWho.text: だれが応じるかを選んでください。
live.chooseWho.back: Choose who you want to answer.

live.device.text: Ariel（技巧 +½）：叫びます。一行を感嘆符で終えてください。
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (Skill +½): Scream. End the line with an exclamation mark.

live.signature.text: シグネチャー（技巧 +½）：Hamletの台詞を、引用せずに響かせてください
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (Skill +½): Play a quote from Hamlet without quoting

live.power.text: 力の言葉（+2）：骸骨、冗談、墓 のうち二つを使う
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Power words (+2): Use two of skeleton, joke, tomb

live.powerUsed.text: 使った言葉：骸骨、冗談、墓

signature.none.text: このカードにはシグネチャーの台詞がありません
signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: This card doesn 't have a signature quote .

signature.hint.text: 次のどれかを響かせてください：骸骨、冗談、墓
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: Make one of the following sound: skeleton, joke, tomb

signature.quoted.text: そのまま引用しています。自分の行で響かせてください
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: I'm quoted as it is. Let me echo in your own line.

mic.transcribing.text: 文字に起こしています…

mic.heardNothing.text: 何も聞こえませんでした。もう一度どうぞ
mic.heardNothing.back: I couldn't hear anything. Please try again.

mic.failed.text: 文字に起こせませんでした

mic.none.text: ここにはマイクがありません

mic.loadingEar.text: 耳を読み込んでいます（75 MB、初回のみ）…
mic.loadingEar.back: Loading ears (75 MB, first time only)...

mic.loadingEarProgress.text: 耳を読み込んでいます：40%

mic.earFailed.text: 耳を読み込めませんでした

mic.listening.text: 聞いています… タップで停止

mic.denied.text: マイクが許可されていません

verdict.roundYours.text: このラウンドはあなたのものです。

verdict.roundTheirs.text: Hamletがこのラウンドを取りました。

verdict.judgedCompare.text: この端末上のGemmaが、二つの詩を両方の順番で読んで審査しました。
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Gemma on this terminal reviewed the two poems in order.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: この端末上のGemmaが、詩をひとつずつ採点して審査しました。
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Gemma on this terminal scored the poems one by one.

verdict.judgedRules.text: モデルが動いていないため、規則（多様さ、引喩、響き、切り返し）で審査しました。
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: Since the model is not moving, it was evaluated by rules (variety, metaphor, resonance, turning).

end.won.text: あなたが決闘に勝ちました。

end.lost.text: 今宵の舞台は相手のものです。

end.tally.text: ラウンド：あなた 2、相手 1。あなたの合計：3。

badge.onDevice.back: Gemma, it's working on this device.

badge.writtenJudged.text: 書かれた詩を出す相手・審査はGemma
badge.writtenJudged.back: The person to submit the poems and judge them is Gemma.

badge.written.text: 書かれた詩を出す相手
badge.written.back: The person to whom the poem is written.

theatre.intro.text: 同じ決闘を、あなたを囲む舞台の上で。指し示すかつまむ動作でカードを出し、マイクを押して詩を詠んでください。文字起こしも審査も、この端末で行います。
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: Play the same duel on a stage surrounding you. Use your fingers to point and flick cards, press the microphone to sing a poem, and this terminal will be used for spelling and judging.

theatre.questBody.text: パススルーで開くので、舞台があなたの部屋に現れます。コントローラーで指すか、手でつまんでください。
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: It opens by passthrough, so the stage appears in your room. Point with the controller or grab it with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: 完全な舞台として開きます。カードを見て、指をつまんでください。visionOSのSafariは、ウェブページにパススルーを提供していません。
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Open as a full stage. Look at the card and grab your finger. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.

theatre.screenBody.text: 舞台上のカードやボタンをクリックし、話すか入力してください。
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards or buttons on the stage to speak or type.

theatre.running.text: Gemmaがこの端末で動いています。
theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.
theatre.running.back: Gemma is running on this terminal.

theatre.writtenHint.text: あらかじめ書かれた詩を出す相手と対戦します。ここでモデルと対戦するには、バトルページでモデルを召喚してください。
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: You play against a pre-written poem. To fight the model here, you must summon the model on the battle page.

theatre.enterAr.text: 入場：あなたの部屋に舞台を

theatre.inPassthrough.text: ヘッドセット内（パススルー）。

theatre.inFullStage.text: ヘッドセット内（完全な舞台）。

theatre.declined.text: この端末は没入型セッションを拒否しました。
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This terminal has refused an immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: ヘッドセットのセッションを開始できませんでした。
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: Could not start the headset session.

theatre.judgedModel.text: この端末上のGemmaが審査しました。
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Gemma on this terminal has approved.

theatre.judgedRules.text: 規則で審査しました。モデルは動いていません。
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Rules have been validated. The model is not moving.

theatre.micLoading.text: 耳を読み込んでいます…

theatre.pick.text: 手札から登場人物を選んでください。
theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from the cards in hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: あなたへの呪い：あなたは5文字を超える語を使えません。
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: Curse on you: You can't use more than five letters in a word.

theatre.composingDraft.text: 詩を作っています… 下書き 3 / 3

theatre.versePrompt.text: あなたの詩がここに表示されます。マイクを押し、ひと息に一行ずつ詠んでください。
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your poem will be displayed here. Press the microphone and sing one line at a time.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: 네 행: 앞의 두 행끼리, 뒤의 두 행끼리 운이 맞아요.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four Rows: Match the two rows in front and the two rows behind.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four lines: Line 1 is lucky with line 3, and line 2 is lucky with line 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: 세 행. 첫 행과 마지막 행의 운이 맞아요.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three rows, the first row and the last row are lucky.

form.anaphora.brief.text: 모두 같은 낱말로 시작하는 세 행.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three lines that all start with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: 모두 같은 글자로 시작하는 세 행.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three lines that all start with the same letter.

form.acrostic.brief.text: 글자마다 한 행씩: 각 행의 첫 글자를 이으면 해골이(가) 되어야 해요.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One line per letter: The first letter of each row must be a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: 낱말마다 한 행씩: 각 행이 차례대로 해골(으)로 시작해야 해요.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One line per word: Each line must start with a skull in turn.

form.crescendo.brief.text: 세 행. 뒤로 갈수록 앞 행보다 길어져요.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: It's three rows, the backward one is longer than the forward one.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: 모두 같은 낱말로 끝나는 세 행.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three lines all ending with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: 모두 같은 글자로 끝나는 세 행.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines all ending in the same letter.

form.haiku.brief.back: Five syllables, seven syllables, three rows of five syllables.

form.haiku.brief.char.back: Five, seven, three rows of five.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: 5음, 7음, 5음의 세 행. 소리를 셀 수 있도록 가나로 쓰세요.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines of 5 notes, 7 notes and 5 notes. Write the numbers so that you can count them.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: 각각 열 음절 안팎이고 운이 맞는 두 행. 셰익스피어가 소네트를 맺던 방식이에요.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: That's the way Shakespeare ended his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: 네 행. 모두 다섯 자이거나 모두 일곱 자인, 중국 고전 절구의 틀이에요.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines. All five characters or all seven characters, a template for Chinese classical carving.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: 여섯 음절 한 행, 그다음 여덟 음절 한 행. 둘째 행의 여섯째 음절이 첫 행의 끝과 운이 맞아요.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A row of six syllables, then a row of eight syllables. The sixth syllable in the second row matches the end of the first row.

check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All lines start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: All lines start with the same letter

check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: All lines end with the same word

check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: All lines end with the same letter

check.spells.back: After the first letter is a skull.

check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: Each row starts with a skull in turn

check.growing.text: 각 행이 앞 행보다 낱말이 많음
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each row has more words than the previous row

check.growing.char.text: 각 행이 앞 행보다 글자가 많음
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each row has more characters than the previous row

check.jueju-length.text: 모든 행이 다섯 자이거나, 모든 행이 일곱 자
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: All lines are five characters, or all lines are seven characters.

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: 두 행의 여섯째 음절끼리 운이 맞음
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: The sixth syllable of the two lines matches.

device.question.brief.text: 질문을 던지세요: 한 행을 물음표로 끝내세요.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: End one line with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Shout: End a line with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: 한 행 안에서 세 낱말을 같은 첫소리로 시작하세요.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words in a line with the same first sound.

device.repetition.brief.text: 힘 있는 낱말 하나를 세 번 되풀이하세요.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat one powerful word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: 한 행 안에서 두 낱말의 운을 맞추세요.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Match two words in a row.

device.riposte.brief.text: 상대의 직전 시에서 3글자 이상인 낱말 하나를 가져와 되돌려 주세요.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Return a word of three or more letters from your opponent's previous poem.

device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: Keep all lines shorter than three words.

device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: Keep all lines shorter than three characters.

device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make the last line as long as possible.

device.balance.brief.text: 모든 행의 낱말 수를 똑같이 맞추세요.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Match the number of words in all rows.

device.balance.brief.char.text: 모든 행의 글자 수를 똑같이 맞추세요.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Match the same number of characters in all rows.

device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End the poem with the word you started.

device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End the poem with the letter you started it with.

device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.
device.invocation.brief.back: Call the name of one character.

device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Write two words of at least three letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Finish all lines with the same luck.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: 내 시에 글자 ‘이’을(를) 쓸 수 없어요.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: I can't write the letter 'i' in my poem.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: 상대의 시에 글자 ‘이’을(를) 쓸 수 없어요.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: I can't write the letter 'i' in someone else's poem.

curse.short-words.brief.text: 내 낱말은 어느 것도 3글자를 넘을 수 없어요.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: None of my words can be longer than three letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: 상대의 낱말은 어느 것도 3글자를 넘을 수 없어요.
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: None of his words can be longer than three letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: 나는 3글자 이상인 낱말을 두 번 쓸 수 없어요.
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: I can't write words of more than three letters twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: 상대는 3글자 이상인 낱말을 두 번 쓸 수 없어요.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: You can't use a word of more than three letters twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: 내 행은 어느 것도 3낱말을 넘을 수 없어요.
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: None of my lines can exceed three words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: 내 행은 어느 것도 3자를 넘을 수 없어요.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: None of my lines can exceed three characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: 상대의 행은 어느 것도 3낱말을 넘을 수 없어요.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: None of the opponent's lines can exceed three words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: 상대의 행은 어느 것도 3자를 넘을 수 없어요.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: None of your opponent's rows can exceed three.

house.montague.why.text: 머큐시오의 재빠른 혀는 행 한가운데서 운을 맞춰요.
