house.montague.why.back: Mercutio's quick tongue catches luck in the middle of a row.

house.verona-court.why.text: 궁정은 당신에게 던져진 말 한 마디 한 마디를 저울질해요.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word thrown at you.

house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm gets bigger until it breaks.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Man은 한 가지 운을 끝까지 타고 가요.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: Sonnet Man rides one luck to the end.

house.lake-district.why.text: 낭만파 시인들은 모든 행을 재어 썼어요.

house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it started.

house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.

house.underworld.why.text: 죽은 자들은 당신이 한 말을 모두 기억해요.
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you said.

footer.tagline.text: AI와 증강 현실로 움직이는 디지털 수집 카드. 셰익스피어를 되살리는 인터랙티브 경험.
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital collectible cards that move with AI and augmented reality. An interactive experience that brings Shakespeare to life.

age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.
age.intro.back: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Please select all the dates of birth.

age.minorBody.text: Inspired Mile은 만 13세 이상부터 이용할 수 있어요. 나이 조건이 되면 다시 찾아와 주세요.
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be 13 years of age or older to use the Inspired Mile.

age.teenBody.text: 만 18세 미만이므로 Inspired Mile을 이용하려면 부모님이나 보호자의 동의가 필요해요.
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: You are under the age of 18 and require parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the

age.consentAfter.text: 을(를) 읽었으며 제가 Inspired Mile을 이용하는 데 동의했음을 확인합니다.
age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: I have read and agree to use Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our

migrate.body.text: 이 기기에 저장된 게임 진행 기록을 찾았어요. 계정에 동기화하면 모든 기기에서 이어갈 수 있어요.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: I've found game progress on this device. Sync it to your account so you can continue on all your devices.

migrate.failed.text: 동기화하지 못했어요. 나중에 다시 시도할 수 있어요.
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Failed to sync. You can try again later.

pwa.install.text: Inspired Mile을 설치하면 더 편하게 즐길 수 있어요
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile to make it easier

offline.banner.text: 오프라인이에요. 컬렉션과 퀴즈는 계속 쓸 수 있어요. 멀티플레이는 인터넷이 필요해요.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: It's offline, but you can still use the collection and quizzes. Multiplayer requires an internet connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: 외울 비밀번호가 없어요. 패스키를 쓰면 지문, 얼굴 또는 화면 잠금으로 로그인해요.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: You don't have to remember a password. Use your passkey to sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: 이 브라우저는 패스키를 쓸 수 없어요. 이메일로 받은 코드로 로그인하세요.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser cannot write passkeys. Please log in with the code you received by email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: 이 브라우저는 패스키를 쓸 수 없는데, 이 사이트는 패스키로 로그인해요. 최신 버전의 Chrome, Safari, Edge 또는 Firefox를 써 보세요.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser can't write passkeys, but this site logs in with passkeys. Try the latest version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: 계정은 이 기기나 비밀번호 관리자에 저장되는 패스키예요. 이름도, 이메일도, 비밀번호도 묻지 않아요.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a passkey that's stored on this device or in your password manager. We don't ask for your name, email address or password.

auth.createWarning.text: 패스키를 잃어버리면 다시 들여보내 드릴 방법이 없어요. 만든 뒤에 두 번째 패스키나 이메일을 추가해 두면 다시 들어올 수 있어요.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your passkey, there's no way we can send it back to you. You can add a second passkey or email after you create it.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: 패스키를 잃어버리면 다시 들여보내 드릴 방법이 없어요. 만든 뒤에 두 번째 패스키를 추가해 두면 다시 들어올 수 있어요.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your pass, there's no way we can let you in again. You can add a second pass after you have created it.

auth.nudgeBody.text: 지금은 패스키 하나가 이 계정으로 들어오는 유일한 길이에요. 그것을 잃으면 계정도 잃어요. 두 번째 패스키나 이메일을 추가해 두면 다시 들어올 수 있어요.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: Now, one passkey is the only way to get into this account. If you lose it, you'll lose your account as well, but if you add a second passkey or email, you can get back in.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: 지금은 패스키 하나가 이 계정으로 들어오는 유일한 길이에요. 그것을 잃으면 계정도 잃어요. 두 번째 패스키를 추가해 두면 다시 들어올 수 있어요.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: Now, one passkey is the only way to get into this account. If you lose it, you'll lose your account, and if you add a second passkey, you can get back in.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: 다른 기기, 비밀번호 관리자 또는 보안 키를 쓰세요.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use a different device, password manager or security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: 패스키 하나가 유일한 로그인 수단이에요. 두 번째 패스키나 이메일을 추가해 두면 다시 들어올 수 있어요.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: One passcode is your only way to log in, so you can add a second passcode or email to get back in.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: 패스키 하나가 유일한 로그인 수단이에요. 두 번째 패스키를 추가해 두면 다시 들어올 수 있어요.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: One passkey is the only way to log in, so add a second passkey and you'll be back.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: a@example.com(으)로 6자리 코드를 보냈어요. 주소가 본인 것인지 확인하도록 코드를 입력해 주세요.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: I've sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Please enter the code to verify that this is your address.

auth.addEmailDone.text: 이메일을 추가했어요. 이제 그 주소로 받은 코드로 로그인할 수 있어요.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: I've added an email address and can now sign in with the code sent to that address.

auth.emailHint.text: 패스키가 없는 기기인가요? 계정에 이메일이 있다면 이메일로 로그인하세요.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: If you have an email in your account, log in with it.

auth.emailIntro.text: 6자리 코드를 이메일로 보내 드려요. 처음 쓰는 주소라면 그 코드로 계정이 만들어져요.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit code by email, which will be used to create your account if this is the first time you use it.

auth.codeIntro.text: a@example.com(으)로 6자리 코드를 보냈어요. 한 번만 쓸 수 있고 10분 뒤에 만료돼요.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: I sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, it's one-time and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: 새 코드를 보냈어요. 이전 코드는 더 이상 쓸 수 없어요.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: We've sent you a new code. You can't use the old one anymore.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our

auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device

auth.offerBody.text: 다음부터는 지문, 얼굴 또는 화면 잠금으로 로그인하세요. 코드도, 이메일을 기다릴 일도 없어요.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: From now on, you can sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock — no more waiting for codes or emails.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: 아직 패스키가 없어요. 하나 추가하면 이메일 코드 없이 로그인할 수 있어요.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: I don't have a passkey yet, add one to log in without an email code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: 패스키를 추가했어요. 이제부터 이 패스키로 로그인할 수 있어요.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: I've added a passkey. You can now log in with it.

auth.error.age_required.text: 먼저 홈 화면에서 나이를 확인해 주세요. 계정은 만 13세 이상 플레이어를 위한 것이에요.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please first check your age on the home screen. The account is for players over 13 years old.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: 그 주소는 이미 다른 계정의 것이에요. 로그아웃한 뒤 그 주소로 로그인하세요.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: The address already belongs to another account. Sign out and then sign in with that address.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: 이 계정에는 이미 이메일 주소가 있어요.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.
auth.error.signup_retry.back: We couldn't handle it, please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: 코드가 틀렸거나 만료됐어요. 다시 확인하거나 새 코드를 받으세요.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect or expired. Please check again or get a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Please enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: 코드를 너무 많이 요청했어요. 몇 분 기다렸다가 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: I requested too many codes. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.back: I can't write emails right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: 이메일을 보내지 못했어요. 잠시 뒤에 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: The email could not be sent, please try again later.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: 이 브라우저는 패스키를 쓸 수 없어요.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: Your browser does not support frames.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: 패스키를 쓰지 않았어요. 준비되면 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: I didn't use a passkey. Please try again when you are ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: 그 패스키는 받아들여지지 않았어요. 이메일 코드로 로그인한 뒤 새 패스키를 추가하세요.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: The passkey was not accepted. Please log in with your email code and add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: 패스키가 작동하지 않았어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The passkey did not work, please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: 이 기기에는 이미 내 계정의 패스키가 있어요.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a passkey for my account.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: 그 패스키를 추가하지 못했어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Unable to add that passkey. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: 이 계정은 패스키를 더 가질 수 없어요. 먼저 하나를 삭제하세요.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account cannot have more passkeys. Please delete one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: 이 패스키가 유일한 로그인 수단이에요. 삭제하기 전에 다른 패스키를 추가하세요.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This passkey is your only means of signing in. Add another passkey before deleting it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: 시간이 너무 오래 걸렸어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long, please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: 서버에 연결하지 못했어요. 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도해 주세요.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: We have a problem, please try again.

battle.intro.text: 세 라운드, 세 가지 형식. 카드가 내 시가 해내야 할 일을 정해요. 상대는 내 브라우저 안에서 움직여요. 쓴 글은 이 기기 밖으로 나가지 않아요.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three formats. The cards decide what my poem needs to do. My opponent moves inside my browser. What I write doesn't leave this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: 등장인물은 저마다 한 번만 무대에 오를 수 있어요. 유물과 물약은 잉크가 들어요.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can only be on stage once, and the artifacts and potions use ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: 배우: 초안 둘 중 나은 것을 골라요
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: Choose the better of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: 거장: 초안 셋 중 가장 좋은 것을 골라요
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: Choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: 이 기기에서 무엇을 돌릴 수 있는지 확인하는 중…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what can be played on this device...

brain.kept.text: Hugging Face에서 한 번 다운로드하면 브라우저가 보관해요. 쓰거나 말한 내용은 어디로도 전송되지 않아요.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Once you download it from Hugging Face, it's stored in your browser. What you write or say isn't sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Gemma을(를) 불러와 이 기기에서 실행 중이에요.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Get Gemma and run it on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Gemma을(를) 이 기기에 불러왔어요. 작은 모델이라 시를 심사만 하고, 상대는 미리 쓰인 시를 내요.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: I'm bringing Gemma to this device. She's a small model, so you just review the poem, and your opponent gives you a pre-written one.

brain.failed.text: 이 기기에서 모델을 시작하지 못했어요. 그래도 미리 쓰인 시를 내는 상대와 겨룰 수 있어요.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: I couldn't start a model on this device, but I can still compete with an opponent who makes a pre-written poem.

brain.written.text: 미리 쓰인 시를 내는 상대와 겨뤄요.

brain.noWebgpu.text: 이 브라우저에는 WebGPU가 없어서 상대는 미리 쓰인 시를 내고 심사는 규칙으로 해요. 나머지는 모두 작동해요.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser doesn't have a WebGPU, so the opponent puts in a pre-written poem and rules are used for judging.

brain.canRun.text: 이 기기는 브라우저에서 Gemma을(를) 돌릴 수 있어요. 처음에 3.1 GB를 다운로드하면 그 뒤로는 보관돼요.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in a browser. You download 3.1 GB initially, and you'll keep it after that.

brain.summonLighter.text: Gemma 소환 (3.1 GB): 더 가벼운 다운로드
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: 미리 쓰인 시를 내는 상대와 겨뤄요. 페이지를 새로 고치면 언제든 모델을 소환할 수 있어요.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: Refresh the page and you'll be able to summon a model at any time.

round.device.text: Ariel: 외치세요: 한 행을 느낌표로 끝내세요.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Exclaim: End one line with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet이(가) 저주 ‘Ariel’을(를) 걸었어요: 내 낱말은 어느 것도 5글자를 넘을 수 없어요.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet casts the curse 'Ariel': None of my words can exceed five letters.

round.composingDraft.back: Hamlet is writing a poem... Draft 3/3

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…

round.mustDo.back: What my poetry needs to do

round.seedNote.text: 시드와 덱이 같으면 같은 형식이 뽑혀요.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: If the seed and deck match, you'll get the same format.

hand.lends.text: 빌려주는 낱말: 해골, 농담 및 무덤
hand.lends.back: Borrowing Words: Skulls, Jokes and Tombs

hand.curses.text: 상대에게 거는 저주: 내 낱말은 어느 것도 5글자를 넘을 수 없어요.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: A curse on your opponent: None of my words can exceed five letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet이(가) 빌려주는 낱말: 해골, 농담 및 무덤.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Words borrowed by Hamlet: skull, joke and tomb.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet이(가) 상대의 다음 시에 저주를 걸어요: 내 낱말은 어느 것도 5글자를 넘을 수 없어요.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses his opponent's next poem: None of my words may exceed five letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet은(는) 상대의 다음 시에 저주를 걸 수 있지만, 지금이 마지막 라운드예요.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet can cast a curse on his opponent's next poem, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: That character isn't in my deck.

illegal.character-used.text: 등장인물은 한 경기에서 한 번만 무대에 오를 수 있어요.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Characters can only step on stage once per game.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: That artefact isn't on my deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.

illegal.relic-spent.back: The artefact has already been written.

live.device.text: Ariel (기교 +½): 외치세요: 한 행을 느낌표로 끝내세요.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (Skill +½): Shout: End one line with an exclamation mark.

live.signature.text: 시그니처 (기교 +½): Hamlet의 대사를 인용하지 말고 떠올리게 하세요
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (Skill +½): Don't quote Hamlet's words, but make them come to mind

live.power.text: 힘의 낱말 (+2): 해골, 농담 및 무덤 중 두 개를 쓰세요
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Words of Power (+2): Use two of Skull, Joke and Tomb

live.powerUsed.text: 쓴 낱말: 해골, 농담 및 무덤
live.powerUsed.back: Written Word: Skulls, Jokes and Tombs

signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: This card doesn't have a signature line.

signature.hint.text: 다음 중 하나를 떠올리게 하세요: 해골, 농담 및 무덤
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: Remind me of one of the following: skulls, jokes and tombs

signature.quoted.text: 그대로 인용했어요. 내가 지은 행으로 떠올리게 해야 해요
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: I'm quoted exactly. You have to think of it as a line that I wrote.

signature.echoed.back: It reminded me of a skull.

mic.heardNothing.text: 아무것도 못 들었어요. 다시 해 보세요

mic.earFailed.back: I couldn't get my ears out.

verdict.judgedCompare.text: 이 기기에서 Gemma이(가) 두 시를 두 가지 순서로 읽고 심사했어요.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: On this device, Gemma read and reviewed two poems in two different orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: 이 기기에서 Gemma이(가) 시를 하나씩 따로 채점해 심사했어요.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: On this device, Gemma scored the poems one by one.

verdict.judgedRules.text: 실행 중인 모델이 없어서 규칙(다양성, 인유, 소리, 되받아치기)으로 심사했어요.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: We didn't have a running model, so we judged by rules (variety, manpower, sounds, replay).

badge.writtenJudged.text: 미리 쓰인 시를 내는 상대 · 심사 Gemma
badge.writtenJudged.back: Contestant with pre-written poems · Judge Gemma

theatre.intro.text: 같은 결투를, 나를 둘러싼 무대에서. 가리키거나 손가락을 집어 카드를 내고, 마이크를 누르고 시를 읊으세요. 이 기기에서 받아 적고 심사해요.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on the stage surrounding me. Point or pick up your finger to take out a card, press the microphone and sing a poem.

theatre.questBody.text: 패스스루로 열려서 무대가 내 방 안에 놓여요. 컨트롤러로 가리키거나 손으로 집으세요.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: It opens through a pass-through, so the stage is in my room. Point with your controller or grab it with your hand.

theatre.visionBody.text: 전체 무대로 열려요. 카드를 바라보고 손가락을 집으세요. visionOS의 Safari는 웹 페이지에 패스스루를 제공하지 않아요.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Look at the card and pick up your finger. Safari on visionOS doesn’t provide a passthrough to web pages, so you don’t have to do anything else.

theatre.screenBody.text: 무대 위의 카드와 버튼을 클릭하고, 말하거나 입력하세요.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click, speak or type on the cards and buttons on stage.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.
theatre.running.back: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: 미리 쓰인 시를 내는 상대와 겨뤄요. 여기서 모델과 겨루려면 배틀 페이지에서 모델을 소환하세요.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: To compete with a model here, summon the model on the Battle page.

theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This device refused an immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: I could not start the headset session.

theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Reviewed by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: 규칙으로 심사했어요: 실행 중인 모델이 없어요.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Checked by rules: No models running.

theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character from the draw.

theatre.cursesYou.text: 내게 걸린 저주: 내 낱말은 어느 것도 5글자를 넘을 수 없어요.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: My curse: None of my words can be longer than five letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: 내 시가 여기에 나타나요. 마이크를 누르고 한 숨에 한 행씩 읊으세요.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: My poem will appear here. Press the microphone and sing one line at a time.

form.couplet.brief.text: Hai dòng hiệp vần với nhau.

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: Bốn dòng: hai dòng đầu hiệp vần, hai dòng cuối hiệp vần.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines: two lines at the beginning of the interpolation, two lines at the end.

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: Bốn dòng: dòng 1 vần với dòng 3, dòng 2 vần với dòng 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four lines: line 1 with line 3, line 2 with line 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: Ba dòng; dòng đầu và dòng cuối hiệp vần.
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines; first line and last line of the interjection.

form.anaphora.brief.text: Ba dòng đều mở đầu bằng cùng một từ.
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: All three lines start with the same word.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: Ba dòng đều mở đầu bằng cùng một chữ.
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: All three lines start with the same letter.

form.acrostic.brief.text: Mỗi chữ cái một dòng: các chữ cái đầu dòng phải ghép thành đầu lâu.
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: Each letter a line: the first letters of each line must be combined into a long head.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: Mỗi từ một dòng: các dòng phải lần lượt mở đầu bằng đầu lâu.
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: Each word a line: the lines must begin with a long initial in turn.

form.crescendo.brief.text: Ba dòng, dòng sau dài hơn dòng trước.
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three lines, the last one longer than the first.

form.epistrophe.brief.text: Ba dòng đều kết thúc bằng cùng một từ.
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: All three lines end with the same word.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: Ba dòng đều kết thúc bằng cùng một chữ.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: All three lines end with the same word.

form.haiku.brief.text: Ba dòng gồm 5, 7 và 5 âm tiết.
form.haiku.brief.back: The three lines consist of 5, 7 and 5 syllables.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Ba dòng gồm 5, 7 và 5 âm. Hãy viết bằng kana để đếm được số âm.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 syllables. Write in kana to count the syllables.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Hai dòng hiệp vần, mỗi dòng chừng mười âm tiết, như cách Shakespeare khép lại các bài sonnet.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two lines of interjections, each about ten syllables long, like the way Shakespeare closed his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Bốn dòng, tất cả năm chữ hoặc tất cả bảy chữ: dáng của bài tứ tuyệt cổ điển Trung Hoa.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines, all five letters or all seven letters: the style of classical Chinese quatrain.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Một dòng sáu tiếng, rồi một dòng tám tiếng mà tiếng thứ sáu hiệp vần với tiếng cuối dòng trên.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A sixth line, then an eighth line where the sixth is interspersed with the last note of the upper line.

check.same-opening.text: Mọi dòng mở đầu bằng cùng một từ
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: All lines start with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: Mọi dòng mở đầu bằng cùng một chữ
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: All lines start with the same word

check.same-ending.text: Mọi dòng kết thúc bằng cùng một từ
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: All lines end with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: Mọi dòng kết thúc bằng cùng một chữ
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: All lines end with the same word

check.spells.text: Các chữ cái đầu dòng ghép thành đầu lâu
check.spells.back: Initial letters assembled into long initials

check.spells.words.text: Các dòng lần lượt mở đầu bằng đầu lâu
check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull
check.spells.words.back: Lines in turn begin with a long header

check.growing.text: Dòng nào cũng nhiều từ hơn dòng trước
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each line has more words than the previous one .

check.growing.char.text: Dòng nào cũng nhiều chữ hơn dòng trước
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each line has more words than the previous one .

check.jueju-length.text: Mọi dòng đều năm chữ, hoặc mọi dòng đều bảy chữ
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: Each line is five letters, or each line is seven letters.

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: Tiếng thứ sáu của hai dòng hiệp vần
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes

device.question.brief.text: Hãy đặt một câu hỏi: kết một dòng bằng dấu chấm hỏi.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Let's ask a question: end a line with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: Hãy thốt lên: kết một dòng bằng dấu chấm than.
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Speak out: end a line with a dot.

device.alliteration.brief.text: Cho ba từ trong cùng một dòng bắt đầu bằng cùng một chữ cái.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Give three words in the same line that begin with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: Lặp lại ba lần một từ đắt giá.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat a precious word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: Cho hai từ hiệp vần ngay trong một dòng.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Give two words with the same syllable in one line.

device.riposte.brief.text: Lấy một từ có 3 chữ cái trở lên trong bài thơ vừa rồi của đối thủ mà ném trả lại.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Take a word of three letters or more in the opponent's previous poem and throw it back.

device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: No lines longer than three words.

device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.char.back: No lines longer than three words.

device.swell.brief.text: Cho dòng cuối là dòng dài nhất.
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Let the last line be the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: Cho mọi dòng cùng một số từ.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Give each line the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: Cho mọi dòng cùng một số chữ.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Give each line the same number of letters.

device.ring.brief.text: Kết bài thơ bằng chính từ đã mở đầu.
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: End the poem with the same words you started.

device.ring.brief.char.text: Kết bài thơ bằng chính chữ đã mở đầu.
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: End the poem with the words you started.

device.invocation.brief.text: Gọi đích danh một nhân vật.
device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: Dùng hai từ có 3 chữ cái trở lên.
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of three letters or more.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: Cho mọi dòng kết bằng cùng một vần.
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Give all lines the same ending.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: Bài thơ của bạn không được có chữ T.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: Your poem must not have a T.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: Bài thơ của đối thủ không được có chữ T.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: The opponent's poem must not have a T.

curse.short-words.brief.text: Không từ nào của bạn được dài quá 3 chữ cái.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: None of your words is longer than three letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: Không từ nào của đối thủ được dài quá 3 chữ cái.
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: None of the opponent's words are longer than three letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: Bạn không được dùng hai lần bất cứ từ nào có 3 chữ cái trở lên.
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You may not use any word with three letters or more twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: Đối thủ không được dùng hai lần bất cứ từ nào có 3 chữ cái trở lên.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: The opponent may not use any word of three letters or more twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: Không dòng nào của bạn được quá 3 từ.
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: No line of yours exceeds three words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: Không dòng nào của bạn được quá 3 chữ.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: No line of yours exceeds three words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: Không dòng nào của đối thủ được quá 3 từ.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: No line of the opponent exceeds three words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: Không dòng nào của đối thủ được quá 3 chữ.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: None of the opponent's lines exceed three words.

house.montague.why.text: Cái lưỡi nhanh nhảu của Mercutio gieo vần ngay giữa dòng.
house.montague.why.back: Mercutio's jumping tongue sows right in the middle of the line.

house.verona-court.why.text: Triều đình cân từng lời nói ra để chống lại bạn.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word it speaks against you.

house.the-tempest.why.text: Cơn bão lớn dần cho đến khi vỡ oà.
house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm grew stronger and stronger until it broke.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Man cưỡi một vần duy nhất đi đến cùng.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: Sonnet Man rides a single stroke to the end.

house.lake-district.why.text: Các nhà thơ Lãng mạn đong đếm từng dòng.

house.gothic-circle.why.text: Câu chuyện kết thúc ở nơi nó bắt đầu.
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.text: Các vị thần nói bằng những lời như sấm.
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods speak with words like thunder.

house.underworld.why.text: Người chết nhớ mọi điều bạn từng nói.
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you ever said.

nav.toggleAudio.back: Turns the sound on or off

footer.tagline.text: Thẻ bài sưu tầm kỹ thuật số với AI và thực tế tăng cường. Những trải nghiệm tương tác làm Shakespeare sống dậy.
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital collection cards with AI and augmented reality, interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.

age.title.text: Chào mừng đến với Inspired Mile

age.intro.text: Vui lòng xác nhận tuổi của bạn để tiếp tục.
age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.
age.intro.back: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.text: Vui lòng chọn đầy đủ ngày sinh.
age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Please select a complete date of birth.

age.minorBody.text: Bạn phải từ 13 tuổi trở lên mới dùng được Inspired Mile. Hãy quay lại khi bạn đủ tuổi.
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be 13 or older to use the Inspired Mile. Please come back when you're old enough.

age.teenTitle.text: Cần sự đồng ý của phụ huynh

age.teenBody.text: Vì bạn chưa đủ 18 tuổi, bạn cần cha mẹ hoặc người giám hộ đồng ý mới dùng được Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: Because you are under the age of 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.text: Tôi xác nhận cha mẹ hoặc người giám hộ hợp pháp của tôi đã đọc
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the
age.consentBefore.back: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has read

age.consentAfter.text: và đồng ý cho tôi dùng Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: And agreed to let me use the Inspired Mile.

age.teenContinue.text: Tiếp tục với sự đồng ý

age.agreeBefore.text: Khi tiếp tục, bạn đồng ý với
age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our

migrate.title.text: Đồng bộ dữ liệu của bạn?

migrate.body.text: Chúng tôi tìm thấy tiến trình chơi lưu trên thiết bị này. Hãy đồng bộ vào tài khoản để giữ nó trên mọi thiết bị.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We have found saved game progress on this device. Please sync your account to keep it on all devices.

migrate.done.text: Đã đồng bộ 12 thẻ bài và 4 thành tựu.

migrate.failed.text: Đồng bộ thất bại. Bạn có thể thử lại sau.
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Sync failed. You can try again later.

pwa.install.text: Cài đặt Inspired Mile để có trải nghiệm tốt nhất
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience

offline.banner.text: Bạn đang ngoại tuyến: Bộ sưu tập và Đố vui vẫn dùng được. Chế độ nhiều người chơi cần có mạng.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You are offline: Collection and Fun still available. Multiplayer mode requires a network connection.

auth.signInIntro.text: Không cần nhớ mật khẩu. Khoá truy cập cho bạn đăng nhập bằng vân tay, khuôn mặt hoặc khoá màn hình.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No need to remember passwords. Access lock allows you to log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

auth.passkeyButton.text: Đăng nhập bằng khoá truy cập

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Trình duyệt này không dùng được khoá truy cập. Hãy đăng nhập bằng mã gửi qua email.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser does not use access keys. Please log in with the password sent to you by email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Trình duyệt này không dùng được khoá truy cập, mà trang này lại đăng nhập bằng khoá truy cập. Hãy thử bản mới của Chrome, Safari, Edge hoặc Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser does not use access keys, and this site logs in with access keys. Try a newer version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

auth.createButton.text: Tạo tài khoản bằng khoá truy cập
auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey

auth.createIntro.text: Tài khoản của bạn là một khoá truy cập lưu trên thiết bị này hoặc trong trình quản lý mật khẩu. Chúng tôi không hỏi tên, email hay mật khẩu.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is an access key stored on this device or in the password manager. We do not ask for your name, email or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Nếu bạn làm mất khoá truy cập, chúng tôi không thể cho bạn vào lại. Sau bước này, hãy thêm một khoá thứ hai hoặc một email để còn đường quay lại.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your access key, we will not be able to re-enable you. After this step, please add a second key or an email so that we have a way back.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Nếu bạn làm mất khoá truy cập, chúng tôi không thể cho bạn vào lại. Sau bước này, hãy thêm một khoá thứ hai để còn đường quay lại.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose your access key, we will not be able to let you in again. After this step, add a second key so that there is a way back.

auth.nudgeHeading.text: Tài khoản của bạn đã sẵn sàng

auth.nudgeBody.text: Hiện giờ một khoá truy cập là lối duy nhất vào tài khoản này. Mất nó là mất tài khoản. Hãy thêm một khoá thứ hai hoặc một email để còn đường quay lại.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: An access key is currently the only way to access this account. Losing it means losing your account. Please add a second key or an email address so that you have a way back.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Hiện giờ một khoá truy cập là lối duy nhất vào tài khoản này. Mất nó là mất tài khoản. Hãy thêm một khoá thứ hai để còn đường quay lại.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: An access key is currently the only way to access this account. Losing it means losing your account. Please add a second key so that you have a way back.

auth.nudgePasskey.text: Thêm khoá truy cập thứ hai

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Dùng một thiết bị khác, trình quản lý mật khẩu hoặc khoá bảo mật.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use a different device, password manager or security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Một khoá truy cập là lối vào duy nhất của bạn. Hãy thêm một khoá thứ hai hoặc một email để còn đường quay lại.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: An access key is your only entry. Please add a second key or an email to have a way back.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Một khoá truy cập là lối vào duy nhất của bạn. Hãy thêm một khoá thứ hai để còn đường quay lại.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: An access key is your only entry. Add a second key so you have a way back.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Chúng tôi đã gửi mã 6 chữ số tới a@example.com. Hãy nhập mã để xác nhận địa chỉ này là của bạn.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We have sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Please enter the code to verify that this address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: Đã thêm email. Giờ bạn có thể đăng nhập bằng mã gửi tới địa chỉ đó.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email has been added. You can now log in with the code sent to that address.

auth.emailButton.text: Gửi mã cho tôi qua email

auth.emailHint.text: Đang dùng thiết bị không có khoá truy cập của bạn? Hãy đăng nhập qua email, nếu tài khoản có email.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Using a device that does not have your password? Please log in with email, if the account has email.

auth.emailIntro.text: Chúng tôi sẽ gửi cho bạn mã 6 chữ số. Nếu địa chỉ là mới, mã sẽ tạo tài khoản cho bạn.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a six-digit code. If the address is new, the code will create an account for you.

auth.emailSend.text: Gửi mã cho tôi qua email

auth.codeIntro.text: Chúng tôi đã gửi mã 6 chữ số tới a@example.com. Mã dùng được một lần và hết hạn sau 10 phút.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We sent a six-digit code to a@example.com. The code is one-time and expires after 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Mã mới đang được gửi đi. Mã cũ không còn dùng được.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: The new code is being sent out, the old one is no longer valid.

auth.legalBefore.text: Khi đăng nhập, bạn đồng ý với
auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our
auth.legalBefore.back: When logging in, you agree to .

auth.offerHeading.text: Thêm khoá truy cập cho thiết bị này
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add access key for this device

auth.offerBody.text: Lần sau, hãy đăng nhập bằng vân tay, khuôn mặt hoặc khoá màn hình. Không cần mã, không phải chờ email.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No code needed, no waiting for email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Chưa có khoá truy cập nào. Hãy thêm một khoá để đăng nhập mà không cần mã email.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There are no access keys. Please add a key to log in without an email password.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Đã thêm khoá truy cập. Từ giờ bạn có thể đăng nhập bằng khoá này.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: An access key has been added. You can log in with this key from now on.

auth.error.age_required.text: Vui lòng xác nhận tuổi ở trang chủ trước. Tài khoản dành cho người chơi từ 13 tuổi trở lên.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please confirm your age on the homepage first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Địa chỉ đó đã thuộc về một tài khoản khác. Hãy đăng xuất rồi đăng nhập bằng địa chỉ đó.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: That address already belongs to another account. Please log out and login with that address.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: Tài khoản này đã có địa chỉ email.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: Chưa thực hiện được. Vui lòng thử lại.
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.
auth.error.signup_retry.back: Not yet completed. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: Trông không giống một địa chỉ email.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Mã không đúng hoặc đã hết hạn. Hãy kiểm tra lại, hoặc gửi mã mới.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: Invalid or expired code. Please check again, or send a new code.

auth.error.code_incomplete.text: Hãy nhập đủ 6 chữ số của mã.
auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.error.code_incomplete.back: Please enter all six digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Đã yêu cầu quá nhiều mã. Hãy chờ vài phút rồi thử lại.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Chúng tôi không gửi được email. Vui lòng thử lại sau giây lát.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We were unable to send the email. Please try again in a second.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Trình duyệt này không dùng được khoá truy cập.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: This browser does not use access keys.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Chưa có khoá truy cập nào được dùng. Hãy thử lại khi bạn sẵn sàng.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No access key used. Please try again when you are ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Khoá truy cập đó không được chấp nhận. Hãy đăng nhập bằng mã email, rồi thêm một khoá mới.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: That access key is not accepted. Please log in with your email password, and add a new one.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: Khoá truy cập không hoạt động. Vui lòng thử lại.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The access lock is not working. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: Thiết bị này đã có khoá truy cập cho tài khoản của bạn.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has access to your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: Khoá truy cập đó đã được đăng ký.
auth.error.passkey_already_registered.back: That access key has been registered.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Không thêm được khoá truy cập đó. Vui lòng thử lại.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Could not add that access key. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: Tài khoản này đã có số khoá truy cập tối đa. Hãy gỡ bớt một khoá trước.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account already has the maximum number of access keys. Please remove one key first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Khoá truy cập này là cách đăng nhập duy nhất của bạn. Hãy thêm một khoá khác trước khi gỡ nó.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This access key is your only login. Please add another key before removing it.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: Mất quá nhiều thời gian. Vui lòng thử lại.
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long, please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: Phiên của bạn đã kết thúc. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

auth.error.network.text: Không kết nối được với máy chủ. Hãy kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your network and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: Đã có lỗi xảy ra. Vui lòng thử lại.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: An error has occurred. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: Ba hiệp, ba thể thơ. Lá bài của bạn quyết định bài thơ phải làm được gì. Đối thủ chạy ngay trong trình duyệt của bạn: không chữ nào bạn viết rời khỏi thiết bị này.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three verses, three poems. Your cards decide what the poem should do. The opponent runs right in your browser: no word you write leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Mỗi nhân vật chỉ được lên sân khấu một lần. Bảo vật và thuốc phép tốn mực.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can only be on stage once, and the artefacts and potions are expensive.

battle.difficulty.apprentice.text: Tập sự: viết một bản nháp

battle.difficulty.player.text: Diễn viên: chọn bản hay hơn trong hai bản nháp
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Actor: Choose the better of two sketches

battle.difficulty.master.text: Bậc thầy: chọn bản hay nhất trong ba bản nháp
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Master: Choose the best of three sketches

battle.noWorldCard.text: Không dùng lá bài thế giới

brain.checking.text: Đang kiểm tra xem thiết bị này chạy được gì…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: Tải một lần từ Hugging Face và được trình duyệt giữ lại. Những gì bạn viết hoặc nói không bị gửi đi đâu cả.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Download once from Hugging Face and your browser will keep it. What you write or say is not sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Gemma đã được tải và đang chạy trên thiết bị này.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Gemma has been downloaded and is running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Gemma đã được tải trên thiết bị này. Mô hình này nhỏ: nó chấm các bài thơ, còn đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: Gemma has been loaded on this device. This model is small: it scores poems, the opponent uses pre-written poems.

brain.failed.text: Mô hình không khởi động được trên thiết bị này. Bạn vẫn có thể đấu với đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: The model cannot be started on this device. You can still play against your opponent using the pre-written poems.

brain.noModel.text: Đang chơi không có mô hình.

brain.written.text: Đang đấu với đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn.
brain.written.back: I'm fighting an opponent with a pre-written poem.

brain.noWebgpu.text: Trình duyệt này không có WebGPU, nên đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn và việc chấm điểm theo quy tắc. Mọi thứ khác vẫn hoạt động.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: This browser does not have a WebGPU, so the opponent uses pre-written poetry and rules-based scoring. Everything else still works.

brain.canRun.text: Thiết bị này chạy được Gemma ngay trong trình duyệt. Lần đầu phải tải 3,1 GB, sau đó được giữ lại.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma directly in the browser. 3.1 GB initially loaded, then retained.

brain.summonLighter.text: Triệu hồi Gemma (3,1 GB): bản tải nhẹ hơn
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: Đang đấu với đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn. Bạn có thể triệu hồi mô hình bất cứ lúc nào bằng cách tải lại trang.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You are playing against an opponent using a pre-written poem. You can recall the model at any time by reloading the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: Hãy thốt lên: kết một dòng bằng dấu chấm than.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Ariel: Say it out loud: end a line with a dot.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet giáng lên bạn lời nguyền Ariel: Không từ nào của bạn được dài quá 5 chữ cái.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet casts on you the Ariel curse: None of your words shall be longer than five letters.

round.composingDraft.text: Hamlet đang làm thơ… bản nháp 3 trên 3
round.composingDraft.back: Hamlet's writing a poem... a sketch of three.

round.items.text: Bảo vật và thuốc phép (mỗi thứ tốn 1 mực)
round.items.back: Relics and potions (each costing one ink)

round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…

round.mustDo.text: Bài thơ của bạn phải làm được gì

round.seedNote.text: Cùng hạt giống và cùng bộ bài sẽ rút ra cùng các thể thơ.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: The same seed and the same deck of cards will draw the same poems.

hand.lends.text: Cho mượn: đầu lâu, trò hề và nấm mồ
hand.lends.back: For loan: long head, tricks and mushrooms.

hand.curses.text: Nguyền đối thủ: Không từ nào của bạn được dài quá 5 chữ cái.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Opponent curse: None of your words can be longer than five letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet cho bạn mượn: đầu lâu, trò hề và nấm mồ.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet lends you: long heads, tricks and grave mushrooms.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet nguyền bài thơ kế tiếp của đối thủ: Không từ nào của bạn được dài quá 5 chữ cái.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses his opponent's next poem: None of your words shall be longer than five letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet lẽ ra sẽ nguyền bài thơ kế tiếp của đối thủ, nhưng đây là hiệp cuối.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet would have cursed his opponent's next poem, but this is the final act.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.text: Nhân vật đó không có trong bộ bài của bạn.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: That character is not in your deck.

illegal.character-used.text: Mỗi nhân vật chỉ được lên sân khấu một lần mỗi trận.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Each character can only be on stage once per match.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.text: Bảo vật đó không có trong bộ bài của bạn.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: That item isn't in your deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.text: Thuốc phép đó không có trong bộ bài của bạn.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.back: That magic isn't in your deck.

illegal.relic-spent.text: Bảo vật đó đã dùng rồi.

illegal.potion-spent.text: Thuốc phép đó đã dùng rồi.
illegal.potion-spent.back: That magic has already been used.

live.device.text: Ariel (+½ tay nghề): Hãy thốt lên: kết một dòng bằng dấu chấm than.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (+½ skill): Speak out: end a line with a dot.

live.signature.text: Dấu ấn (+½ tay nghề): gợi lại câu thoại của Hamlet mà không trích nguyên văn
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Mark (+½ skill): recall Hamlet's dialogue without quoting the original

live.power.text: Từ quyền năng (+2): dùng hai trong số đầu lâu, trò hề và nấm mồ
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Power Words (+2): Use two of the long-headed, tricky and grave mushrooms

live.powerUsed.text: đã dùng: đầu lâu, trò hề và nấm mồ

signature.none.text: lá bài này không có câu thoại dấu ấn
signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: This card doesn 't have a marked line .

signature.hint.text: gợi lại một trong các từ: đầu lâu, trò hề và nấm mồ
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: reminds me of one of the words: long-headed, jokes and mushrooms.

signature.quoted.text: trích nguyên văn; tiếng vọng phải là câu của chính bạn
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: quote; the echo must be your own sentence

mic.heardNothing.text: Không nghe thấy gì; hãy thử lại
mic.heardNothing.back: I can't hear anything; try again

mic.loadingEar.text: Đang tải đôi tai (75 MB, chỉ một lần)…

verdict.judgedCompare.text: Do Gemma chấm trên thiết bị này, đọc hai bài thơ theo cả hai thứ tự.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Because Gemma scored on this device, she read the two poems in both orders.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: Do Gemma chấm trên thiết bị này, cho điểm riêng từng bài thơ.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Because Gemma scores on this device, giving individual scores to each poem.

verdict.judgedRules.text: Chấm theo quy tắc (độ đa dạng, điển tích, âm điệu và lời đáp trả), vì không có mô hình nào đang chạy.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: Score according to the rules (variability, typicity, tone and response), because there is no running model.

end.lost.text: Đêm nay sân khấu thuộc về họ.
end.lost.back: Tonight the stage belongs to them.

end.tally.text: Số hiệp: bạn 2, đối thủ 1. Tổng điểm của bạn: 3.

badge.writtenJudged.text: Đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn · Gemma chấm
badge.writtenJudged.back: The opponent uses a pre-written poem · Gemma punctuated

badge.written.text: Đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn
badge.written.back: The opponent uses a pre-written poem.

theatre.intro.text: Vẫn trận đấu ấy, trên một sân khấu bao quanh bạn. Trỏ hoặc chụm ngón tay để đánh một lá bài, bấm micrô rồi xướng bài thơ. Lời bạn được chép lại và chấm ngay trên thiết bị này.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: Same game, on a stage all around you. Point or pinch your fingers to play a card, press the microphone and recite a poem. Your words are recorded and punctuated right on this device.

theatre.typeLabel.text: Hoặc gõ bài thơ của bạn

theatre.questBody.text: Mở ở chế độ nhìn xuyên, nên sân khấu nằm ngay trong phòng bạn. Trỏ bằng tay cầm hoặc chụm ngón tay.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: Opened in translucent mode, so the stage is right inside your room. Point with your hand or pinch your fingers.

theatre.visionBody.text: Mở thành một sân khấu trọn vẹn. Nhìn vào một lá bài rồi chụm ngón tay. Safari trên visionOS không cho trang web dùng chế độ nhìn xuyên.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Opens up a full stage. Look at a card and pinch your finger. Safari on visionOS does not allow the web to use translucent mode.

theatre.screenBody.text: Bấm vào các lá bài và nút trên sân khấu, rồi nói hoặc gõ.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click on the cards and buttons on stage, then speak or type.

theatre.running.text: Gemma đang chạy trên thiết bị này.
theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.
theatre.running.back: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: Đang đấu với đối thủ dùng thơ viết sẵn. Hãy triệu hồi một mô hình ở trang đấu trường để gặp nó tại đây.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: Fighting an opponent with a pre-written poem. Summon a model on the battlefield to meet it here.

theatre.enterAr.text: Vào: sân khấu trong phòng bạn
theatre.enterAr.back: Enter the stage in your room.

theatre.inFullStage.text: Đang trong kính (sân khấu trọn vẹn).

theatre.declined.text: Thiết bị này đã từ chối phiên nhập vai.
theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.
theatre.declined.back: This device has denied the role session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: Không bắt đầu được phiên trong kính.
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: Can't start the session in glasses.

theatre.judgedModel.text: Do Gemma chấm trên thiết bị này.
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: It's Gemma pointing at this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: Chấm theo quy tắc: không có mô hình nào đang chạy.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Punctuation by rule: there is no running model.

theatre.pick.text: Hãy chọn một nhân vật trên tay.
theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Choose a character on your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: Nguyền bạn: Không từ nào của bạn được dài quá 5 chữ cái.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: Curse you: None of your words can be longer than five letters.

theatre.composingDraft.text: đang làm thơ… bản nháp 3 trên 3
theatre.composingDraft.back: I'm writing a poem... sketch 3 of 3.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Bài thơ của bạn hiện ở đây. Bấm micrô rồi xướng lên, mỗi hơi một dòng.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Your poem is right here. Press the microphone and sing it up, one line at a time.

form.couplet.brief.text: สองบรรทัดที่สัมผัสกัน

form.quatrain-aabb.name.text: กลอนสี่สัมผัสคู่

form.quatrain-aabb.brief.text: สี่บรรทัด: สองบรรทัดแรกสัมผัสกัน และสองบรรทัดหลังสัมผัสกัน
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.english: Four lines: the first two rhyme, and the last two rhyme.
form.quatrain-aabb.brief.back: Four lines: the first two lines touch and the last two lines touch

form.quatrain-abab.name.text: กลอนสี่สัมผัสไขว้

form.quatrain-abab.brief.text: สี่บรรทัด: บรรทัด 1 สัมผัสกับบรรทัด 3 และบรรทัด 2 สัมผัสกับบรรทัด 4
form.quatrain-abab.brief.english: Four lines: line 1 rhymes with 3, line 2 with 4.
form.quatrain-abab.brief.back: Four lines: Line 1 touches line 3 and line 2 touches line 4.

form.tercet.brief.text: สามบรรทัด บรรทัดแรกกับบรรทัดสุดท้ายสัมผัสกัน
form.tercet.brief.english: Three lines; the first and last rhyme.
form.tercet.brief.back: Three lines. The first line and the last line touch each other.

form.anaphora.name.text: ซ้ำคำขึ้นต้น

form.anaphora.brief.text: สามบรรทัดที่ขึ้นต้นด้วยคำเดียวกันทุกบรรทัด
form.anaphora.brief.english: Three lines that all begin with the same word.
form.anaphora.brief.back: Three lines that start with the same word every line.

form.anaphora.brief.char.text: สามบรรทัดที่ขึ้นต้นด้วยอักษรตัวเดียวกันทุกบรรทัด
form.anaphora.brief.char.english: Three lines that all begin with the same character.
form.anaphora.brief.char.back: Three lines starting with the same letter every line.

form.acrostic.name.text: กลอนกระทู้

form.acrostic.brief.text: หนึ่งบรรทัดต่อหนึ่งตัวอักษร: อักษรตัวแรกของแต่ละบรรทัดต้องเรียงเป็นคำว่า กะโหลก
form.acrostic.brief.english: One line per letter: the first letters must spell skull.
form.acrostic.brief.back: One line per letter: The first letter of each line must be a skull.

form.acrostic.brief.words.text: หนึ่งบรรทัดต่อหนึ่งคำ: แต่ละบรรทัดต้องขึ้นต้นตามลำดับด้วย กะโหลก
form.acrostic.brief.words.english: One line per word: the lines must open, in order, with skull.
form.acrostic.brief.words.back: One line per word: Each line must begin with a skull.

form.crescendo.brief.text: สามบรรทัด แต่ละบรรทัดยาวกว่าบรรทัดก่อนหน้า
form.crescendo.brief.english: Three lines, each longer than the one before.
form.crescendo.brief.back: Three lines, each line longer than the previous one.

form.epistrophe.name.text: ซ้ำคำลงท้าย

form.epistrophe.brief.text: สามบรรทัดที่ลงท้ายด้วยคำเดียวกันทุกบรรทัด
form.epistrophe.brief.english: Three lines that all end on the same word.
form.epistrophe.brief.back: Three lines ending with the same word every line.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.text: สามบรรทัดที่ลงท้ายด้วยอักษรตัวเดียวกันทุกบรรทัด
form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three lines ending with the same letter every line.

form.haiku.brief.text: สามบรรทัด 5, 7 และ 5 พยางค์

form.haiku.brief.char.text: สามบรรทัด 5, 7 และ 5 ตัวอักษร

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: สามบรรทัด 5, 7 และ 5 เสียง ให้เขียนด้วยอักษรคานะ จึงจะนับเสียงได้
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 notes to be written with the letter Kana in order to count the notes.

form.heroic-couplet.name.text: กลอนคู่วีรกรรม

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: สองบรรทัดที่สัมผัสกัน บรรทัดละราวสิบพยางค์ แบบที่เชกสเปียร์ใช้ปิดซอนเน็ตของเขา
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two lines touching each other, about ten verses each, the way Shakespeare used to close his sonnet.

form.jueju.name.text: เจวี๋ยจวี้

auth.createWarning.text: ถ้าคุณทำพาสคีย์หาย เราจะพาคุณกลับเข้ามาไม่ได้ หลังจากนี้โปรดเพิ่มพาสคีย์ที่สองหรืออีเมล เพื่อให้กลับเข้ามาได้
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your passkey, we won't be able to get you back in. From now on, please add a second passkey or email to get back in.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: ถ้าคุณทำพาสคีย์หาย เราจะพาคุณกลับเข้ามาไม่ได้ หลังจากนี้โปรดเพิ่มพาสคีย์ที่สอง เพื่อให้กลับเข้ามาได้
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose the passkey, we won't be able to get you back in. From now on, please add a second passkey so that we can get back in.

auth.createConfirm.text: สร้างบัญชีของฉัน

auth.nudgeHeading.text: บัญชีของคุณพร้อมแล้ว

auth.nudgeBody.text: ตอนนี้พาสคีย์เพียงอันเดียวคือทางเดียวที่จะเข้าบัญชีนี้ ถ้ามันหาย บัญชีก็หายไปด้วย โปรดเพิ่มพาสคีย์ที่สองหรืออีเมล เพื่อให้กลับเข้ามาได้
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: Now, the only way to access this account is with one passkey. If it's lost, the account will be lost too. Please add a second passkey or email to get back in.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: ตอนนี้พาสคีย์เพียงอันเดียวคือทางเดียวที่จะเข้าบัญชีนี้ ถ้ามันหาย บัญชีก็หายไปด้วย โปรดเพิ่มพาสคีย์ที่สอง เพื่อให้กลับเข้ามาได้
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: Now, the only way to access this account is with one passkey. If it's lost, the account's gone too. Please add a second passkey to get back in.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: ใช้อุปกรณ์อีกเครื่อง ตัวจัดการรหัสผ่าน หรือคีย์ความปลอดภัย
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: The one passkey is your only access. Please add a second passkey or email to get back in.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: พาสคีย์อันเดียวคือทางเข้าทางเดียวของคุณ โปรดเพิ่มพาสคีย์ที่สอง เพื่อให้กลับเข้ามาได้
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: The one passkey is your only entrance. Please add a second passkey to get back in.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We've sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com, and please enter the code to verify that this address is yours.
