auth.addEmailDone.text: เพิ่มอีเมลแล้ว ตอนนี้คุณลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยรหัสที่ส่งไปยังอีเมลนั้นได้
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: An email has been added. You can now sign in with the code sent to that email.

auth.emailButton.text: ส่งรหัสให้ฉันทางอีเมล

auth.emailHint.text: ใช้อุปกรณ์ที่ไม่มีพาสคีย์ของคุณอยู่หรือ ลงชื่อเข้าใช้ทางอีเมลได้ ถ้าบัญชีของคุณมีอีเมล
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: Use a device that doesn't have your passkey, or sign in via email if your account has an email.

auth.emailHeading.text: ลงชื่อเข้าใช้ทางอีเมล

auth.emailIntro.text: เราจะส่งรหัส 6 หลักให้คุณทางอีเมล ถ้าเป็นที่อยู่ใหม่ รหัสนั้นจะสร้างบัญชีให้คุณ
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll email you a 6-digit code. If it's the new address, that code will create an account for you.

auth.emailLabel.text: ที่อยู่อีเมล

auth.emailSend.text: ส่งรหัสให้ฉันทางอีเมล

auth.codeHeading.text: กรอกรหัสของคุณ

auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We send a six-digit code to a@example.com, and the code is one-time and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.back: I'm sending you a new code. The old one is no longer valid.

auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add a passkey to this device.

auth.offerBody.text: ครั้งหน้า ลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยลายนิ้วมือ ใบหน้า หรือการล็อกหน้าจอ ไม่ต้องใช้รหัส ไม่ต้องรออีเมล

auth.offerBody.back: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No passcodes, no waiting for email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: No pascal key yet. Add one to log in without email encryption.

auth.passkeysAdd.text: เพิ่มพาสคีย์อีกอัน

auth.passkeyAdded.text: เพิ่มพาสคีย์แล้ว จากนี้ไปคุณลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยพาสคีย์นี้ได้
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: You have added a passkey. From now on, you can log in with this passkey.

auth.error.age_required.text: โปรดยืนยันอายุของคุณที่หน้าแรกก่อน บัญชีมีไว้สำหรับผู้เล่นอายุ 13 ปีขึ้นไป
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: ที่อยู่นั้นเป็นของบัญชีอื่นอยู่แล้ว โปรดออกจากระบบ แล้วลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยที่อยู่นั้นแทน
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: That address already belongs to another account. Please log out and log in with that address instead.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: บัญชีนี้มีที่อยู่อีเมลอยู่แล้ว
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.text: ดำเนินการไม่สำเร็จ โปรดลองอีกครั้ง
auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: ดูไม่เหมือนที่อยู่อีเมล
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: It doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: รหัสนั้นไม่ถูกต้อง หรือหมดอายุแล้ว โปรดตรวจดู หรือส่งรหัสใหม่
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect or expired. Please check or send a new one.

auth.error.code_incomplete.text: โปรดกรอกรหัสให้ครบ 6 หลัก
auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: ขอรหัสบ่อยเกินไป โปรดรอสักสองสามนาทีแล้วลองใหม่
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Asked for code too often. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.text: ขณะนี้ใช้อีเมลไม่ได้
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.
auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.back: Email is not available at the moment.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: เราส่งอีเมลไม่ได้ โปรดลองอีกครั้งในอีกสักครู่
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We can't send email. Please try again in a moment.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: เบราว์เซอร์นี้ใช้พาสคีย์ไม่ได้

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: ยังไม่ได้ใช้พาสคีย์ ลองใหม่ได้เมื่อคุณพร้อม
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: You can try again when you're ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: พาสคีย์นั้นไม่ได้รับการยอมรับ โปรดลงชื่อเข้าใช้ด้วยรหัสทางอีเมล แล้วเพิ่มพาสคีย์ใหม่
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: The passkey was not accepted. Please log in with your email password and add a new passkey.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: พาสคีย์ใช้งานไม่ได้ โปรดลองอีกครั้ง
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: Paskey not working. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: อุปกรณ์เครื่องนี้มีพาสคีย์ของบัญชีคุณอยู่แล้ว
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has the pascal of your account.

auth.error.passkey_already_registered.text: พาสคีย์นั้นลงทะเบียนไว้แล้ว

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: เพิ่มพาสคีย์นั้นไม่ได้ โปรดลองอีกครั้ง
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: Could not add that pascal. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: บัญชีนี้มีพาสคีย์ครบจำนวนสูงสุดแล้ว โปรดนำออกหนึ่งอันก่อน
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account has the maximum number of pascal keys. Please export one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: พาสคีย์นี้เป็นทางเดียวที่คุณใช้ลงชื่อเข้าใช้ โปรดเพิ่มอีกอันก่อนนำอันนี้ออก
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This key is the only way you can log in. Please add another before removing this one.

auth.error.challenge_expired.text: ใช้เวลานานเกินไป โปรดลองอีกครั้ง
auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.
auth.error.challenge_expired.back: It took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: เซสชันของคุณสิ้นสุดแล้ว โปรดลงชื่อเข้าใช้อีกครั้ง
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session has expired. Please login again.

auth.error.network.text: เราติดต่อเซิร์ฟเวอร์ไม่ได้ โปรดตรวจการเชื่อมต่อแล้วลองอีกครั้ง
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: We can't connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: เกิดข้อผิดพลาดบางอย่าง โปรดลองอีกครั้ง
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error.generic.back: Something went wrong. Please try again.

battle.badge.text: สังเวียนสด

battle.intro.text: สามยก สามฉันทลักษณ์ การ์ดของคุณกำหนดว่าบทกลอนของคุณต้องทำอะไร คู่ต่อสู้ทำงานอยู่ในเบราว์เซอร์ของคุณ: สิ่งที่คุณเขียนไม่ออกไปจากอุปกรณ์เครื่องนี้

battle.intro.back: Three turns, three syllables. Your card defines what your poem has to do. The opponent works in your browser: What you write can't get out of this device.

battle.difficulty.master.back: Choose the best out of three.

form.epistrophe.brief.char.english: Three lines that all end on the same character.
form.epistrophe.brief.char.back: Three rows all enclosed by the same character.

form.haiku.brief.text: Tiga baris berisi 5, 7, dan 5 suku kata.

form.haiku.brief.kana.text: Tiga baris berisi 5, 7, dan 5 bunyi. Tulis dengan kana supaya bunyinya bisa dihitung.
form.haiku.brief.kana.english: Three lines of 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write in kana so the sounds can be counted.
form.haiku.brief.kana.back: Three lines containing 5, 7 and 5 sounds. Write with kana so that the sounds can be counted.

form.heroic-couplet.brief.text: Dua baris berima, masing-masing kira-kira sepuluh suku kata, seperti cara Shakespeare menutup sonetanya.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.english: Two rhyming lines of about ten syllables each, as Shakespeare closed his sonnets.
form.heroic-couplet.brief.back: Two lines of intonation, about ten syllables each, like the way Shakespeare ended his sonnets.

form.jueju.brief.text: Empat baris, semuanya lima aksara atau semuanya tujuh: bentuk sajak empat baris klasik Tiongkok.
form.jueju.brief.english: Four lines, all of five characters or all of seven, the shape of a classical quatrain.
form.jueju.brief.back: Four lines, all five characters or all seven: Chinese classical four-line poem form.

form.luc-bat.brief.text: Satu baris enam suku kata, lalu satu baris delapan suku kata yang suku keenamnya berima dengan akhir baris pertama.
form.luc-bat.brief.english: A line of six syllables, then one of eight whose sixth syllable rhymes with the end of the first.
form.luc-bat.brief.back: A row of six syllables, then a row of eight syllables where the sixth syllable comes at the end of the first row.

check.same-opening.text: Setiap baris dibuka dengan kata yang sama
check.same-opening.english: Every line opens with the same word
check.same-opening.back: Each line starts with the same word

check.same-opening.char.text: Setiap baris dibuka dengan aksara yang sama
check.same-opening.char.english: Every line opens with the same character
check.same-opening.char.back: Each line starts with the same character

check.same-ending.text: Setiap baris ditutup dengan kata yang sama
check.same-ending.english: Every line ends on the same word
check.same-ending.back: Each line ends with the same word

check.same-ending.char.text: Setiap baris ditutup dengan aksara yang sama
check.same-ending.char.english: Every line ends on the same character
check.same-ending.char.back: Each line ends with the same character

check.spells.back: The first letters form a skull.

check.spells.words.english: Lines open, in order, with skull

check.growing.text: Setiap baris punya lebih banyak kata daripada baris sebelumnya
check.growing.english: Each line has more words than the last
check.growing.back: Each line has more words than the previous one.

check.growing.char.text: Setiap baris punya lebih banyak aksara daripada baris sebelumnya
check.growing.char.english: Each line has more characters than the last
check.growing.char.back: Each line has more characters than the previous one

check.jueju-length.text: Setiap baris berisi lima aksara, atau setiap baris berisi tujuh
check.jueju-length.english: Every line has five characters, or every line has seven
check.jueju-length.back: Each line contains five characters, or each line contains seven

check.luc-bat-rhyme.text: Suku kata keenam di kedua baris berima
check.luc-bat-rhyme.english: The sixth syllable of each line rhymes
check.luc-bat-rhyme.back: Sixth syllable in both syllable lines

device.question.brief.text: Ajukan pertanyaan: akhiri satu baris dengan tanda tanya.
device.question.brief.english: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
device.question.brief.back: Ask a question: end one line with a question mark.

device.exclaim.brief.text: Berserulah: akhiri satu baris dengan tanda seru.
device.exclaim.brief.english: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
device.exclaim.brief.back: Exclamation: end a line with an exclamation mark.

device.alliteration.brief.text: Awali tiga kata dalam satu baris dengan huruf yang sama.
device.alliteration.brief.english: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
device.alliteration.brief.back: Start three words in a row with the same letter.

device.repetition.brief.text: Ulangi satu kata yang kuat sebanyak tiga kali.
device.repetition.brief.english: Repeat one strong word three times.
device.repetition.brief.back: Repeat one strong word three times.

device.internal-rhyme.brief.text: Buat dua kata berima di dalam satu baris.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.english: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
device.internal-rhyme.brief.back: Make two apostrophes in one line.

device.riposte.brief.text: Balikkan kepada lawanmu satu kata berisi 3 huruf atau lebih dari syair terakhirnya.
device.riposte.brief.english: Turn a word of 3 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
device.riposte.brief.back: Return to your opponent a word of three letters or more from his last poem.

device.brevity.brief.text: Jangan ada baris yang lebih dari 3 kata.
device.brevity.brief.english: Keep every line to 3 words or fewer.
device.brevity.brief.back: No lines that are longer than three words.

device.brevity.brief.char.text: Jangan ada baris yang lebih dari 3 aksara.
device.brevity.brief.char.english: Keep every line to 3 characters or fewer.

device.swell.brief.text: Jadikan baris terakhirmu yang paling panjang.
device.swell.brief.english: Make your last line your longest.
device.swell.brief.back: Make your last line the longest.

device.balance.brief.text: Beri setiap baris jumlah kata yang sama.
device.balance.brief.english: Give every line the same number of words.
device.balance.brief.back: Give each line the same number of words.

device.balance.brief.char.text: Beri setiap baris jumlah aksara yang sama.
device.balance.brief.char.english: Give every line the same number of characters.
device.balance.brief.char.back: Give each line the same number of characters.

device.ring.brief.text: Tutup syairmu dengan kata yang sama dengan pembukanya.
device.ring.brief.english: End your verse on the same word it began with.
device.ring.brief.back: Close your poem with the same words as it opens.

device.ring.brief.char.text: Tutup syairmu dengan aksara yang sama dengan pembukanya.
device.ring.brief.char.english: End your verse on the same character it began with.
device.ring.brief.char.back: Close your poem with the same character as its opening.

device.invocation.brief.english: Call on a character by name.

device.grandeur.brief.text: Gunakan dua kata yang berisi 3 huruf atau lebih.
device.grandeur.brief.english: Use two words of 3 letters or more.
device.grandeur.brief.back: Use two words of 3 or more letters.

device.monorhyme.brief.text: Tutup setiap baris dengan rima yang sama.
device.monorhyme.brief.english: End every line on the same rhyme.
device.monorhyme.brief.back: Close each line with the same rhyme.

curse.forbidden-letter.brief.text: Syairmu tidak boleh memuat huruf N.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.english: Your verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.brief.back: Your poem can't contain the letter N.

curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.text: Syair lawan tidak boleh memuat huruf N.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.english: Their verse may not contain the letter S.
curse.forbidden-letter.theirs.back: The opponent's puzzle cannot contain the letter N.

curse.short-words.brief.text: Tidak satu pun katamu boleh lebih dari 3 huruf.
curse.short-words.brief.english: No word of yours may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.brief.back: No one of your words can be longer than three letters.

curse.short-words.theirs.text: Tidak satu pun kata lawan boleh lebih dari 3 huruf.
curse.short-words.theirs.english: No word of theirs may be longer than 3 letters.
curse.short-words.theirs.back: No opposing word can be longer than three letters.

curse.no-repeats.brief.text: Kamu tidak boleh memakai dua kali kata yang berisi 3 huruf atau lebih.
curse.no-repeats.brief.english: You may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.brief.back: You can't use a word of three letters or more twice.

curse.no-repeats.theirs.text: Lawan tidak boleh memakai dua kali kata yang berisi 3 huruf atau lebih.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.english: They may not use any word of 3 letters or more twice.
curse.no-repeats.theirs.back: The opponent cannot use a word of 3 or more letters twice.

curse.short-lines.brief.text: Tidak satu pun barismu boleh lebih dari 3 kata.
curse.short-lines.brief.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.brief.back: No one of your bars can be more than three words.

curse.short-lines.brief.char.text: Tidak satu pun barismu boleh lebih dari 3 aksara.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.english: No line of yours may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.brief.char.back: None of your bars can be longer than three characters.

curse.short-lines.theirs.text: Tidak satu pun baris lawan boleh lebih dari 3 kata.
curse.short-lines.theirs.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 words.
curse.short-lines.theirs.back: No line of opponents can be more than three words.

curse.short-lines.theirs.char.text: Tidak satu pun baris lawan boleh lebih dari 3 aksara.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.english: No line of theirs may be longer than 3 characters.
curse.short-lines.theirs.char.back: None of the opposing lines can be longer than 3 characters.

house.montague.why.text: Lidah Mercutio yang lincah berima di tengah baris.
house.montague.why.back: Mercutio's agile tongue takes in the middle of the line.

house.verona-court.why.text: Mahkamah menimbang setiap kata yang diucapkan melawanmu.
house.verona-court.why.english: The court weighs every word said against you.
house.verona-court.why.back: The court weighs every word spoken against you.

house.the-tempest.why.english: The storm builds until it breaks.
house.the-tempest.why.back: The storm grew until it finally broke.

house.legendary.why.text: Sonnet Man menunggangi satu rima sampai habis.
house.legendary.why.english: The Sonnet Man rides one rhyme all the way down.
house.legendary.why.back: Sonnet Man rides one rhyme to the end.

house.gothic-circle.why.text: Kisah berakhir di tempat ia bermula.
house.gothic-circle.why.english: The tale ends where it began.
house.gothic-circle.why.back: The story ends where it began.

house.olympus.why.text: Para dewa berbicara dengan kata-kata bergemuruh.
house.olympus.why.english: The gods speak in thunderous words.
house.olympus.why.back: The gods speak with tumultuous words.

house.underworld.why.text: Orang mati mengingat semua yang kamu ucapkan.
house.underworld.why.english: The dead remember everything you said.
house.underworld.why.back: The dead remember everything you say.

footer.tagline.text: Kartu koleksi digital bertenaga AI dan realitas tertambah. Pengalaman interaktif yang menghidupkan Shakespeare.
footer.tagline.english: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality. Interactive experiences that bring Shakespeare to life.
footer.tagline.back: Digital collectible cards powered by AI and augmented reality, an interactive experience that brings Shakespeare to life.

age.intro.english: Please confirm your age to continue.

age.errorDob.english: Please select your full date of birth.
age.errorDob.back: Please enter your full date of birth.

age.minorBody.text: Kamu harus berusia sekurangnya 13 tahun untuk memakai Inspired Mile. Silakan kembali setelah memenuhi syarat usia.
age.minorBody.english: You must be at least 13 years old to use Inspired Mile. Please come back when you meet the age requirement.
age.minorBody.back: You must be at least 13 years old to use the Inspired Mile.

age.teenBody.text: Karena usiamu di bawah 18 tahun, kamu perlu izin orang tua atau wali untuk memakai Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.english: Since you are under 18, you need parental or guardian consent to use Inspired Mile.
age.teenBody.back: Because you are under the age of 18, you need parental or guardian permission to use Inspired Mile.

age.consentBefore.text: Saya menyatakan bahwa orang tua atau wali sah saya telah membaca
age.consentBefore.english: I confirm that my parent or legal guardian has reviewed the
age.consentBefore.back: I declare that my parent or legal guardian has read

age.consentAfter.text: serta mengizinkan saya memakai Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.english: and consents to my use of Inspired Mile.
age.consentAfter.back: And allow me to use the Inspired Mile.

age.agreeBefore.english: By continuing, you agree to our

migrate.body.text: Kami menemukan progres permainan di perangkat ini. Sinkronkan ke akunmu supaya tersimpan di semua perangkat.
migrate.body.english: We found local game progress. Sync it to your account so it's saved across devices.
migrate.body.back: We found game progress on this device, sync it to your account so it's saved across all devices.

migrate.failed.text: Sinkronisasi gagal. Kamu bisa mencoba lagi nanti.
migrate.failed.english: Sync failed. You can try again later.
migrate.failed.back: Sync failed. You can try again later.

pwa.install.text: Pasang Inspired Mile untuk pengalaman terbaik
pwa.install.english: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience
pwa.install.back: Install Inspired Mile for the best experience

offline.banner.text: Kamu sedang luring: Koleksi dan Kuis tetap berjalan. Multipemain butuh internet.
offline.banner.english: You're offline — Collection and Trivia still work. Multiplayer requires internet.
offline.banner.back: You're offline: Collections and Quizzes are still running. Multiplayer requires internet.

auth.signInIntro.text: Tidak ada kata sandi yang perlu diingat. Kunci sandi memasukkanmu dengan sidik jari, wajah, atau kunci layar.
auth.signInIntro.english: No password to remember. A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
auth.signInIntro.back: No passwords to remember. Password lock signs you in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.

auth.passkeyUnsupported.text: Peramban ini tidak bisa memakai kunci sandi. Masuklah dengan kode yang dikirim lewat email.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.english: This browser cannot use passkeys. Sign in with an emailed code instead.
auth.passkeyUnsupported.back: This browser cannot use a password. Please enter the code sent to you by email.

auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.text: Peramban ini tidak bisa memakai kunci sandi, padahal situs ini masuk dengan kunci sandi. Coba versi terbaru Chrome, Safari, Edge, atau Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.english: This browser cannot use passkeys, and this site signs in with them. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedNoEmail.back: This browser cannot use a password, but the site is logged in with a password. Try the latest version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.

auth.createButton.english: Create an account with a passkey
auth.createButton.back: Create an account with a password

auth.createIntro.text: Akunmu adalah sebuah kunci sandi yang tersimpan di perangkat ini atau di pengelola kata sandimu. Kami tidak meminta nama, email, atau kata sandi.
auth.createIntro.english: Your account is a passkey saved on this device or in your password manager. We do not ask for a name, an email, or a password.
auth.createIntro.back: Your account is a password key stored on this device or in your password manager. We don't ask for your name, email, or password.

auth.createWarning.text: Kalau kunci sandinya hilang, kami tidak bisa memasukkanmu lagi. Setelah ini, tambahkan kunci sandi kedua atau email supaya kamu bisa masuk kembali.
auth.createWarning.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.createWarning.back: If you lose your password, we won't be able to enter you again. After this, add a second password or email so that you can get back in.

auth.createWarningNoEmail.text: Kalau kunci sandinya hilang, kami tidak bisa memasukkanmu lagi. Setelah ini, tambahkan kunci sandi kedua supaya kamu bisa masuk kembali.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.english: If you lose the passkey, we cannot let you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.createWarningNoEmail.back: If you lose the passkey, we can't get you back in. After this, add a second passkey so you can get back in.

auth.nudgeBody.text: Saat ini satu kunci sandi adalah satu-satunya jalan masuk ke akun ini. Kalau hilang, akunnya ikut hilang. Tambahkan kunci sandi kedua atau email supaya kamu bisa masuk kembali.
auth.nudgeBody.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBody.back: Currently, one password key is the only way to access this account. If you lose it, your account will also be lost. Please add a second password key or email so that you can log in again.

auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.text: Saat ini satu kunci sandi adalah satu-satunya jalan masuk ke akun ini. Kalau hilang, akunnya ikut hilang. Tambahkan kunci sandi kedua supaya kamu bisa masuk kembali.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.english: Right now one passkey is the only way into this account. If it is lost, the account is lost. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.nudgeBodyNoEmail.back: Currently, one password key is the only way to access this account. If you lose it, your account will also be lost. Add a second password key so that you can log in again.

auth.nudgePasskeyHint.text: Gunakan perangkat lain, pengelola kata sandi, atau kunci keamanan.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.english: Use another device, a password manager or a security key.
auth.nudgePasskeyHint.back: Use another device, password manager, or security key.

auth.recoveryWarning.text: Satu kunci sandi adalah satu-satunya jalan masukmu. Tambahkan kunci sandi kedua atau email supaya kamu bisa masuk kembali.
auth.recoveryWarning.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey or an email so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarning.back: One password key is your only way to get in. Add a second password key or email so you can get back in.

auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.text: Satu kunci sandi adalah satu-satunya jalan masukmu. Tambahkan kunci sandi kedua supaya kamu bisa masuk kembali.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.english: One passkey is your only way in. Add a second passkey so you can get back in.
auth.recoveryWarningNoEmail.back: One passkey is your only way in, add a second passkey so you can get back in.

auth.addEmailCodeIntro.text: Kami mengirim kode 6 angka ke a@example.com. Masukkan kode itu untuk memastikan alamat tersebut milikmu.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter it to confirm the address is yours.
auth.addEmailCodeIntro.back: We've sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. Enter that code to verify the address is yours.

auth.addEmailDone.text: Email ditambahkan. Sekarang kamu bisa masuk dengan kode yang dikirim ke alamat itu.
auth.addEmailDone.english: Email added. You can now sign in with a code sent to it.
auth.addEmailDone.back: Email added, now you can log in with the code sent to that address.

auth.emailButton.back: Send me the code by email

auth.emailHint.text: Sedang di perangkat tanpa kunci sandimu? Masuklah lewat email, kalau akunmu punya.
auth.emailHint.english: On a device without your passkey? Sign in by email, if your account has one.
auth.emailHint.back: If you're on a device without your password, log in via email if you have one.

auth.emailIntro.text: Kami akan mengirim kode 6 angka. Kalau alamatnya baru, kode itu membuat akunmu.
auth.emailIntro.english: We will email you a 6-digit code. If the address is new, the code creates your account.
auth.emailIntro.back: We'll send you a 6-digit code, and if the address is new, it creates your account.

auth.emailSend.back: Send me the code by email

auth.codeIntro.text: Kami mengirim kode 6 angka ke a@example.com. Kode berlaku satu kali dan kedaluwarsa dalam 10 menit.
auth.codeIntro.english: We sent a 6-digit code to a@example.com. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
auth.codeIntro.back: We send a 6-digit code to a@example.com. The code is valid once and expires in 10 minutes.

auth.codeResent.text: Kode baru sedang dikirim. Kode lama tidak berlaku lagi.
auth.codeResent.english: A new code is on its way. The old one no longer works.
auth.codeResent.back: The new code is being sent, the old one has expired.

auth.legalBefore.english: By signing in, you agree to our

auth.offerHeading.text: Tambahkan kunci sandi ke perangkat ini
auth.offerHeading.english: Add a passkey to this device
auth.offerHeading.back: Add password key to this device

auth.offerBody.text: Lain kali, masuklah dengan sidik jari, wajah, atau kunci layar. Tanpa kode, tanpa menunggu email.
auth.offerBody.english: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock. No code, no waiting for an email.
auth.offerBody.back: Next time, sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock without a code, without waiting for an email.

auth.passkeysEmpty.text: Belum ada kunci sandi. Tambahkan satu supaya bisa masuk tanpa kode email.
auth.passkeysEmpty.english: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without an email code.
auth.passkeysEmpty.back: There is no password key. Add one so you can log in without an email code.

auth.passkeyAdded.text: Kunci sandi ditambahkan. Mulai sekarang kamu bisa masuk dengannya.
auth.passkeyAdded.english: Passkey added. You can sign in with it from now on.
auth.passkeyAdded.back: A password key has been added, and from now on you can log in with it.

auth.error.age_required.text: Konfirmasikan dulu usiamu di halaman beranda. Akun hanya untuk pemain berusia 13 tahun ke atas.
auth.error.age_required.english: Please confirm your age on the home page first. Accounts are for players aged 13 and over.
auth.error.age_required.back: Please confirm your age on the home page. Accounts are only for players 13 and over.

auth.error.email_in_use.text: Alamat itu sudah dimiliki akun lain. Keluarlah, lalu masuk dengan alamat itu.
auth.error.email_in_use.english: That address already belongs to another account. Sign out and sign in with it instead.
auth.error.email_in_use.back: That address is already in another account.

auth.error.email_already_set.text: Akun ini sudah punya alamat email.
auth.error.email_already_set.english: This account already has an email address.
auth.error.email_already_set.back: This account already has an email address.

auth.error.signup_retry.english: That did not go through. Please try again.

auth.error.invalid_email.text: Itu tidak tampak seperti alamat email.
auth.error.invalid_email.english: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.invalid_email.back: That doesn't look like an email address.

auth.error.invalid_code.text: Kode itu salah atau sudah kedaluwarsa. Periksa lagi, atau kirim kode baru.
auth.error.invalid_code.english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
auth.error.invalid_code.back: The code is incorrect or expired. Please check again, or send a new code.

auth.error.code_incomplete.english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

auth.error.too_many_requests.text: Terlalu banyak kode diminta. Tunggu beberapa menit, lalu coba lagi.
auth.error.too_many_requests.english: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.too_many_requests.back: Too many codes requested, please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.error.email_sign_in_unavailable.english: Email is not available right now.

auth.error.email_send_failed.text: Kami tidak bisa mengirim email. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
auth.error.email_send_failed.english: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.error.email_send_failed.back: We can't send the email, please try again in a moment.

auth.error.passkey_unsupported.text: Peramban ini tidak bisa memakai kunci sandi.
auth.error.passkey_unsupported.back: This browser cannot use a passkey.

auth.error.passkey_cancelled.text: Tidak ada kunci sandi yang dipakai. Coba lagi kalau kamu sudah siap.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.english: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
auth.error.passkey_cancelled.back: No password key used. Try again when you're ready.

auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.text: Kunci sandi itu tidak diterima. Masuklah dengan kode email, lalu tambahkan kunci sandi baru.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.english: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with an emailed code, then add a new passkey.
auth.error.passkey_not_accepted.back: The key password is not accepted. Please enter the email code, and add a new key password.

auth.error.passkey_failed.text: Kunci sandinya tidak berfungsi. Silakan coba lagi.
auth.error.passkey_failed.english: The passkey did not work. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_failed.back: The passkey does not work. Please try again.

auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.text: Perangkat ini sudah punya kunci sandi untuk akunmu.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.english: This device already has a passkey for your account.
auth.error.passkey_already_on_device.back: This device already has a password for your account.

auth.error.passkey_not_registered.text: Kunci sandi itu tidak bisa ditambahkan. Silakan coba lagi.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.english: That passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth.error.passkey_not_registered.back: That password key could not be added. Please try again.

auth.error.too_many_passkeys.text: Akun ini sudah punya jumlah kunci sandi maksimum. Hapus satu dulu.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.english: This account has the most passkeys it can hold. Remove one first.
auth.error.too_many_passkeys.back: This account already has the maximum number of password keys. Delete one first.

auth.error.last_sign_in_method.text: Kunci sandi ini satu-satunya caramu masuk. Tambahkan yang lain sebelum menghapusnya.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.english: This passkey is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
auth.error.last_sign_in_method.back: This password is the only way you can get in.

auth.error.challenge_expired.english: That took too long. Please try again.

auth.error.not_signed_in.text: Sesimu sudah berakhir. Silakan masuk lagi.
auth.error.not_signed_in.english: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.error.not_signed_in.back: Your session is over, please come back in.

auth.error.network.text: Kami tidak bisa menghubungi server. Periksa koneksimu dan coba lagi.
auth.error.network.english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.back: We can't reach the server, please check your connection and try again.

auth.error.generic.text: Ada yang tidak beres. Silakan coba lagi.
auth.error.generic.english: Something went wrong. Please try again.

battle.intro.text: Tiga ronde, tiga bentuk. Kartumu menentukan apa yang harus dilakukan syairmu. Lawan berjalan di perambanmu: tak satu pun tulisanmu meninggalkan perangkat ini.
battle.intro.english: Three rounds, three forms. Your cards decide what your verse must do. The opponent runs in your browser: nothing you write leaves this device.
battle.intro.back: Three rounds, three shapes, your cards dictate what your spell must do, the opponent walks on your browser: not one of your writings leaves this device.

battle.prepareNote.text: Setiap tokoh hanya bisa naik panggung satu kali. Relik dan ramuan memakan tinta.
battle.prepareNote.english: Each character can take the stage once. Relics and potions cost ink.
battle.prepareNote.back: Each character can only be on stage once, relics and spices eat ink.

battle.difficulty.player.text: Pemain: memilih yang lebih baik dari dua draf
battle.difficulty.player.english: Player: picks the better of two drafts
battle.difficulty.player.back: Player: choose the better of two drafts

battle.difficulty.master.text: Empu: memilih yang terbaik dari tiga draf
battle.difficulty.master.english: Master: picks the best of three drafts
battle.difficulty.master.back: Empu: choose the best of three drafts

brain.checking.text: Memeriksa apa yang bisa dijalankan perangkat ini…
brain.checking.english: Checking what this device can run…
brain.checking.back: Checking what this device can run...

brain.kept.text: Diunduh sekali dari Hugging Face dan disimpan perambanmu. Apa pun yang kamu tulis atau ucapkan tidak dikirim ke mana pun.
brain.kept.english: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept by your browser. Nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.
brain.kept.back: Once downloaded from Hugging Face and stored in your browser, nothing you write or say is sent anywhere.

brain.loaded.text: Gemma sudah dimuat dan berjalan di perangkat ini.
brain.loaded.english: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.
brain.loaded.back: Gemma is loaded and running on this device.

brain.loadedJudgeOnly.text: Gemma sudah dimuat di perangkat ini. Modelnya kecil: ia menilai syair, sedangkan lawan memainkan syair yang sudah ditulis.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.english: Gemma is loaded on this device. It is small: it judges the verses, and the opponent plays written verse.
brain.loadedJudgeOnly.back: Gemma has been loaded on this device. The model is small: she scores poems while the opponent plays poems that have already been written.

brain.failed.text: Model tidak bisa berjalan di perangkat ini. Kamu tetap bisa bermain melawan lawan bersyair tertulis.
brain.failed.english: The model could not start on this device. You can still play against the written opponent.
brain.failed.back: Models can't run on this device, but you can still play against opponents with written poetry.

brain.noWebgpu.text: Peramban ini tidak punya WebGPU, jadi lawan memainkan syair yang sudah ditulis dan penilaian memakai aturan. Selebihnya berjalan seperti biasa.
brain.noWebgpu.english: This browser has no WebGPU, so the opponent plays from written verses and the judging is by rule. Everything else works.
brain.noWebgpu.back: The browser does not have a WebGPU, so the opponent plays a written poem and scores according to the rules. The rest goes as usual.

brain.canRun.text: Perangkat ini bisa menjalankan Gemma di peramban. Unduhan pertamanya 3,1 GB, sesudah itu tersimpan.
brain.canRun.english: This device can run Gemma in the browser. It is a 3.1 GB download the first time, then it is kept.
brain.canRun.back: This device can run Gemma in a browser. The initial download is 3.1 GB, after that it's saved.

brain.summonLighter.text: Panggil Gemma (3,1 GB): unduhan yang lebih ringan
brain.summonLighter.english: Summon Gemma (3.1 GB): a lighter download

brain.writtenReload.text: Bermain melawan lawan bersyair tertulis. Kamu bisa memanggil model kapan saja dengan memuat ulang halaman.
brain.writtenReload.english: Playing against the written opponent. You can summon the model any time by reloading.
brain.writtenReload.back: You can call the model at any time by reloading the page.

round.device.text: Ariel: Berserulah: akhiri satu baris dengan tanda seru.
round.device.english: Ariel: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
round.device.back: Come on: end one line with an exclamation mark.

round.cursesYou.text: Hamlet mengutukmu dengan Ariel: Tidak satu pun katamu boleh lebih dari 5 huruf.
round.cursesYou.english: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
round.cursesYou.back: Hamlet curses you with Ariel: No word of yours can be more than five letters.

round.versePlaceholder.text: Satu baris syair di tiap baris…
round.versePlaceholder.english: One line of verse per line…
round.versePlaceholder.back: One line of poetry in each line...

round.mustDo.back: What your poem has to do

round.seedNote.text: Benih dan dek yang sama mengundi bentuk yang sama.
round.seedNote.english: The same seed and deck draw the same forms.
round.seedNote.back: Same seeds and decks vote for the same shape.

hand.curses.text: Mengutuk lawanmu: Tidak satu pun katamu boleh lebih dari 5 huruf.
hand.curses.english: Curses your opponent: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.curses.back: Curse your opponent: No word can be longer than 5 letters.

hand.relicNote.text: Hamlet meminjamimu: tengkorak, lelucon, dan kubur.
hand.relicNote.english: Hamlet lends you: skull, jest, and grave.
hand.relicNote.back: Hamlet borrowed you: a skull, a joke, and a tomb.

hand.potionNote.text: Hamlet mengutuk syair lawanmu berikutnya: Tidak satu pun katamu boleh lebih dari 5 huruf.
hand.potionNote.english: Hamlet curses your opponent's next verse: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
hand.potionNote.back: Hamlet curses your next opponent's poem: No word of yours may be more than five letters.

hand.potionLastRound.text: Hamlet akan mengutuk syair lawan berikutnya, tetapi ini ronde terakhir.
hand.potionLastRound.english: Hamlet would curse the opponent's next verse, but this is the last round.
hand.potionLastRound.back: Hamlet will curse his next opponent, but this is the last round.

illegal.character-not-in-deck.text: Tokoh itu tidak ada di dekmu.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.english: That character is not in your deck.
illegal.character-not-in-deck.back: That character isn't on your deck.

illegal.character-used.text: Setiap tokoh hanya bisa naik panggung satu kali per pertandingan.
illegal.character-used.english: Each character can take the stage once per match.
illegal.character-used.back: Each character can only step on stage once per match.

illegal.relic-not-in-deck.text: Relik itu tidak ada di dekmu.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.english: That relic is not in your deck.
illegal.relic-not-in-deck.back: The relic's not on your deck.

illegal.potion-not-in-deck.text: Ramuan itu tidak ada di dekmu.
illegal.potion-not-in-deck.english: That potion is not in your deck.

live.device.text: Ariel (+½ keahlian): Berserulah: akhiri satu baris dengan tanda seru.
live.device.english: Ariel (+½ craft): Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
live.device.back: Ariel (+½ skill): Exclaim: end one line with an exclamation mark.

live.signature.text: Tanda tangan (+½ keahlian): gemakan dialog Hamlet tanpa mengutipnya
live.signature.english: Signature (+½ craft): echo Hamlet's line without quoting it
live.signature.back: Signature (+½ expertise): emulate Hamlet's dialogue without quoting it

live.power.text: Kata sakti (+2): pakai dua dari tengkorak, lelucon, dan kubur
live.power.english: Power words (+2): use two of skull, jest, and grave
live.power.back: Magic words (+2): use two of skulls, jokes, and graves

signature.none.text: kartu ini tidak punya dialog tanda tangan
signature.none.english: this card has no signature line
signature.none.back: This card does not have a signature dialog

signature.hint.text: gemakan salah satu dari: tengkorak, lelucon, dan kubur
signature.hint.english: echo one of: skull, jest, and grave
signature.hint.back: Echo one of: skulls, jokes, and graves

signature.quoted.text: dikutip mentah-mentah; gema harus berupa barismu sendiri
signature.quoted.english: quoted outright; an echo must be your own line
signature.quoted.back: quoted raw; the echo must be your own

verdict.judgedCompare.text: Dinilai oleh Gemma di perangkat ini, dengan membaca kedua syair dalam dua urutan.
verdict.judgedCompare.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, reading the verses in both orders.
verdict.judgedCompare.back: Evaluated by Gemma on this device, by reading both poems in two sequences.

verdict.judgedGrade.text: Dinilai oleh Gemma di perangkat ini, dengan menilai tiap syair secara terpisah.
verdict.judgedGrade.english: Judged by Gemma on this device, grading each verse on its own.
verdict.judgedGrade.back: Graded by Gemma on this device, grading each poem separately.

verdict.judgedRules.text: Dinilai dengan aturan (keragaman, alusi, bunyi, dan balasan), karena tidak ada model yang berjalan.
verdict.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule (variety, allusion, sound, and comeback), because no model is running.
verdict.judgedRules.back: It is judged by rules (diversity, allusions, sounds, and responses), since there are no running models.

badge.writtenJudged.back: A rival poet wrote · rated Gemma

theatre.intro.text: Duel yang sama, di panggung yang mengelilingimu. Tunjuk atau cubit untuk memainkan kartu, tekan mikrofon, lalu ucapkan syairmu. Ucapanmu disalin dan dinilai di perangkat ini.
theatre.intro.english: The same duel, on a stage around you. Point or pinch to play a card, press the microphone and speak your verse. It is transcribed and judged on this device.
theatre.intro.back: The same duel, on a stage surrounding you, point or pinch to play cards, press the microphone, then say your poem, your speech is copied and scored on this device.

theatre.questBody.text: Terbuka dalam mode tembus pandang, jadi panggungnya berdiri di ruanganmu. Tunjuk dengan pengendali atau cubit dengan tangan.
theatre.questBody.english: Opens in passthrough, so the stage sits in your room. Point a controller or pinch with a hand.
theatre.questBody.back: Open in translucent mode, so the stage stands in your room.

theatre.visionBody.text: Terbuka sebagai panggung penuh. Tatap sebuah kartu, lalu cubit. Safari di visionOS tidak menyediakan mode tembus pandang untuk halaman web.
theatre.visionBody.english: Opens as a full stage. Look at a card and pinch. Safari on visionOS does not offer passthrough to web pages.
theatre.visionBody.back: Open as a full stage. Look at a card, then pinch. Safari on visionOS does not provide transparency mode for web pages.

theatre.screenBody.text: Klik kartu dan tombol di panggung, lalu bicara atau ketik.
theatre.screenBody.english: Click the cards and buttons on the stage, and speak or type.
theatre.screenBody.back: Click cards and buttons on the stage, then speak or type.

theatre.running.english: Gemma is running on this device.

theatre.writtenHint.text: Bermain melawan lawan bersyair tertulis. Panggil model di halaman pertarungan untuk menghadapinya di sini.
theatre.writtenHint.english: Playing the written opponent. Summon a model on the battle page to face one here.
theatre.writtenHint.back: Play against a written opponent, call the model on the battle page to face him here.

theatre.declined.english: This device declined an immersive session.

theatre.xrFailed.text: Sesi di headset tidak bisa dimulai.
theatre.xrFailed.english: The headset session could not start.
theatre.xrFailed.back: The session on the headset could not start.

theatre.judgedModel.text: Dinilai oleh Gemma di perangkat ini.
theatre.judgedModel.english: Judged by Gemma on this device.
theatre.judgedModel.back: Rated by Gemma on this device.

theatre.judgedRules.text: Dinilai dengan aturan: tidak ada model yang berjalan.
theatre.judgedRules.english: Judged by rule: no model is running.
theatre.judgedRules.back: Judged by the rule: no running model.

theatre.pick.english: Pick a character from your hand.
theatre.pick.back: Pick a character from your hand.

theatre.cursesYou.text: Mengutukmu: Tidak satu pun katamu boleh lebih dari 5 huruf.
theatre.cursesYou.english: Curses you: No word of yours may be longer than 5 letters.
theatre.cursesYou.back: Cursing you: No one of your words can be longer than five letters.

theatre.versePrompt.text: Syairmu muncul di sini. Tekan mikrofon dan ucapkan, satu baris tiap tarikan napas.
theatre.versePrompt.english: Your verse appears here. Press the microphone and speak it, one line at a breath.
theatre.versePrompt.back: Press the microphone and say it, one line per breath.
